modules.title: Unit 1: Amazing People: Present Tenses & Personality
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan present perfect dengan just, already, dan yet untuk membicarakan hal yang sudah dan belum dilakukan, serta membandingkannya dengan past simple. Siswa juga dapat mendeskripsikan kepribadian seseorang menggunakan kata sifat yang tepat dan memberikan dukungan dalam percakapan.

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan perbedaan antara present perfect dan past simple. Present perfect digunakan untuk tindakan yang relevan dengan sekarang atau tanpa waktu spesifik. Past simple digunakan untuk tindakan di waktu tertentu di masa lalu. Kata just, already, dan yet sering dipakai dengan present perfect untuk menunjukkan waktu tindakan.
rules: Present Perfect + just: I have just finished my homework. (Baru saja selesai, relevan dengan sekarang)
Present Perfect + already: She has already come back from Papua New Guinea. (Sudah selesai lebih cepat dari yang diharapkan)
Present Perfect + yet: They haven't made any recordings yet. (Belum terjadi, tapi kita harapkan akan segera terjadi)
Past Simple untuk waktu spesifik: She wrote her first book when she was just five. (Waktu jelas: when she was five)
Present Perfect tanpa waktu spesifik: He has visited Greece more than 20 times. (Tidak ada waktu spesifik disebutkan)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampur Present Perfect dengan Waktu Spesifik
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula menggunakan present perfect bersama keterangan waktu spesifik seperti 'yesterday' atau 'in 1998'. Ini salah karena present perfect tidak menyebutkan waktu spesifik, hanya past simple yang boleh.
commonTrap.wrong: I have visited Greece in 1998.
commonTrap.correct: I visited Greece in 1998. (atau) I have visited Greece before.

dialogue.context: Sekelompok teman sedang membahas siapa yang harus membuka kafe baru di taman. Mereka mendiskusikan berbagai pilihan dan memberikan pendapat tentang siapa yang paling cocok.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Have you read this? They're opening a new café in the park. Saturday afternoon.
lines.translation: Kamu sudah baca ini? Mereka membuka kafe baru di taman. Sabtu sore.

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: That's fantastic. Who's going to do the big opening ceremony?
lines.translation: Itu fantastis. Siapa yang akan melakukan upacara pembukaan besar?

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: The mayor probably. She always does shop openings and conferences, that sort of thing.
lines.translation: Walikota mungkin. Dia selalu melakukan pembukaan toko dan konferensi, hal semacam itu.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Hey, I know. They should get Paul Norris. Yeah! He's a great footballer! He plays for United now, but he grew up round here.
lines.translation: Hei, aku tahu. Mereka harus mengundang Paul Norris. Ya! Dia pemain sepak bola hebat! Dia bermain untuk United sekarang, tapi dia tumbuh di sekitar sini.

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: But he doesn't live round here any more. He's a star now. Let's face it, he won't want to open a little park café.
lines.translation: Tapi dia tidak tinggal di sekitar sini lagi. Dia bintang sekarang. Hadapi kenyataan, dia tidak akan mau membuka kafe taman kecil.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Know what, guys? I've just thought of someone very special, and he's just the person for the job.
lines.translation: Tahu tidak? Aku baru saja memikirkan seseorang yang sangat spesial, dan dia adalah orang yang tepat untuk pekerjaan ini.

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berbincang dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang orang yang kamu kagumi. Dia ingin tahu lebih banyak tentang kepribadian orang tersebut dan apa yang membuatnya istimewa bagimu.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today I'd like to hear about someone you really admire. Can you tell me who that person is and why you chose them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I admire my grandmother. She's 78 and very active.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's wonderful! What makes your grandmother so special to you? What kind of personality does she have?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: She's very positive and cheerful. She always sees the good in people and helps others.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: She sounds like an amazing person! Has she done anything recently that impressed you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, she's just raised money for a children's charity. She did a parachute jump!

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: A parachute jump at 78? That's incredibly brave! You must be very proud of her. What have you learned from her?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: She's taught me that life is for living and to always help other people.

quiz.question: She ___ just ___ back from Papua New Guinea.
quiz.explanation: Present perfect menggunakan 'has/have + past participle'. 'Just' menunjukkan baru saja terjadi, jadi gunakan present perfect: has come.

quiz.question: They haven't made any recordings ___, but they've already attracted lots of interest.
quiz.explanation: 'Yet' digunakan dalam kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan present perfect untuk menunjukkan sesuatu belum terjadi tapi diharapkan akan terjadi.

quiz.question: When did Daniel write his first book? (Choose the correct answer)
options: He has written it when he was five.
He wrote it when he was five.
He writes it when he was five.
quiz.answer: He wrote it when he was five.
quiz.explanation: Karena ada waktu spesifik 'when he was five', kita harus menggunakan past simple, bukan present perfect.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses present perfect correctly?
options: I have visited Greece more than 20 times.
quiz.answer: I have visited Greece more than 20 times.
quiz.explanation: Present perfect tidak menyebutkan waktu spesifik. 'More than 20 times' tidak menyebutkan kapan tepatnya, jadi ini benar.

quiz.question: Which adjective best describes someone who travels to dangerous places? She is extremely ___.
quiz.explanation: 'Brave' berarti berani. Seseorang yang pergi ke tempat berbahaya memerlukan keberanian.

quiz.question: He's really ___ but we all respect him. (Choose the personality adjective that means relaxed)
quiz.explanation: 'Laid-back' berarti santai dan tenang. Ini menggambarkan seseorang yang tidak tegang atau stres.

modules.title: Unit 2: The Ways We Learn
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan present perfect dengan 'for' dan 'since' untuk menyatakan periode waktu, meminta dan memberi izin, serta membicarakan mata pelajaran sekolah dan cara belajar.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas present perfect tense dengan fokus pada penggunaan 'for' dan 'since' untuk menyatakan durasi waktu. Present perfect digunakan untuk menghubungkan masa lalu dengan masa sekarang, terutama ketika membicarakan pengalaman atau situasi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut hingga sekarang.
rules: Present Perfect dengan 'for': Subject + have/has + past participle + for + periode waktu. Contoh: I have studied English for three years.
Present Perfect dengan 'since': Subject + have/has + past participle + since + titik waktu tertentu. Contoh: Children have made fantastic things since the school started.
Penggunaan 'for': Digunakan untuk menyatakan durasi/periode waktu (a month, three years, a long time). Contoh: Tinkering School has been around for many years now.
Penggunaan 'since': Digunakan untuk menyatakan titik waktu kapan suatu kegiatan dimulai (last summer, 2014, Friday). Contoh: I have been at my new school since last December.

Article usage: Gunakan 'a/an' untuk benda tunggal yang tidak spesifik, 'the' untuk benda spesifik yang sudah diketahui, atau tanpa artikel untuk benda jamak/umum. Contoh: You can have an apple or a banana. / The apples in this pie are from our garden.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Membedakan 'For' dan 'Since'
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula bingung kapan menggunakan 'for' dan 'since'. 'For' digunakan untuk durasi (berapa lama), sedangkan 'since' untuk titik waktu (sejak kapan).
commonTrap.wrong: I have lived here since five years.
commonTrap.correct: I have lived here for five years. / I have lived here since 2021.

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan tentang kegiatan belajar dan pengalaman sekolah dengan tutor Mr. Khoirul

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I'd like to know about your school life. Which are your favourite subjects? Which ones don't you like? Why?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I really like English and Drama. I don't like Maths very much because I find it difficult.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's interesting! How long have you studied English? And have you ever performed in a school play?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I have studied English for five years now. Yes, I performed in a school play last year.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Can you tell me about your daily school routine? What time do you usually arrive at school and what activities do you do?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I arrive at school at 7:30. I have classes until 2:00, and sometimes I have extra activities after school.

quiz.question: Children have made fantastic things ______ the school started.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'since' karena 'the school started' adalah titik waktu tertentu di masa lalu, bukan durasi waktu.

quiz.question: Tinkering School has been around ______ many years now.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'for' karena 'many years' adalah periode/durasi waktu.

quiz.question: I ______ (be) at my new school since last December.
quiz.explanation: Present perfect 'have been' digunakan dengan 'since' untuk menyatakan situasi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut.

quiz.question: Can I borrow your bike? - No, sorry. I ______ it.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan present simple 'need' untuk menyatakan kebutuhan saat ini ketika menolak permintaan izin.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses articles correctly?
options: You can have apple or banana.
You can have an apple or a banana.
You can have the apple or the banana.
quiz.answer: You can have an apple or a banana.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'a/an' untuk benda tunggal yang tidak spesifik. 'An' sebelum vokal (apple), 'a' sebelum konsonan (banana).

quiz.question: I have to ______ very carefully about what I'm doing when solving maths problems.
quiz.explanation: 'Concentrate' berarti memusatkan perhatian dengan seksama, yang tepat untuk konteks memecahkan soal matematika.

modules.title: Unit 3: That's Entertainment: Comparatives & Superlatives
modules.objective: Mampu membandingkan benda, orang, atau tindakan menggunakan comparative dan superlative adjectives; menggunakan struktur (not) as...as untuk perbandingan; serta membentuk comparative adverbs untuk memperkuat atau melemahkan perbandingan.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara membandingkan dua atau lebih hal dalam bahasa Inggris. Kamu akan belajar membentuk comparative (lebih...) dan superlative (paling...) dari adjective, menggunakan pola (not) as...as untuk menyatakan kesamaan atau perbedaan, serta membuat comparative adverbs untuk menjelaskan bagaimana suatu tindakan dilakukan dengan lebih baik atau lebih buruk.
rules: Comparative adjectives: Tambahkan -er pada kata sifat pendek (cheap → cheaper), atau gunakan 'more' untuk kata panjang (expensive → more expensive). Contoh: Digital video is cheaper than 35mm film.

Superlative adjectives: Tambahkan -est pada kata sifat pendek (cheap → the cheapest), atau gunakan 'the most' untuk kata panjang (expensive → the most expensive). Contoh: Monsters was one of the best films of the year.
(not) as...as comparatives: Gunakan 'not as + adjective + as' untuk menyatakan perbedaan. Contoh: Extras aren't as expensive as actors.

Making comparisons stronger/weaker: Gunakan 'a lot/much/far' untuk memperkuat, atau 'a little/a bit' untuk melemahkan. Contoh: Independent movies are a lot more interesting. / I had to make it a little shorter.
Comparative adverbs: Bentuk dari adjective dengan menambahkan -ly, lalu tambahkan 'more' di depan. Contoh: carefully → more carefully. Beberapa irregular: fast → faster, good → better, bad → worse.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampur Bentuk Comparative
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula keliru menggunakan 'more' bersama dengan '-er', atau lupa menggunakan 'than' setelah comparative. Ingat: gunakan salah satu bentuk saja, dan selalu tambahkan 'than' saat membandingkan dua hal.
commonTrap.wrong: This film is more cheaper than that one.
commonTrap.correct: This film is cheaper than that one.

vocab.collocation: We're used to hearing about really expensive Hollywood films.
Do you need millions of dollars to make a successful movie?
Monsters had a budget of more than $250 million.
The final film looks nearly as professional as big, fancy Hollywood productions.
The contestants can win £10,000 in the game show.

Extras are the people who stand around and do things but don't say anything.

dialogue.context: Megan dan teman-temannya membicarakan rencana syuting film di taman. Megan sangat bersemangat karena aktor favoritnya, Gregory Harris, akan berada di lokasi syuting.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Guys, guys! Guess what! They're going to make a film here.
lines.translation: Teman-teman! Coba tebak! Mereka akan membuat film di sini.

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: We have. They're going to do some filming in the park. For a new sci-fi movie. And Megan's really excited.
lines.translation: Kami sudah tahu. Mereka akan melakukan syuting di taman. Untuk film sci-fi baru. Dan Megan sangat bersemangat.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: I really am. Gregory Harris is in the film. He's so cool. In fact, I think he's my favourite actor of all time!
lines.translation: Aku benar-benar bersemangat. Gregory Harris ada di film itu. Dia sangat keren. Bahkan, kurasa dia aktor favoritku sepanjang masa!

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Don't get too excited, Megan. You're not going to meet him. Or even see him, probably.
lines.translation: Jangan terlalu bersemangat, Megan. Kamu tidak akan bertemu dengannya. Atau bahkan melihatnya, mungkin.

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: Don't be so sure, Luke. The thing is, they want extras for the film.
lines.translation: Jangan begitu yakin, Luke. Masalahnya, mereka butuh figuran untuk film itu.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Extras? You know – the people who stand around and do things but don't say anything.
lines.translation: Figuran? Kamu tahu – orang-orang yang berdiri di sekitar dan melakukan sesuatu tapi tidak bicara apa-apa.

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang jenis film dan acara TV favoritmu. Ia ingin tahu pendapatmu dan membandingkan preferensimu.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Let's talk about entertainment today. What kind of films do you like? Do you prefer action films or animated films?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I prefer animated films because they are more interesting and fun.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's great! Now, what about TV programmes? Which do you think is more exciting – a game show or a sports programme?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think game shows are more exciting than sports programmes because they are more fun to watch.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! One more question: Do you think expensive films are always better than cheaper films?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: No, I don't think expensive films are always better. Sometimes cheaper films are more creative and interesting.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Well done! You're using comparatives very well. Keep practicing and you'll get even better at expressing your opinions!

quiz.question: Digital video is _______ than 35mm film.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'cheap' adalah adjective pendek (satu suku kata), jadi bentuk comparative-nya adalah 'cheaper' dengan menambahkan -er.

quiz.question: Moviefone thought Monsters was one of the _______ films of the year.
quiz.explanation: Superlative dari 'good' adalah 'best' (bentuk irregular). Digunakan untuk membandingkan dengan semua film lain di tahun itu.

quiz.question: Extras aren't _______ expensive _______ actors.
quiz.explanation: Pola (not) as...as digunakan untuk menyatakan bahwa dua hal tidak sama. 'Extras aren't as expensive as actors' berarti extras lebih murah.

quiz.question: She should think _______ carefully than her sister did.
quiz.explanation: Comparative adverb dibentuk dengan 'more + adverb'. 'More carefully' berarti 'lebih hati-hati'.

quiz.question: Independent movies are _______ more interesting than Hollywood blockbusters.
quiz.explanation: Untuk memperkuat comparative, gunakan 'a lot', 'much', atau 'far' sebelum 'more'. 'Very' dan 'too' tidak digunakan dengan comparative.

quiz.question: The final script was a little _______ than the first version.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'little' digunakan untuk melemahkan comparative. Bentuk comparative dari 'short' adalah 'shorter'.

modules.title: Unit 4: Social Networking
modules.objective: Mampu memberikan saran (giving advice) menggunakan should, had better, ought to, serta memahami penggunaan indefinite pronouns (everyone, no one, someone, dll.) dalam konteks media sosial dan keamanan online.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara memberikan nasihat dalam bahasa Inggris menggunakan modal verbs seperti should, had better, dan ought to. Selain itu, kamu akan mempelajari indefinite pronouns (kata ganti tak tentu) seperti everyone, someone, anyone, no one, nothing, everything yang sering digunakan dalam percakapan sehari-hari terutama terkait media sosial dan keamanan online.
rules: Should + verb (infinitive): digunakan untuk memberikan saran atau nasihat. Contoh: You should think before you post something online.
Had better + verb (infinitive): memberikan saran yang lebih kuat, biasanya ada konsekuensi negatif jika tidak diikuti. Contoh: You'd better not share your password with anyone.
Ought to + verb (infinitive): memiliki makna serupa dengan should, tapi lebih formal. Contoh: You ought to get him a nice present this year.
Indefinite pronouns dengan -one/-body (everyone, someone, anyone, no one): merujuk pada orang. Contoh: Everyone knows that I love music.
Indefinite pronouns dengan -thing (everything, something, anything, nothing): merujuk pada benda/hal. Contoh: I don't like eating anything that has got meat in it.

All / some / none / any + of them: digunakan untuk merujuk kembali ke kelompok (benda atau orang) yang sudah disebutkan. Contoh: There were 500 people at the party, and some of them were smashing windows.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menggunakan 'to' setelah should dan had better
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula salah menambahkan 'to' setelah should dan had better karena terpengaruh oleh ought to. Padahal should dan had better langsung diikuti verb bentuk dasar (infinitive tanpa to).
commonTrap.wrong: You should to think before posting. / You'd better to change your password.
commonTrap.correct: You should think before posting. / You'd better change your password.

vocab.collocation: His boss apologised for giving James work that wasn't very interesting.
Cathy's birthday party ended in disaster because her parents went out that evening.
I constantly check for updates on social media.
I sometimes post comments that I regret later.
You need to attach a file to add a photo to an email.
What you should know about uploading photos on social networks.
Don't share your passwords with anyone.
Make sure you log out properly when you want to leave a site.

dialogue.context: Hannah dan ayahnya sedang membicarakan masalah Hannah menghabiskan terlalu banyak waktu bermain game komputer. Ayahnya mencoba memberi nasihat tentang pentingnya membuat username dan mengatur waktu dengan lebih baik.

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.text: Hannah, you spend too much time playing computer games.
lines.translation: Hannah, kamu menghabiskan terlalu banyak waktu bermain game komputer.

lines.speaker: Hannah
lines.text: But I love gaming! It's so much fun.
lines.translation: Tapi aku suka main game! Sangat menyenangkan.

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.text: I understand, but you should create your own username and password first.
lines.translation: Aku paham, tapi kamu sebaiknya buat username dan password sendiri dulu.

lines.speaker: Hannah
lines.text: Why do I need to do that?
lines.translation: Kenapa aku harus melakukan itu?

lines.speaker: Dad
lines.text: You ought to be more careful online. And you'd better choose a team when it asks you.
lines.translation: Kamu seharusnya lebih hati-hati saat online. Dan kamu sebaiknya pilih tim saat diminta.

lines.speaker: Hannah
lines.text: OK, I'll do it properly this time.
lines.translation: Baiklah, aku akan melakukannya dengan benar kali ini.

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berbincang dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang kebiasaanmu menggunakan media sosial dan keamanan online. Ia ingin tahu seberapa sering kamu posting, apa yang kamu bagikan, dan bagaimana kamu menjaga keamanan akunmu.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hi! How often do you post something on social media?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I don't post very often, maybe once or twice a week. I prefer reading other people's posts.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's good! What kind of things do you usually post when you do share something?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I usually post photos from trips or interesting things I see. Sometimes I share funny videos too.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Nice! Now, do you think it's important to keep your passwords secure? What ways do you use to remember them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, definitely! I write them down in a private notebook and I never share them with anyone.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Last question - if your friend wanted to post something when they're angry, what advice would you give them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'd tell them they should wait and think carefully before posting. They might regret it later.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: You _____ think before you post something online.
quiz.explanation: Should diikuti langsung oleh verb bentuk dasar (infinitive tanpa to). Jadi pilihan yang tepat adalah 'should', bukan 'should to'.

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: You'd better not share your password.
You'd better to not share your password.
You'd better not sharing your password.
quiz.answer: You'd better not share your password.
quiz.explanation: Had better diikuti langsung oleh verb bentuk dasar. Untuk bentuk negatif, gunakan 'had better not + verb'.

quiz.question: Choose the correct word: _____ knows that I love social media.
quiz.explanation: Everyone digunakan untuk merujuk pada semua orang. Everything merujuk pada semua benda/hal, dan everywhere merujuk pada semua tempat.

quiz.question: Complete: There were 32 students in the class, and _____ of them like music.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'all / some / none / any + of them' untuk merujuk kembali ke kelompok yang sudah disebutkan. Dalam konteks ini, 'all of them' adalah pilihan yang tepat.

quiz.question: What does 'You ought to get him a present' mean?
options: You should get him a present (it's a good idea)
You must get him a present (it's an obligation)
You will get him a present (it's a fact)
quiz.answer: You should get him a present (it's a good idea)
quiz.explanation: Ought to memiliki makna yang sama dengan should, yaitu memberikan saran atau nasihat, bukan kewajiban atau fakta.

quiz.question: Which sentence gives the strongest advice?
options: You should log out when you finish.
You'd better log out when you finish.
You ought to log out when you finish.
quiz.answer: You'd better log out when you finish.
quiz.explanation: Had better memberikan saran yang lebih kuat daripada should atau ought to, biasanya ada konsekuensi negatif jika tidak diikuti.

modules.title: Unit 5: My Life in Music: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan Present Perfect Continuous untuk menjelaskan aktivitas yang sedang berlangsung dalam periode waktu tertentu, serta membedakan penggunaan Present Perfect Simple vs Past Simple dalam konteks musik dan kehidupan sehari-hari.

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan perbedaan antara Present Perfect Simple (I have played) untuk menekankan hasil akhir, Present Perfect Continuous (I have been playing) untuk menekankan durasi atau proses yang masih berlangsung, dan Past Simple (I played) untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai di waktu tertentu di masa lalu. Konteks musik membantu siswa memahami kapan menggunakan tense yang tepat saat berbicara tentang pengalaman hidup mereka.
rules: Present Perfect Continuous: have/has + been + verb-ing — untuk aktivitas yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung atau baru saja selesai. Contoh: I've been learning the piano for two years.
Present Perfect Simple: have/has + past participle — untuk menekankan hasil akhir atau pengalaman tanpa fokus pada durasi. Contoh: I've played the piano since I was eight.
Past Simple: verb (past tense) — untuk kejadian yang selesai di waktu tertentu di masa lalu. Contoh: He released his first record in 1972.
Gunakan 'for' untuk durasi waktu (for two years) dan 'since' untuk titik waktu mulai (since 10 am).

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampur Present Perfect dengan Past Simple
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula salah menggunakan Past Simple ketika seharusnya menggunakan Present Perfect Continuous untuk aktivitas yang masih relevan dengan sekarang, atau sebaliknya menggunakan Present Perfect untuk kejadian dengan waktu spesifik di masa lalu.
commonTrap.wrong: I play guitar since I was 10. / I have been to the concert yesterday.
commonTrap.correct: I've been playing guitar since I was 10. / I went to the concert yesterday.

vocab.meaning: mengamen (bermain musik di jalanan untuk uang)

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang pengalaman musikmu dan band favoritmu. Ini adalah kesempatan untuk berlatih menggunakan Present Perfect dan Past Simple dengan percaya diri.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul

turns.speaker: You

quiz.question: I _____ (write) songs since I was a teenager.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan Present Perfect Continuous karena aktivitas menulis lagu dimulai di masa lalu dan masih relevan sampai sekarang. 'Since' menunjukkan titik waktu mulai.

quiz.question: John Otway _____ his first record in 1972.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan Past Simple karena ada tahun spesifik (1972) yang menunjukkan kejadian sudah selesai di masa lalu.

quiz.question: We _____ (do) a lot of busking in the streets lately.
quiz.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous digunakan karena 'lately' menunjukkan aktivitas yang berlangsung dalam periode waktu hingga sekarang.

quiz.question: He's been _____ / _____ on the phone all morning.
quiz.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous menggunakan 'been + verb-ing' (talking). Alternatif kedua adalah Past Simple dengan 'talked', namun konteks 'all morning' lebih cocok dengan continuous form.

quiz.question: How long _____ you _____ playing the drums?
quiz.explanation: 'How long' dengan Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + verb-ing) digunakan untuk menanyakan durasi aktivitas yang masih berlangsung atau baru selesai.

quiz.question: Justin Bieber _____ second in a singing competition when he was 12.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan Past Simple karena ada usia spesifik 'when he was 12' yang menunjukkan waktu pasti di masa lalu.

modules.title: Unit 6: Making a Difference: Future Forms - Will, Going to, Present Continuous
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan will (not), may (not), dan might (not) untuk prediksi; menggunakan first conditional dan unless dalam kalimat kondisional pertama; serta memahami kosakata lingkungan dan energi

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara menyatakan prediksi masa depan dengan will, won't, may, may not, might, dan might not. Will digunakan untuk kepastian di masa depan, sedangkan may dan might untuk kemungkinan. Selain itu, kamu akan belajar first conditional (if + present simple, will/won't + verb) untuk membicarakan konsekuensi aksi yang mungkin terjadi, dan penggunaan unless yang berarti 'only if / if not'.
rules: Will / Won't untuk kepastian masa depan: 'In a few years' time, there won't be any tigers left.'
May (not) / Might (not) untuk kemungkinan: 'Some animals may be gone forever very soon.'
First Conditional (If + present simple, will/won't + main verb): 'If we lose the forests, we will lose millions of species.'
Unless dalam first conditional berarti 'only if / if not': 'Unless people stop throwing plastic away, the environment will suffer even more.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampurkan Will dan Might
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering bingung kapan memakai will dan kapan memakai might/may. Will digunakan saat kamu yakin sesuatu akan terjadi, sedangkan might/may untuk hal yang mungkin terjadi tapi belum pasti.
commonTrap.wrong: I will pick you up at 7, but I'm not sure yet.
commonTrap.correct: I might pick you up at 7, but I'm not sure yet.

vocab.collocation: Black rhinos are far more endangered than tigers.

Some rivers polluted, air pollution from factories.

speakingLab.context: Latihan percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang lingkungan dan rencana masa depan

quiz.question: Complete: In a few years' time, there _____ any tigers left.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'won't be' untuk menyatakan prediksi yang sangat mungkin atau kepastian negatif di masa depan.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: If we lose the forests, we will lose millions of species.
If we will lose the forests, we lose millions of species.
If we lose the forests, we lose millions of species.
quiz.answer: If we lose the forests, we will lose millions of species.
quiz.explanation: First conditional menggunakan pola: If + present simple, will/won't + verb.

quiz.question: Complete: She _____ feeling well at all. She might not have to stay at home.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat pertama menyatakan fakta sekarang, jadi gunakan present simple 'is not'. 'Might not' untuk kemungkinan di masa depan.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses 'unless' correctly?
options: Unless people stop throwing plastic away, the environment will suffer.
Unless people will stop throwing plastic away, the environment suffers.
Unless people stop throwing plastic away, the environment suffer.
quiz.answer: Unless people stop throwing plastic away, the environment will suffer.
quiz.explanation: 'Unless' berarti 'if not' dan menggunakan pola first conditional: unless + present simple, will + verb.

quiz.question: Complete: The weather's a real problem. We _____ be able to go for a walk.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'may not' atau 'might not' untuk kemungkinan negatif yang tidak pasti.

quiz.question: Choose the correct response to express enthusiasm:
quiz.explanation: Untuk mengekspresikan antusiasme atau kejutan positif, gunakan frasa seperti 'That sounds wonderful!', 'How exciting!', atau 'What a brilliant idea!'

modules.title: Unit 7: Future Fun: First Conditional with If, When & Unless
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan berbagai bentuk future tense (present simple, be going to, will/won't, present continuous) untuk menyatakan jadwal tetap, rencana, prediksi, dan kesepakatan; memahami penggunaan question tags, nor/neither/so; serta mampu mengatur acara dan bernegosiasi dalam bahasa Inggris.

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan empat cara berbeda untuk membicarakan masa depan dalam bahasa Inggris. Kamu akan belajar kapan menggunakan present simple untuk jadwal tetap, be going to untuk rencana dan niat, will/won't untuk prediksi spontan, dan present continuous untuk kesepakatan yang sudah dibuat. Selain itu, kamu juga akan mempelajari question tags untuk mengecek informasi dan cara menyetujui pernyataan menggunakan so/neither.
rules: Present Simple untuk kejadian masa depan yang sudah terjadwal atau pasti: 'The film opens on Friday.' / 'The match starts at 3 pm.'
Be going to untuk rencana dan niat yang sudah dipikirkan: 'I'm going to start training for Lima 2044.' / 'They're going to buy a new car.'
Will/Won't untuk prediksi tentang masa depan: 'She won't do very well in her exams.' / 'One day we'll all live under the sea.'
Present Continuous untuk pengaturan atau kesepakatan yang sudah dibuat: 'I'm having a party. Lots of people are coming.' / 'They're having a party on Tuesday.'
Question tags: pernyataan positif + tag negatif / pernyataan negatif + tag positif. Contoh: 'You wanted me to do that, didn't you?' / 'The party is open to everyone, isn't it?'
So/Neither untuk menyetujui: 'So' untuk pernyataan positif ('I love school.' - 'So do I.'), 'Neither' untuk pernyataan negatif ('I can't go.' - 'Neither can I.')

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampur Will dengan Be Going To
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula menggunakan 'will' untuk semua situasi masa depan. Padahal 'will' digunakan untuk prediksi atau keputusan spontan, sedangkan 'be going to' untuk rencana yang sudah dipikirkan sebelumnya.
commonTrap.wrong: I will go to the cinema tomorrow. (padahal sudah merencanakan sejak kemarin)
commonTrap.correct: I'm going to go to the cinema tomorrow. (untuk rencana yang sudah dibuat)

vocab.collocation: You are arranging a party for your birthday.
The project has been delayed for three years.
They are spending a three-day honeymoon there.
We use will/won't to make predictions about the future.
We use be going to to talk about future plans and intentions.
We use the present continuous to talk about future arrangements.
I checked the forecast and there will be no rain.
What do you reckon, Ryan?

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara empat teman sekolah (Luke, Olivia, Ryan, dan Megan) yang sedang membicarakan rencana akhir pekan mereka di taman sekolah pada hari Jumat pagi.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Friday morning. I can't wait for the weekend.

lines.speaker: Olivia

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berbicara dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang rencana masa depanmu. Dia ingin tahu apa yang akan kamu lakukan akhir pekan ini dan rencana jangka panjangmu.

quiz.question: The concert _____ at 8 pm on Saturday. (pilih bentuk yang tepat untuk jadwal tetap)
quiz.explanation: Untuk jadwal atau acara yang sudah pasti dan tidak berubah, kita menggunakan present simple. 'The concert starts at 8 pm' menunjukkan waktu yang sudah dijadwalkan.

quiz.question: I _____ to buy a new phone next week. I've been saving money for months. (pilih bentuk untuk rencana yang sudah dipikirkan)
quiz.explanation: Kita menggunakan 'be going to' untuk rencana atau niat yang sudah dipikirkan sebelumnya. Dalam kalimat ini, orang tersebut sudah menabung berbulan-bulan, jadi ini adalah rencana yang matang.

quiz.question: You haven't finished your homework, _____?
quiz.explanation: Question tag untuk pernyataan negatif (haven't) menggunakan bentuk positif (have you). Kita menggunakan auxiliary verb yang sama dengan pernyataan utama.

quiz.question: 'I can't go to the party tonight.' - '_____' (pilih respons yang tepat untuk menyetujui pernyataan negatif)
quiz.explanation: Untuk menyetujui pernyataan negatif, kita menggunakan 'neither' + auxiliary verb. Karena pernyataan menggunakan 'can't', maka responnya adalah 'Neither can I'.

quiz.question: Look at those dark clouds! It _____ rain soon. (pilih bentuk untuk prediksi berdasarkan bukti yang terlihat)
quiz.explanation: Kita menggunakan 'be going to' untuk prediksi berdasarkan bukti yang kita lihat sekarang. Awan gelap adalah bukti bahwa hujan akan segera turun.

quiz.question: We _____ dinner with our friends tomorrow evening. We booked the restaurant yesterday. (pilih bentuk untuk kesepakatan yang sudah dibuat)
quiz.explanation: Present continuous digunakan untuk pengaturan atau kesepakatan yang sudah dibuat. Mereka sudah memesan restoran, jadi ini adalah arrangement yang pasti.

modules.title: Unit 8: Science Counts: Modals of Ability & Obligation
modules.objective: Mampu berbicara tentang kebiasaan masa lalu, menggunakan 'used to', second conditional (I wish), serta memahami perbedaan past simple vs. past continuous dalam konteks penemuan ilmiah dan kehidupan sehari-hari

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara menyatakan kebiasaan di masa lampau dengan 'used to', membayangkan situasi yang berbeda dengan second conditional, dan membedakan past simple dengan past continuous. Dalam konteks sains, kita belajar bagaimana para ilmuwan menemukan hal-hal penting dan bagaimana penemuan tersebut mengubah kehidupan kita.
rules: Used to + verb: untuk menyatakan kebiasaan atau keadaan di masa lalu yang tidak terjadi lagi sekarang. Contoh: 'I used to think that there was a person inside the post box.' / 'People used to read in the evening before they had television.'
Didn't use to + verb: untuk bentuk negatif. Contoh: 'I didn't use to eat the seeds.' / 'He didn't use to be scared of wires.'
Past Simple: untuk aksi yang terjadi pada saat tertentu di masa lalu. Contoh: 'Newton was sitting when an apple fell.'
Past Continuous: untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu atau untuk menggambarkan latar belakang situasi. Contoh: 'While Benjamin Franklin was watching a thunderstorm, he got some ideas.'

Second Conditional: if + past simple, would + verb (untuk situasi yang tidak nyata atau imajiner). Contoh: 'If they found a cure for malaria, life would be easier.' / 'I wish I could go back to when I was a kid.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menggunakan 'use to' tanpa 'didn't'
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula keliru saat membuat kalimat negatif dengan 'used to'. Mereka sering menulis 'I didn't used to' padahal seharusnya 'I didn't use to' (tanpa 'd' pada 'use' karena 'did' sudah menunjukkan past tense).
commonTrap.wrong: I didn't used to like science when I was younger.
commonTrap.correct: I didn't use to like science when I was younger.

vocab.meaning: penemuan (sesuatu yang sudah ada namun baru diketahui)
vocab.collocation: Electricity and fire are discoveries.
The smartphone is an invention that changed our lives.

vocab.meaning: ilmuwan, orang yang bekerja di bidang sains
vocab.collocation: Newton was a famous scientist who discovered gravity.
We did an experiment at school when a fire started.
His best-known achievement was to show that the Earth moves around the sun.
Scientists work in a laboratory to do research.
They found a cure for malaria.
Pasteur developed a way to prevent diseases from spreading.

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang kebiasaan masa kecilmu dan bagaimana kehidupan berbeda dengan sekarang

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today let's talk about when you were younger. What are some things you used to do or believe?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: When I was little, I used to think that cartoons were real people.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a wonderful answer! Well done using 'used to' and 'I wish' correctly. Keep practicing!

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses 'used to' in the negative form?
options: I didn't used to like science.
I didn't use to like science.
I don't used to like science.
quiz.answer: I didn't use to like science.
quiz.explanation: Dalam bentuk negatif, kita menggunakan 'didn't use to' (bukan 'didn't used to') karena 'did' sudah menunjukkan past tense.

quiz.question: Complete: 'Before people had electricity, they _____ cook with fire.'
quiz.explanation: 'Used to' digunakan untuk menyatakan kebiasaan di masa lalu yang tidak lagi terjadi sekarang.

quiz.question: Which is the correct second conditional sentence?
options: If I find a cure, life will be easier.
If they found a cure for malaria, life would be easier.
If they find a cure, life would be easier.
quiz.answer: If they found a cure for malaria, life would be easier.
quiz.explanation: Second conditional menggunakan pola: if + past simple, would + verb untuk situasi imajiner atau tidak nyata.

quiz.question: Choose the correct form: 'While Benjamin Franklin _____ (watch) a thunderstorm, he got some ideas.'
quiz.explanation: Past continuous (was watching) digunakan untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu ketika aksi lain terjadi.

quiz.question: What is the difference between 'discovery' and 'invention'?
options: They mean exactly the same thing.
Discovery is finding something that already exists; invention is creating something new.
Discovery is for science; invention is for technology only.
quiz.answer: Discovery is finding something that already exists; invention is creating something new.
quiz.explanation: Discovery adalah menemukan sesuatu yang sudah ada (seperti gravitasi), sedangkan invention adalah menciptakan sesuatu yang baru (seperti smartphone).

quiz.question: Complete with 'I wish': 'The bus isn't here. I wish the bus _____ here.'
quiz.explanation: 'I wish' diikuti oleh past simple untuk menyatakan keinginan tentang situasi sekarang yang berbeda dari kenyataan.

modules.title: Unit 9: What a Job!: Second Conditional & Work Vocabulary
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan passive voice (present simple, past simple, present continuous, present perfect) untuk menggambarkan aksi yang menekankan objek, serta menguasai kosakata pekerjaan dan ekspresi waktu menggunakan 'in'.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas penggunaan passive voice dalam berbagai bentuk waktu (present simple, past simple, present continuous, present perfect). Passive voice digunakan ketika kita tidak tahu atau tidak ingin menyebutkan siapa yang melakukan aksi, atau ketika fokus pada objek yang dikenai aksi. Selain itu, unit ini juga membahas perbedaan penggunaan 'work' (kata kerja/kata benda tak terhitung) dan 'job' (kata benda terhitung), serta penggunaan preposisi 'work as/in/for'.
rules: Passive Voice dibentuk dengan: to be + past participle. Contoh: The sweets are made in the factory. (Present Simple Passive)
Past Simple Passive: was/were + past participle. Contoh: Ben was paid $111,000 for six months' work.
Present Continuous Passive: is/are being + past participle. Contoh: Many jobs are being replaced by machines.
Present Perfect Passive: has/have been + past participle. Contoh: The Internet has been used by people all over the world for 30 years.
'Work' sebagai kata benda tidak bisa dijadikan plural (uncountable). Contoh: I have a lot of work to do.
'Job' adalah countable noun dan bisa dijadikan plural. Contoh: She did four jobs before she became a travel agent.
Work as = bekerja sebagai (profesi). Contoh: There were men who worked as lamplighters.
Work for = bekerja untuk (perusahaan/organisasi). Contoh: Harry Willsher works for Swizell's.
Work in = bekerja di (bidang/industri). Contoh: Marina Stuart got an offer to work in television.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Passive Voice dengan Subject yang Salah
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula lupa bahwa dalam passive voice, subject kalimat adalah objek yang dikenai aksi, bukan pelaku aksi. Selain itu, kesalahan umum lain adalah menggunakan 'work' sebagai countable noun.
commonTrap.wrong: The factory makes the sweets. → The factory is made the sweets. / I have four works to finish.
commonTrap.correct: The factory makes the sweets. → The sweets are made in the factory. / I have four jobs to finish. OR I have a lot of work to do.

vocab.collocation: I did it when I first left school, just to earn money.
I had to remember the customers' orders, but that was all, really. It wasn't very challenging.
I didn't get paid holidays, so that wasn't good.
So after about five months I gave in my notice and got a job as a shop assistant.
After a few months I was promoted to store manager.
I was happy because I was starting a career — well, I thought I was. I got on-the-job training about management and things.
The pay is fantastic and the work is quite interesting. I guess you can say I'm successful.
In the past, there were many jobs that now no longer exist. These are called obsolete jobs.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara Ryan, Olivia, Luke, dan Megan yang sedang merencanakan kegiatan amal untuk mengumpulkan dana bagi taman bermain anak-anak.

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: Hi, Olivia. What happened to you yesterday?
lines.translation: Hai, Olivia. Apa yang terjadi padamu kemarin?

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: Oh, I just didn't feel very good. I'm all right now though. By the way, here's your book back, Ryan.
lines.translation: Oh, aku hanya tidak enak badan. Tapi sekarang sudah baikan. Ngomong-ngomong, ini bukumu, Ryan.

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: Oh, thanks. Well, you missed the new headmistress's announcement yesterday.
lines.translation: Oh, terima kasih. Kamu ketinggalan pengumuman kepala sekolah baru kemarin.

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: Oh? What about?
lines.translation: Oh? Tentang apa?

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: We've been asked to do something for charity. Miss Dawes wants to raise money for the playground in the park. They really need some new things.
lines.translation: Kita diminta melakukan sesuatu untuk amal. Bu Dawes ingin mengumpulkan uang untuk taman bermain di taman. Mereka sangat butuh beberapa peralatan baru.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: We thought the four of us could do something together. Want to join us, Olivia?
lines.translation: Kami pikir kita berempat bisa melakukan sesuatu bersama. Mau ikut, Olivia?

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: Well, yes, that'd be great. As long as we can have some fun too!
lines.translation: Ya, itu bagus. Asal kita juga bisa bersenang-senang!

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: That's not the point, Olivia. It's not about fun. It's about raising money for a good cause.
lines.translation: Bukan itu intinya, Olivia. Ini bukan soal bersenang-senang. Ini tentang mengumpulkan uang untuk tujuan baik.

speakingLab.context: Latihan percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang pekerjaan impian dan nilai-nilai penting dalam pekerjaan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about jobs and careers. Let me start with a question: What kind of job would you like to have in the future?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would like to work as a teacher because I enjoy helping people learn new things.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's wonderful! Teaching is a very rewarding career. Now, what values are most important to you in a job? For example, is it the money, helping people, creativity, or free time?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think helping people is the most important value for me. I'd rather be a teacher than a banker because it's more meaningful.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent answer! It's great that you know what matters to you. One more question: do you think some jobs will become obsolete in the future? Which ones?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I think there won't be any cleaners when I'm older. Machines and robots will do that job.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Very interesting prediction! You're thinking about how technology changes the world of work. Well done today!

quiz.question: Complete the sentence with the correct passive form: The sweets ________ in the company's factory.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan present simple passive: are/is + past participle. 'Sweets' adalah plural, jadi gunakan 'are made'.

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: I have four works to finish today.
I have four jobs to finish today.
I have many work to do.
She has two works in the city.
quiz.answer: I have four jobs to finish today.
quiz.explanation: 'Job' adalah countable noun dan bisa dijadikan plural. 'Work' sebagai kata benda adalah uncountable dan tidak bisa menggunakan 'four works'.

quiz.question: Complete: Harry Willsher works ________ Swizell's company.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'work for' ketika menyebutkan nama perusahaan atau organisasi tempat seseorang bekerja.

quiz.question: Change to passive voice: 'Ben showed that he was good at blogging.' → Ben showed that he was good at blogging, so _________.
options: he was asked lots of questions
they asked him lots of questions
quiz.answer: he was asked lots of questions
quiz.explanation: Passive voice untuk past simple: was/were + past participle. Fokus pada Ben yang menerima aksi (ditanya), bukan yang bertanya.

quiz.question: Complete: Marina Stuart got an offer to work ________ television.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'work in' ketika menyebutkan bidang atau industri, seperti 'in television', 'in education', 'in the computer industry'.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses present perfect passive correctly?
options: For the last 30 years, the Internet has been used by people all over the world.
For the last 30 years, the Internet is used by people all over the world.
For the last 30 years, the Internet was used by people all over the world.
For the last 30 years, the Internet uses by people all over the world.
quiz.answer: For the last 30 years, the Internet has been used by people all over the world.
quiz.explanation: Present perfect passive dibentuk dengan: has/have been + past participle. Digunakan untuk aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan berlanjut hingga sekarang.

modules.title: Unit 10: Keep Healthy: Past Perfect & Health Vocabulary
modules.objective: Mampu memahami dan menggunakan Past Perfect Simple dan Past Perfect Continuous untuk menceritakan pengalaman masa lalu, serta menguasai kosakata kesehatan dan ekspresi waktu (time linkers) dalam konteks berbicara tentang kesehatan.

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan dua bentuk Past Perfect: Simple dan Continuous. Past Perfect Simple digunakan untuk menceritakan kejadian yang terjadi sebelum kejadian lain di masa lalu. Past Perfect Continuous digunakan untuk menceritakan aksi yang berlangsung dalam periode waktu tertentu di masa lalu. Unit ini juga mencakup kosakata kesehatan (illness collocations) dan time linkers (when, as soon as, then, until, while) untuk menghubungkan peristiwa.
rules: Past Perfect Simple: had + past participle. Contoh: She had returned from Alaska when her doctors told her that she had cancer. (Kejadian 'returned' terjadi sebelum 'told')
Past Perfect Continuous: had been + verb-ing. Contoh: They had been waiting for this moment for years. (Aksi 'waiting' berlangsung dalam periode waktu sebelum momen tertentu)

Time linkers menghubungkan urutan peristiwa: when (ketika), as soon as (segera setelah), then (kemudian), until (sampai), while (sementara). Contoh: When I finished the book, I went out and bought binoculars.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Urutan Waktu yang Salah
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering keliru menggunakan Past Perfect ketika tidak ada hubungan 'sebelum-sesudah' yang jelas antara dua kejadian. Past Perfect hanya digunakan jika satu kejadian terjadi sebelum kejadian lain di masa lalu.
commonTrap.wrong: I had eaten breakfast this morning. (tidak ada kejadian kedua sebagai acuan)
commonTrap.correct: I had already eaten breakfast when she called me. (ada dua kejadian dengan urutan jelas: makan sarapan terjadi sebelum dia menelepon)

vocab.collocation: Her doctor gave her medication and she got better immediately.
If you have a problem with your eyes, make an appointment with a specialist soon!

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara dua teman yang mendiskusikan pengalaman sakit di masa lalu dan bagaimana mereka pulih.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: I felt really sick last week after I had eaten some seafood.
lines.translation: Aku merasa sangat mual minggu lalu setelah aku makan seafood.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Oh no! What did you do? Did you see a doctor?
lines.translation: Oh tidak! Apa yang kamu lakukan? Apakah kamu periksa ke dokter?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Yes, I made an appointment immediately. The doctor gave me medication.
lines.translation: Ya, aku langsung membuat janji temu. Dokter memberi aku obat.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Did the medication help? Are you feeling better now?
lines.translation: Apakah obatnya membantu? Apakah kamu merasa lebih baik sekarang?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: Yes, I got better after a few days. I had been feeling sick all night before I went to the doctor.
lines.translation: Ya, aku membaik setelah beberapa hari. Aku sudah merasa mual sepanjang malam sebelum aku pergi ke dokter.

speakingLab.context: Simulasi percakapan dengan tutor AI tentang pengalaman kesehatan dan kebiasaan sehat siswa

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about health. Have you ever felt sick after eating something? What happened?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I felt sick after I had eaten too much spicy food last month.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. That must have been uncomfortable. What did you do to get better? Did you take any medication or see a doctor?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I didn't see a doctor. I just rested at home and drank a lot of water. I got better after two days.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's good to hear. Now, what do you usually do to stay fit and healthy? Do you exercise regularly?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I try to exercise three times a week. I also eat fruit every day to strengthen my immune system.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent habits! Those are really good for your health. Keep it up!

quiz.question: Which sentence uses Past Perfect Simple correctly?
options: She had returned from Alaska when her doctors told her the news.
She has returned from Alaska when her doctors told her the news.
She returned from Alaska when her doctors had told her the news.
quiz.answer: She had returned from Alaska when her doctors told her the news.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Simple (had returned) digunakan untuk kejadian yang terjadi sebelum kejadian lain di masa lalu (told). Kejadian 'kembali dari Alaska' terjadi sebelum 'dokter memberi tahu berita'.

quiz.question: Complete: They ________ for this moment for years before the operation happened.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous (had been waiting) digunakan untuk aksi yang berlangsung dalam periode waktu (for years) sebelum momen tertentu di masa lalu (the operation).

quiz.question: Which collocation is correct?
quiz.explanation: Kolokasi yang tepat dalam bahasa Inggris adalah 'take medication' (minum/mengonsumsi obat), bukan 'do' atau 'have' medication.

quiz.question: Choose the correct time linker: I never really liked birdwatching ________ I read the book.
quiz.explanation: 'Until' (sampai) menunjukkan bahwa situasi 'tidak suka birdwatching' berlangsung sampai kejadian 'membaca buku' terjadi. Setelah membaca buku, situasinya berubah.

quiz.question: What does 'get better' mean in: When you have a cold, what do you do to get better?
quiz.explanation: Dalam konteks kesehatan, 'get better' berarti pulih atau sembuh dari penyakit (recover from illness).

quiz.question: Which sentence shows Past Perfect Continuous correctly?
options: Jack suffered from a serious illness since he was born.
Jack had been suffering from a serious illness since he was born.
Jack has been suffering from a serious illness since he was born.
quiz.answer: Jack had been suffering from a serious illness since he was born.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous (had been suffering) digunakan untuk aksi yang berlangsung dalam periode waktu di masa lalu (since he was born). Konteks cerita menunjukkan ini adalah masa lalu, bukan present perfect.

modules.title: Unit 11: Making the News: Passive Voice - Present & Past Simple
modules.objective: Mampu melaporkan perkataan orang lain menggunakan reported speech, memahami perbedaan tenses dalam pelaporan, serta menggunakan verb patterns dengan object + infinitive dalam konteks berita dan jurnalistik.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara melaporkan pernyataan orang lain (reported speech/reported statements) dan penggunaan verb patterns dengan object + infinitive. Ketika kita melaporkan apa yang orang katakan, kita sering mengubah tenses kata kerja: present simple menjadi past simple, present continuous menjadi past continuous, dan seterusnya. Selain itu, beberapa kata kerja seperti ask, want, tell diikuti oleh object (kata benda atau kata ganti) dan infinitive.
rules: Reported Speech - Perubahan Tenses: present simple → past simple (contoh: 'I work hard' → He said that he worked hard), present continuous → past continuous, can → could, will → would
Verb + say/tell: Gunakan 'say' tanpa object, gunakan 'tell' dengan object (contoh: He told me that... / He said that...)

Verb patterns (object + infinitive): Beberapa kata kerja diikuti object + infinitive (contoh: ask, want, tell, persuade, encourage, warn, invite, remind, allow, expect) → 'Mum asked me to tidy my room' atau 'The teacher told him to follow her'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Lupa mengubah tenses atau salah menggunakan tell/say
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering lupa mengubah tenses saat melaporkan pernyataan (misalnya tetap menggunakan present simple padahal harus past simple). Kesalahan lain adalah menggunakan 'say' dengan object atau 'tell' tanpa object.
commonTrap.wrong: He said me that he was tired. / She told that she liked it.
commonTrap.correct: He told me that he was tired. / She said that she liked it.

vocab.collocation: April 1st seems to be very popular with journalists.
Swiss farmers were enjoying a really good year for their spaghetti crop.
The BBC later admitted they had made up the whole story.
The athlete had misunderstood the rules of the race.

dialogue.context: Megan, seorang siswa, sedang kesal membaca berita tentang remaja yang dianggap melakukan vandalisme. Dia berdiskusi dengan teman-temannya Luke, Ryan, dan Olivia tentang berita tersebut.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: What's up, Megan? You don't look too happy.
lines.translation: Ada apa, Megan? Kamu terlihat tidak senang.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: I'm not. Check this out. 'Teenagers in graffiti disgrace - Local teenagers vandalise town centre once again.'
lines.translation: Aku memang tidak senang. Lihat ini. 'Remaja dalam aib grafiti - Remaja lokal vandalisme pusat kota lagi.'

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: What!? Let me see.
lines.translation: Apa!? Coba aku lihat.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Do you see that? 'Once again'! Like it happens every day!
lines.translation: Kamu lihat itu? 'Lagi'! Seolah-olah terjadi setiap hari!

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: It makes me so angry when I read headlines like this.
lines.translation: Aku sangat kesal ketika membaca judul berita seperti ini.

lines.speaker: Luke
lines.text: Don't get too angry, guys. It's not worth it.
lines.translation: Jangan terlalu marah, teman-teman. Tidak sepadan.

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.text: Sorry, Luke, I don't agree. We're talking about this journalist, what's his name, Nigel Forsyth, who doesn't like teenagers.
lines.translation: Maaf, Luke, aku tidak setuju. Kita sedang membicarakan jurnalis ini, siapa namanya, Nigel Forsyth, yang tidak suka remaja.

lines.speaker: Olivia
lines.text: That's right. My dad heard him on the radio once, and he was like: Oh, teenagers, all they do is make trouble.
lines.translation: Benar. Ayahku mendengarnya di radio suatu kali, dan dia seperti: Oh, remaja, yang mereka lakukan hanya membuat masalah.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih melaporkan pernyataan dengan Mr. Khoirul. Dia akan memberikan pernyataan langsung, dan Anda harus mengubahnya menjadi reported speech.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Let's practice reported speech today. I'll give you a direct statement, and you report it using the past tense. Ready? Here's the first one: 'I enjoy reading newspapers.' Now, report what I said.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: You said that you enjoyed reading newspapers.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Now try this one: 'The students are working on their projects.' How would you report that?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: You said that the students were working on their projects.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! One more challenge. Use 'tell' this time: 'Please close the door.' Report what I asked you to do.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: You told me to close the door.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Well done! You've got the hang of it. Keep practicing and you'll master reported speech in no time!

quiz.question: Complete the reported speech: 'I can swim very fast.' → He said that he _____ swim very fast.
quiz.explanation: Dalam reported speech, 'can' berubah menjadi 'could' ketika melaporkan pernyataan di masa lampau.

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: She told that she was tired.
She said me that she was tired.
She told me that she was tired.
quiz.answer: She told me that she was tired.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'tell' harus diikuti oleh object (me, him, her, dll). 'Say' tidak memerlukan object setelahnya.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence with the correct verb pattern: My teacher _____ me _____ my homework.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'ask' diikuti oleh object + infinitive (to + verb). Pola yang benar adalah: asked me to do.

quiz.question: Change to reported speech: 'We are enjoying the party.' → They said _____.
options: that they are enjoying the party
that they were enjoying the party
quiz.answer: that they were enjoying the party
quiz.explanation: Present continuous 'are enjoying' berubah menjadi past continuous 'were enjoying' dalam reported speech.

quiz.question: Which verb pattern is correct?
options: She encouraged me to study harder.
She encouraged to me study harder.
quiz.answer: She encouraged me to study harder.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'encourage' menggunakan pola: object + infinitive (me to study).

quiz.question: Complete: 'I will call you tomorrow.' → He said that he _____ call me the next day.
quiz.explanation: Dalam reported speech, 'will' berubah menjadi 'would' ketika melaporkan pernyataan di masa lampau.

modules.title: Unit 12: Playing by the Rules: Reported Speech & Sport Rules
modules.objective: Mampu membicarakan izin dan aturan, memberikan instruksi sederhana, serta menggunakan struktur 'be allowed to/let' dan third conditional untuk menjelaskan situasi hipotesis di masa lalu

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara mengekspresikan izin dan larangan menggunakan 'be allowed to' dan 'let', serta third conditional untuk membicarakan situasi yang tidak terjadi di masa lalu. Kamu akan belajar tentang peraturan dalam berbagai konteks, dari kehidupan sehari-hari hingga olahraga dan hukum di berbagai negara.
rules: be allowed to: Untuk membicarakan izin, gunakan 'be allowed to' + kata kerja dasar. Contoh: I'm not allowed to stay out late. (Saya tidak diizinkan pulang terlambat). My parents never let me go to parties. (Orang tua saya tidak pernah mengizinkan saya pergi ke pesta)

Third conditional: Untuk membicarakan situasi hipotesis di masa lalu, gunakan 'If + past perfect, would (not) have + past participle'. Contoh: If we had run, we wouldn't have missed the train. (Jika kami berlari, kami tidak akan ketinggalan kereta). If I hadn't listened to my mother, I wouldn't have got into trouble. (Jika saya tidak mendengarkan ibu saya, saya tidak akan mendapat masalah)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Urutan Kata 'be allowed to'
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering keliru dalam membentuk kalimat pasif dengan 'be allowed to'. Jangan lupa subjek kalimat adalah orang yang menerima izin, bukan yang memberi izin.
commonTrap.wrong: My parents allowed me to stay up late. (ini benar tapi bukan passive form)
commonTrap.correct: I was allowed to stay up late. (Saya diizinkan untuk begadang) atau I'm allowed to stay up late. (Saya diizinkan untuk begadang)

Stealing an alligator is against the law in Louisiana.

lines.translation: Itu tidak benar. Saya tidak diizinkan pergi ke pesta minggu lalu.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: My parents never let me go to parties either.
lines.translation: Orang tua saya juga tidak pernah mengizinkan saya pergi ke pesta.
