lines.translation: Saya tahu. Jika saya tidak mendengarkan ibu saya, saya tidak akan mendapat masalah.

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berbicara dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang peraturan di rumah dan sekolahmu. Ia ingin tahu apa yang diizinkan dan tidak diizinkan untuk kamu lakukan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Let's talk about rules today. Tell me, what are you allowed to do at home on weekends?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm allowed to stay up late and watch TV before school.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's interesting! And what about things you're not allowed to do? Are there any strict rules in your family?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm not allowed to use my mobile phone at school, and my parents never let me go out on school nights.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. Now, can you think of a time when you broke a rule? What would have happened if you hadn't broken it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: If I hadn't listened to my mother, I wouldn't have got into trouble last week.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good use of the third conditional! Do you think rules are important? Why or why not?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think rules are important because they help us behave well and stay safe.

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses 'be allowed to'?
options: My parents allowed me go to parties.
I'm not allowed to stay out late.
The teachers didn't let them have much food.
quiz.answer: I'm not allowed to stay out late.
quiz.explanation: Struktur yang benar adalah 'be allowed to + kata kerja dasar'. Kalimat ini menggunakan bentuk pasif untuk menyatakan bahwa subjek (I) menerima izin atau tidak diizinkan melakukan sesuatu.

quiz.question: Complete the third conditional: If we _____ run, we wouldn't have missed the train.
quiz.explanation: Third conditional menggunakan 'If + past perfect' untuk kondisi, dan 'would (not) have + past participle' untuk hasil. Bentuk lengkapnya adalah 'If we had run'.

quiz.question: Ancient Greek parents _____ to decide if they wanted to keep their babies.
quiz.explanation: Konteks kalimat menunjukkan orang tua Yunani kuno diberi izin (bentuk pasif). 'Were allowed' adalah bentuk past tense dari 'be allowed to' yang tepat untuk konteks historis ini.

quiz.question: Which phrase means 'mendapat masalah'?
quiz.explanation: 'Get into trouble' adalah frasa yang berarti mendapat masalah atau kesulitan karena melakukan sesuatu yang salah. 'Break the rules' berarti melanggar aturan, dan 'get told off' berarti dimarahi.

quiz.question: If I _____ to my mother, I wouldn't have got into trouble.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini adalah third conditional yang menyatakan penyesalan di masa lalu. Karena hasilnya 'wouldn't have got into trouble' (tidak akan mendapat masalah), kondisinya harus 'hadn't listened' (tidak mendengarkan) yang menunjukkan situasi berlawanan dengan kenyataan.

quiz.question: The teachers didn't let them _____ much food.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'let', kita menggunakan kata kerja dasar (infinitive tanpa 'to'). Struktur yang benar adalah 'let + object + bare infinitive', sehingga jawabannya adalah 'have'.

modules.title: Ujian Kelulusan B1.1: Evaluasi Komprehensif Fondasi Intermediate
modules.objective: Ujian kelulusan komprehensif 4 keterampilan (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) untuk membuka Sub-Level B1.2

theory.summary: Ujian kelulusan B1.1 ini mengevaluasi penguasaan komprehensif Anda terhadap semua materi yang telah dipelajari di level Intermediate Foundations. Anda akan diuji dalam empat keterampilan utama: Listening (mendengarkan dan memahami percakapan), Reading (membaca dan memahami teks), Writing & Grammar (menulis dengan tata bahasa yang tepat), dan Speaking (berbicara dalam situasi nyata). Materi yang diujikan mencakup present tenses untuk mendeskripsikan kepribadian, present perfect dengan for/since, comparatives/superlatives, indefinite pronouns, future forms (will/going to/present continuous), first conditional dengan unless, modals of ability/obligation, second conditional, past perfect, passive voice simple, dan reported speech dasar. Passing score adalah 75 poin dari 100, yang berarti Anda perlu menjawab minimal 12 dari 16 soal dengan benar untuk lulus ke level B1.2.
rules: Present Perfect with For/Since: Subject + have/has + past participle + for/since + time period. Gunakan 'for' untuk durasi waktu (for three years) dan 'since' untuk titik waktu spesifik (since 2020). Contoh: 'I have worked here for five years' atau 'She has lived in Jakarta since 2018'.

Second Conditional: If + past simple, would + base verb. Digunakan untuk situasi hipotesis atau tidak nyata di masa sekarang. Contoh: 'If I had more money, I would travel around the world' atau 'If she studied harder, she would pass the exam'.

Passive Voice (Simple): Subject + be (am/is/are/was/were) + past participle + by + agent. Digunakan ketika fokus pada objek yang dikenai aksi, bukan pelaku. Contoh: 'The book was written by Shakespeare' atau 'English is spoken in many countries'.

Reported Speech (Dasar): Mengubah direct speech menjadi indirect speech dengan backshifting tense. Present simple → past simple, will → would, can → could. Contoh: She said, 'I am tired' → She said (that) she was tired. He said, 'I will come' → He said (that) he would come.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum dalam Ujian Komprehensif
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa B1.1 terjebak dengan mencampurkan tenses dalam conditional sentences, lupa melakukan backshifting dalam reported speech, atau salah menempatkan 'for' dan 'since' dalam present perfect. Kesalahan lain adalah tidak memperhatikan konteks dalam listening dan reading comprehension, sehingga menjawab terlalu cepat tanpa memahami detail penting.
commonTrap.wrong: If I will have time, I would visit you. She said that she is busy now. I have been working here since five years.
commonTrap.correct: If I had time, I would visit you. She said that she was busy. I have been working here for five years.

vocab.collocation: The comprehensive exam tests all four language skills thoroughly.
Teachers evaluate students' progress through regular assessments.
Her English proficiency has improved significantly this year.
You need to demonstrate your speaking skills in the oral exam.
Critical analysis of reading texts is essential at B1 level.
Meeting the passing requirements means scoring at least 75 points.
You must answer the grammar questions accurately to pass.
This course builds a strong foundation for intermediate English.
Students who study consistently will achieve their learning goals.
After passing B1.1, you'll make a smooth transition to B1.2.

dialogue.context: Dua siswa, Sarah dan David, sedang membicarakan persiapan mereka untuk ujian kelulusan B1.1 di perpustakaan sekolah.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Hi David! Have you been studying for the B1.1 final exam? I'm a bit nervous about it.
lines.translation: Hai David! Apakah kamu sudah belajar untuk ujian akhir B1.1? Aku agak gugup tentang ini.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Yes, I have been reviewing all the grammar points for two weeks now. The second conditional is still tricky for me.
lines.translation: Ya, aku sudah mengulas semua poin grammar selama dua minggu sekarang. Second conditional masih sulit bagiku.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I know what you mean! If I had more practice time, I would feel more confident. What about the listening section?
lines.translation: Aku tahu maksudmu! Kalau aku punya lebih banyak waktu latihan, aku akan merasa lebih percaya diri. Bagaimana dengan bagian listening?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: The listening is okay for me, but the reported speech questions always confuse me. I keep forgetting to change the tenses.
lines.translation: Listening oke bagiku, tapi pertanyaan reported speech selalu membuatku bingung. Aku terus lupa mengubah tenses-nya.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Actually, I've been practicing reported speech since last Monday, and it's getting easier. Remember to backshift the tenses!
lines.translation: Sebenarnya, aku sudah latihan reported speech sejak Senin lalu, dan semakin mudah. Ingat untuk backshift tenses-nya!

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: That's a good tip! Thanks, Sarah. If we both pass this exam, we'll move on to B1.2 together.
lines.translation: Itu tips yang bagus! Terima kasih, Sarah. Kalau kita berdua lulus ujian ini, kita akan lanjut ke B1.2 bersama.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Definitely! Let's do our best. I heard the passing score is 75, so we need at least 12 correct answers.
lines.translation: Pasti! Ayo kita lakukan yang terbaik. Aku dengar passing score-nya 75, jadi kita butuh minimal 12 jawaban benar.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: We can do this! Good luck to both of us. Should we study together tomorrow before the exam?
lines.translation: Kita bisa melakukan ini! Semoga beruntung untuk kita berdua. Haruskah kita belajar bersama besok sebelum ujian?

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih persiapan ujian dengan Mr. Khoirul, AI Tutor Anda. Beliau akan membantu Anda mempraktikkan berbagai situasi yang mungkin muncul dalam ujian speaking B1.1.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Welcome to your B1.1 exam preparation session. How are you feeling about the upcoming comprehensive exam?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi, Mr. Khoirul! I'm feeling a bit nervous, but I've been studying hard for the past few weeks.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's great to hear! Tell me, which skill do you find most challenging: listening, reading, writing, or speaking?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think the writing section is the most challenging for me because I need to use correct grammar and tenses accurately.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I understand. Let me ask you a hypothetical question: If you could choose only one grammar point to master before the exam, which one would it be and why?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: If I could choose one, I would choose the second conditional because I still find it confusing when to use 'would' correctly.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent self-awareness! Now, can you tell me how long you have been learning English at the B1.1 level?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I have been learning at the B1.1 level for about three months now, and I feel much more confident than when I started.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Hi, this is Emma calling from City Library. I'm calling to remind you that the books you borrowed are due tomorrow. You've had them for two weeks now. If you need them longer, you can renew them online or call us before 5 PM today. Otherwise, there will be a late fee of $2 per day. Thank you!' - What should the listener do to avoid a late fee?
options: Renew the books before 5 PM today
quiz.answer: Renew the books before 5 PM today
quiz.explanation: Dalam pesan audio, Emma menjelaskan bahwa untuk menghindari denda keterlambatan, pendengar harus memperbarui (renew) buku-buku tersebut secara online atau menelepon sebelum jam 5 sore hari ini. Ini adalah informasi spesifik tentang cara menghindari late fee sebesar $2 per hari.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Good morning, passengers. This is your captain speaking. We will be landing at Singapore Changi Airport in approximately 25 minutes. The local time in Singapore is 3:15 PM, and the temperature is 32 degrees Celsius. Please fasten your seatbelts and return your seats to the upright position. We hope you've enjoyed your flight with us.' - What time will the plane land?
quiz.explanation: Kapten mengatakan bahwa waktu lokal saat ini adalah pukul 3:15 PM dan pesawat akan mendarat dalam sekitar 25 menit. Jadi waktu pendaratan adalah 3:15 PM + 25 menit = 3:40 PM. Ini menguji kemampuan mendengarkan detail dan melakukan kalkulasi sederhana.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Hi James, it's Lucy. I wanted to let you know that the meeting has been rescheduled. It was supposed to be on Friday at 2 PM, but now it's on Thursday at 10 AM instead. The location is still the same - Conference Room B on the third floor. Could you please confirm if you can make it? Thanks!' - What has changed about the meeting?
options: The location has changed to the third floor
The day and time have been changed
quiz.answer: The day and time have been changed
quiz.explanation: Lucy menjelaskan bahwa pertemuan dijadwal ulang dari hari Jumat pukul 2 siang menjadi hari Kamis pukul 10 pagi. Lokasi tetap sama di Conference Room B lantai tiga, jadi yang berubah hanya hari dan waktunya. Ini menguji kemampuan mengidentifikasi informasi yang berubah vs yang tetap sama.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Welcome to Sunshine Café. Today's special is grilled salmon with roasted vegetables for $18. It comes with a free drink - you can choose between orange juice, iced tea, or coffee. We're also running a promotion: if you buy two main courses, you'll get 20% off your total bill. Our café is open until 9 PM tonight.' - What will customers get if they order today's special?
options: A complimentary beverage of their choice
quiz.answer: A complimentary beverage of their choice
quiz.explanation: Dalam pengumuman, disebutkan bahwa special hari ini (grilled salmon) sudah termasuk minuman gratis (free drink) dan pelanggan bisa memilih antara orange juice, iced tea, atau coffee. Diskon 20% hanya berlaku jika membeli dua main courses, bukan otomatis untuk satu special. Kata 'complimentary' berarti gratis.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'Climate change is one of the most serious challenges facing our planet today. Scientists have been warning us for decades that global temperatures are rising due to human activities, especially the burning of fossil fuels. If we don't take action soon, the consequences will be devastating. Sea levels will rise, extreme weather events will become more frequent, and many species will face extinction. However, there is still hope. By switching to renewable energy sources, reducing our carbon footprint, and protecting forests, we can slow down climate change and create a more sustainable future for the next generation.' - According to the text, what is the main cause of rising global temperatures?
options: Human activities, particularly burning fossil fuels
Rising sea levels around the world
quiz.answer: Human activities, particularly burning fossil fuels
quiz.explanation: Teks dengan jelas menyatakan bahwa 'global temperatures are rising due to human activities, especially the burning of fossil fuels'. Rising sea levels dan extinction adalah konsekuensi (consequences), bukan penyebab. Ini menguji kemampuan mengidentifikasi cause and effect dalam bacaan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'Maria has been a professional photographer for eight years. She started her career after graduating from art school in 2015. Since then, she has traveled to over 30 countries to capture stunning images of nature and wildlife. Her work has been published in several international magazines, and she has won three prestigious photography awards. Maria says that if she hadn't followed her passion, she would have become a lawyer like her parents wanted. But she has never regretted her decision because photography brings her true happiness.' - How long has Maria been working as a photographer?
options: For over eight years after art school
quiz.explanation: Teks menyebutkan 'Maria has been a professional photographer for eight years' dan 'She started her career after graduating from art school in 2015'. Kedua informasi ini konsisten dan menunjukkan durasi karir fotografinya. Ini menguji pemahaman present perfect dengan 'for' dan 'since'.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'The new community center will be opened next month by the mayor. It has been built to provide local residents with various facilities including a gym, library, computer lab, and meeting rooms. The project was funded by both government grants and private donations. Local residents are excited about the opening because the center will offer free English classes, job training workshops, and activities for children. Registration for programs will begin on the opening day.' - What is true about the community center?
options: It was opened last month by residents
It will be inaugurated by the mayor next month
It only provides English classes for free
Registration has already begun for all programs
quiz.answer: It will be inaugurated by the mayor next month
quiz.explanation: Kalimat pertama menjelaskan bahwa 'The new community center will be opened next month by the mayor' menggunakan passive voice dalam future tense. Pusat komunitas ini belum dibuka (akan dibuka bulan depan), menawarkan berbagai program (tidak hanya English classes), dan registrasi baru akan dimulai pada hari pembukaan. Ini menguji pemahaman passive voice dan detail faktual.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'Last week, Tom went to a job interview at a technology company. The interviewer asked him many questions about his experience and skills. Tom said that he had worked in customer service for five years before deciding to switch to the tech industry. The interviewer seemed impressed and told Tom that they would contact him within a week. Tom felt confident about his performance, but he knew that many other candidates had also applied for the position. Now he's waiting anxiously for their response.' - What did Tom tell the interviewer about his work history?
options: He said he is currently working in customer service
He mentioned he had five years of customer service experience
He told them he would work for five years
He explained he has been in tech industry for years
quiz.answer: He mentioned he had five years of customer service experience
quiz.explanation: Teks menjelaskan dalam reported speech bahwa 'Tom said that he had worked in customer service for five years before deciding to switch to the tech industry'. Past perfect tense 'had worked' menunjukkan pengalaman yang sudah selesai sebelum dia memutuskan berganti industri. Ini menguji pemahaman reported speech dan past perfect.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the grammatically correct sentence using present perfect with 'for' or 'since':
options: I have lived in this city since five years
She has been a teacher for 2010
They have known each other since childhood
We have studied English since three months
quiz.answer: They have known each other since childhood
quiz.explanation: Kalimat yang benar menggunakan 'since' + titik waktu spesifik (childhood = masa kecil). Kesalahan umum: 'since' harus diikuti titik waktu (since 2010, since Monday, since childhood), sedangkan 'for' diikuti durasi (for five years, for three months). 'Since five years' dan 'since three months' salah; seharusnya 'for five years' dan 'for three months'. 'For 2010' juga salah; seharusnya 'since 2010'.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Select the correct second conditional sentence:
options: If I will have more money, I would buy a car
If she studies harder, she will pass the exam
If they had more time, they would visit us
If he would be rich, he will travel the world
quiz.answer: If they had more time, they would visit us
quiz.explanation: Second conditional yang benar menggunakan pola: If + past simple, would + base verb. 'If they had more time, they would visit us' adalah struktur yang tepat untuk situasi hipotesis di masa sekarang. Pilihan pertama salah karena 'if I will have' (seharusnya 'if I had'). Pilihan kedua adalah first conditional, bukan second. Pilihan keempat mencampur 'would be' di klausa if yang tidak tepat.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice?
options: The letter was wrote by Sarah yesterday
English is spoken in many countries around the world
The house is building by workers now
The book has written by a famous author
quiz.answer: English is spoken in many countries around the world
quiz.explanation: Passive voice yang benar: be + past participle. 'English is spoken' menggunakan struktur yang tepat (is + spoken, past participle dari speak). Kesalahan pada pilihan lain: 'was wrote' seharusnya 'was written' (past participle yang benar), 'is building' seharusnya 'is being built' (passive continuous), dan 'has written' seharusnya 'has been written' (passive present perfect).

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the correct reported speech transformation of: She said, 'I will help you tomorrow.'
options: She said that she will help me tomorrow
She said that she would help me the next day
She said that she will help you tomorrow
She told she would help me tomorrow
quiz.answer: She said that she would help me the next day
quiz.explanation: Dalam reported speech, kita harus melakukan backshifting: 'will' menjadi 'would', 'you' menjadi 'me' (perspektif berubah), dan 'tomorrow' menjadi 'the next day' (time reference berubah). Struktur 'she said that' sudah benar; 'she told' harus diikuti objek (she told me that). Pilihan pertama dan ketiga tidak melakukan backshifting yang diperlukan.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] You are at a restaurant and the waiter brought you the wrong dish. What is the most polite way to address this?
options: This is wrong! I didn't order this food!
Excuse me, I think there might be a mistake. I ordered the pasta, not the pizza.
You made an error. Take this back immediately.
Hey, this isn't my order. Fix it now.
quiz.answer: Excuse me, I think there might be a mistake. I ordered the pasta, not the pizza.
quiz.explanation: Dalam situasi formal seperti di restoran, kita harus menggunakan bahasa yang sopan dan tidak langsung menyalahkan. 'Excuse me, I think there might be a mistake' menggunakan frasa sopan dan softener 'might be' yang tidak konfrontatif. Kemudian dengan jelas menyebutkan apa yang dipesan. Pilihan lain terlalu langsung, demanding, atau tidak sopan untuk konteks B1 formal.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Your friend invites you to a party, but you have an exam the next day. How should you politely decline?
options: No, I can't come. I'm busy that day.
I'd love to come, but unfortunately I have an important exam the next morning. Maybe next time?
Sorry, but I have to study. Bye.
I don't want to go to your party because of my exam.
quiz.answer: I'd love to come, but unfortunately I have an important exam the next morning. Maybe next time?
quiz.explanation: Menolak undangan dengan sopan memerlukan beberapa elemen: menunjukkan apresiasi ('I'd love to come'), memberikan alasan jelas ('I have an important exam'), menggunakan softener ('unfortunately'), dan menawarkan alternatif ('Maybe next time?'). Ini menunjukkan Anda menghargai undangan tetapi memiliki komitmen lain. Pilihan lain terlalu singkat, blunt, atau kurang sopan.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] You're in a job interview and the interviewer asks: 'Where do you see yourself in five years?' What is the best response?
options: I don't know. Maybe I'll still be looking for a job.
In five years, I see myself growing within this company, taking on more responsibilities and contributing to important projects.
I see myself being rich and not working anymore.
I haven't thought about it. Can we talk about something else?
quiz.answer: In five years, I see myself growing within this company, taking on more responsibilities and contributing to important projects.
quiz.explanation: Dalam job interview, pertanyaan tentang rencana masa depan menguji ambisi dan komitmen Anda. Jawaban terbaik menunjukkan Anda punya visi yang realistis, menunjukkan loyalitas pada perusahaan ('within this company'), dan fokus pada pertumbuhan profesional. Pilihan lain menunjukkan kurangnya persiapan, ambisi yang tidak realistis, atau sikap yang tidak profesional.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] A colleague asks for your opinion on their presentation. You think it needs improvement. What should you say?
options: It was terrible. You need to redo everything.
I think the content is strong, but perhaps you could make the slides more visual and add some concrete examples to support your points.
It's okay, I guess. Nothing special about it.
Honestly, I wasn't paying attention to your presentation.
quiz.answer: I think the content is strong, but perhaps you could make the slides more visual and add some concrete examples to support your points.
quiz.explanation: Memberikan feedback konstruktif memerlukan sandwich approach: mulai dengan hal positif ('the content is strong'), kemudian saran perbaikan dengan sopan menggunakan 'perhaps you could' (bukan 'you must'), dan berikan saran spesifik yang actionable. Ini menunjukkan profesionalisme dan emotional intelligence di level B1. Pilihan lain terlalu negatif, tidak membantu, atau tidak profesional.

modules.title: Professional Communication: Business Emails, Formal Registers & Etiquette
modules.objective: Menguasai etika korespondensi formal, sapaan profesional, struktur email bisnis, dan frase penutup baku.

theory.summary: Komunikasi profesional dalam bahasa Inggris memerlukan pemahaman tentang register formal yang tepat. Email bisnis memiliki struktur standar: salam pembuka formal (Dear Mr./Ms. + nama keluarga), paragraf pembuka yang menyatakan tujuan, isi yang jelas dan ringkas, serta penutup profesional. Perbedaan utama antara email ke rekan kerja dan klien penting terletak pada tingkat formalitas - kepada klien atau atasan, gunakan struktur lebih formal dengan frasa seperti 'I am writing to inquire' atau 'I would appreciate if you could', sedangkan kepada rekan setingkat bisa sedikit lebih santai namun tetap profesional. Hindari kontraksi (gunakan 'I am' bukan 'I'm'), gunakan kalimat lengkap, dan selalu proofread sebelum mengirim.
rules: Struktur Email Formal: Subject line yang jelas → Salam formal (Dear Mr./Ms. + nama keluarga) → Paragraf pembuka (tujuan email) → Isi utama (2-3 paragraf singkat) → Penutup sopan (Thank you for your time/consideration) → Sign-off formal (Yours sincerely/Best regards) → Nama lengkap dan jabatan

Frasa Pembuka Formal: 'I am writing to inquire about/regarding...' (untuk pertanyaan), 'I am writing to inform you that...' (untuk pemberitahuan), 'Thank you for your email dated...' (untuk balasan), 'Further to our conversation...' (follow-up)

Frasa Permintaan Sopan: 'I would appreciate if you could...' (sangat formal), 'Could you please...' (formal), 'Would it be possible to...' (meminta kemungkinan), 'I would be grateful if...' (mengungkapkan terima kasih di awal). Contoh: 'I would appreciate if you could send me the updated proposal by Friday.' atau 'Could you please confirm your attendance at the meeting?'

Lampiran dan Referensi: 'Please find attached...' (untuk file terlampir), 'As discussed...' (merujuk pembicaraan sebelumnya), 'With reference to...' (merujuk dokumen/email lain). Contoh: 'Please find attached the quarterly report for your review.'

Penutup Profesional: Gunakan 'Yours sincerely' jika Anda tahu nama penerima (Dear Mr. Smith), gunakan 'Yours faithfully' jika tidak tahu nama (Dear Sir/Madam). Alternatif modern: 'Best regards', 'Kind regards' untuk hampir semua situasi formal. Hindari 'Cheers', 'Thanks', atau 'See you' dalam konteks sangat formal.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Tingkat Formalitas
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pembelajar B1 menggunakan bahasa terlalu kasual dalam email bisnis atau sebaliknya, terlalu kaku saat berkomunikasi dengan rekan kerja. Kesalahan umum termasuk penggunaan kontraksi (I'm, don't, can't) dalam email formal, atau memulai email dengan 'Hi' kepada klien penting yang belum kenal.
commonTrap.wrong: Hi John, I'm writing cause I need the report ASAP. Can you send it? Thanks, bye!
commonTrap.correct: Dear Mr. Anderson, I am writing to request the quarterly report. Would it be possible to receive it by the end of this week? I would appreciate your assistance with this matter. Best regards, [Your name]

vocab.collocation: I am writing to inquire about the availability of meeting rooms next week.
Thank you for your email regarding the upcoming conference in Singapore.
I would appreciate if you could review the attached document at your earliest convenience.
Please find attached the revised contract for your consideration.

dialogue.context: Sarah dari departemen Marketing mengirim email kepada Mr. Thompson, seorang klien penting dari perusahaan lain, untuk menindaklanjuti meeting dan meminta konfirmasi proposal.

lines.speaker: Sarah (Email)
lines.text: Dear Mr. Thompson, I am writing to follow up on our meeting last Tuesday regarding the marketing collaboration.
lines.translation: Kepada Bapak Thompson, Saya menulis untuk menindaklanjuti pertemuan kita Selasa lalu mengenai kolaborasi pemasaran.

lines.speaker: Sarah (Email)
lines.text: Thank you for taking the time to discuss the proposal with our team. We found your insights particularly valuable.
lines.translation: Terima kasih telah meluangkan waktu untuk membahas proposal dengan tim kami. Kami merasa masukan Anda sangat berharga.

lines.speaker: Sarah (Email)
lines.text: Please find attached the revised proposal incorporating the changes we discussed. I would appreciate if you could review it at your earliest convenience.
lines.translation: Terlampir proposal revisi yang telah memasukkan perubahan yang kita diskusikan. Saya akan sangat menghargai jika Anda bisa meninjaunya sesegera mungkin.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson (Reply)
lines.text: Dear Sarah, Thank you for your prompt response and for sending the updated proposal.
lines.translation: Kepada Sarah, Terima kasih atas respons cepat Anda dan pengiriman proposal yang telah diperbarui.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson (Reply)
lines.text: I have reviewed the document and I am pleased with the modifications. However, I would like to clarify a few points regarding the timeline.
lines.translation: Saya telah meninjau dokumen tersebut dan saya puas dengan modifikasinya. Namun, saya ingin mengklarifikasi beberapa poin mengenai timeline.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson (Reply)
lines.text: Could you please confirm whether the project launch date can be moved to early March instead of late February?
lines.translation: Bisakah Anda konfirmasi apakah tanggal peluncuran proyek bisa dimundurkan ke awal Maret daripada akhir Februari?

lines.speaker: Sarah (Reply)
lines.text: Dear Mr. Thompson, Thank you for your feedback. I will discuss the timeline adjustment with our project team and get back to you by tomorrow.
lines.translation: Kepada Bapak Thompson, Terima kasih atas masukan Anda. Saya akan mendiskusikan penyesuaian timeline dengan tim proyek kami dan akan menghubungi Anda kembali besok.

lines.speaker: Sarah (Reply)
lines.text: I look forward to moving forward with this partnership. Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any further questions. Best regards, Sarah Mitchell
lines.translation: Saya menantikan untuk melanjutkan kemitraan ini. Jangan ragu menghubungi saya jika ada pertanyaan lebih lanjut. Hormat saya, Sarah Mitchell

speakingLab.context: Anda berlatih menulis email formal dengan Mr. Khoirul. Dia akan berperan sebagai atasan yang meminta Anda mengirim email ke klien, dan Anda harus merespons dengan struktur email yang tepat.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're practicing professional email writing. Imagine you need to write to a client, Ms. Johnson, to request a meeting next week. How would you start your email?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Dear Ms. Johnson, I am writing to inquire about your availability for a meeting next week.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent opening! Very professional. Now, how would you explain the purpose of the meeting? Remember to be clear and concise.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would like to discuss the progress of our current project and address some questions regarding the next phase.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! That's clear and specific. Now, you need to suggest some times. How would you phrase that politely?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Would it be possible to schedule a meeting on Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon? I would appreciate if you could let me know your preferred time.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Great use of formal phrases! Now, let's say you need to attach a document. How would you mention that?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Please find attached the project summary for your review prior to our meeting.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Wonderful! Finally, how would you close this email professionally?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you. Best regards, [My name]

quiz.question: I am writing to ___ about the status of my job application.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'to' (infinitive), kita menggunakan bentuk dasar verb. 'Inquire' adalah bentuk verb yang benar. 'Inquiring' adalah gerund/present participle, dan 'inquiry' adalah noun. Frasa lengkapnya 'I am writing to inquire about...' adalah pembuka email formal yang sangat umum untuk menanyakan informasi.

quiz.question: Please find ___ the documents you requested yesterday.
quiz.explanation: 'Please find attached' adalah frasa baku dalam email bisnis untuk menyebutkan file lampiran. 'Attached' di sini berfungsi sebagai past participle yang mendeskripsikan kondisi dokumen (dalam keadaan terlampir). Ini adalah konstruksi formal yang sangat umum dalam korespondensi profesional.

quiz.question: Which closing is most appropriate for a formal email to someone you know by name?
quiz.explanation: 'Yours sincerely' adalah penutup formal standar ketika Anda menulis kepada seseorang yang namanya Anda ketahui (dimulai dengan 'Dear Mr./Ms. + nama'). 'Cheers' dan 'See you soon' terlalu kasual untuk email bisnis formal. Alternatif modern yang juga tepat adalah 'Best regards' atau 'Kind regards'.

quiz.question: I would appreciate ___ you could send me the report by Friday.
quiz.explanation: Struktur 'I would appreciate if you could...' adalah frasa formal untuk membuat permintaan sopan dalam email bisnis. 'If' membentuk conditional clause yang menyatakan permintaan dengan sangat sopan. 'That' akan membuat kalimat gramatikal tapi mengubah makna ('I would appreciate that...' berarti Anda menghargai fakta tersebut, bukan meminta). 'When' tidak sesuai dengan struktur ini.

quiz.question: ___ to our phone conversation this morning, I am sending the contract details.
quiz.explanation: 'Further to' adalah frasa formal yang berarti 'sehubungan dengan' atau 'melanjutkan dari', sangat umum digunakan untuk mereferensikan komunikasi sebelumnya. 'Farther' digunakan untuk jarak fisik. 'Furthermore' berarti 'selain itu' dan tidak bisa diikuti 'to' dalam konteks ini. Frasa lengkap 'Further to our conversation/meeting/email...' adalah pembuka standar email follow-up.

modules.title: Present Perfect Continuous: Ongoing Actions vs Finished Results
modules.objective: Membedakan aksi yang telah berlangsung hingga sekarang (have been doing) dengan hasil akhir aksi (have done).

theory.summary: Present Perfect Continuous digunakan untuk menekankan durasi atau proses suatu aktivitas yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut atau baru saja selesai, dengan efek yang terlihat sekarang. Berbeda dengan Present Perfect Simple yang fokus pada hasil akhir atau pencapaian. Misalnya: 'I have been painting the wall' (proses, baju kotor cat) vs 'I have painted the wall' (selesai, hasil sudah jadi). Tense ini sangat berguna untuk menjelaskan aktivitas yang memakan waktu atau sedang berlangsung dalam periode hingga sekarang.
rules: Formula: Subject + have/has + been + verb-ing. Digunakan untuk aktivitas yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung atau baru saja berhenti dengan bukti di masa sekarang. Contoh: 'She has been studying for three hours' (dia masih belajar atau baru berhenti).

Time expressions yang sering digunakan: for (durasi), since (titik waktu mulai), all morning/day, lately, recently, how long. Contoh: 'They have been working on this project since January' atau 'I've been feeling tired lately'.

Present Perfect Simple vs Continuous: Simple menekankan hasil (have done = selesai), Continuous menekankan proses atau durasi (have been doing = fokus pada aktivitas itu sendiri). Contoh: 'I have read the book' (selesai) vs 'I have been reading the book' (masih membaca atau baru berhenti, belum tentu selesai).

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampuradukkan Simple dan Continuous
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa sering menggunakan Present Perfect Simple ketika seharusnya menggunakan Continuous untuk menekankan durasi atau proses. Atau sebaliknya, menggunakan Continuous untuk hasil yang sudah pasti selesai. Perhatikan konteks dan fokusnya: apakah Anda ingin menekankan 'sudah selesai' atau 'sudah berapa lama/masih berlangsung'?
commonTrap.wrong: I have worked on this report all day, so I'm exhausted.
commonTrap.correct: I have been working on this report all day, so I'm exhausted.

vocab.collocation: I've been running for an hour and now I'm completely exhausted.
Have you been sleeping well lately? You look tired.
I've been learning Spanish recently and it's quite challenging.
We've been making good progress on the new website design.
I can't concentrate because they've been talking loudly all morning.
The team has been preparing for the presentation since Monday.
Customers have been complaining about the slow service lately.
Your hands are dirty - you've been working in the garden, haven't you?
Her English has been improving a lot since she started watching movies.
How long have you been waiting? I want to know the duration.

dialogue.context: Sarah bertemu temannya Tom di kantor. Tom terlihat sangat lelah dan Sarah bertanya apa yang sedang dia kerjakan.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Hi Tom! You look exhausted. What have you been doing?
lines.translation: Hai Tom! Kamu terlihat kelelahan. Apa yang sudah kamu kerjakan?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I've been preparing the quarterly report since this morning. It's taking forever!
lines.translation: Aku sudah menyiapkan laporan triwulan sejak pagi ini. Ini memakan waktu sangat lama!

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: How long have you been working on it exactly?
lines.translation: Sudah berapa lama tepatnya kamu mengerjakannya?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: About five hours non-stop. I haven't even had lunch yet.
lines.translation: Sekitar lima jam tanpa henti. Aku bahkan belum makan siang.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That's too much! Have you finished it at least?
lines.translation: Itu terlalu banyak! Apakah setidaknya kamu sudah menyelesaikannya?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Not yet. I've been analyzing the data, but there's still more to do.
lines.translation: Belum. Aku sudah menganalisis datanya, tapi masih ada lagi yang harus dikerjakan.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You should take a break. Your eyes look really tired.
lines.translation: Kamu harus istirahat. Matamu terlihat sangat lelah.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You're right. I've been staring at the screen all day. Maybe I'll grab some coffee.
lines.translation: Kamu benar. Aku sudah menatap layar sepanjang hari. Mungkin aku akan mengambil kopi.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berbicara dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang aktivitas yang Anda lakukan baru-baru ini. Mr. Khoirul ingin tahu tentang proyek atau hobi yang sedang Anda kerjakan dan sudah berapa lama Anda melakukannya.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! You look quite busy these days. What have you been working on lately?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi Mr. Khoirul! I've been working on a new project for my company. It's quite challenging.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That sounds interesting! How long have you been working on this project?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I've been working on it for about three weeks now. We started at the beginning of the month.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Three weeks is quite a while! Have you been making good progress?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, we have been making steady progress, but there's still a lot to do before the deadline.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. Have you been getting enough rest? You mentioned it's challenging.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Not really. I've been staying late at the office most evenings. But I hope to finish soon.

quiz.question: I ___ for this exam for two months, and I still don't feel ready.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan Present Perfect Continuous karena kalimat ini menekankan durasi aktivitas (for two months) yang masih berlangsung hingga sekarang. Kata 'still' mengindikasikan proses yang berkelanjutan, bukan hasil yang sudah selesai.

quiz.question: Look at your clothes! What ___ all morning?
quiz.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous tepat digunakan karena ada bukti di masa sekarang (pakaian kotor) dari aktivitas yang baru saja dilakukan. 'All morning' menunjukkan durasi, dan kata 'Look!' menunjukkan ada efek yang terlihat sekarang.

quiz.question: She ___ three reports this week. She's very productive.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan Present Perfect Simple karena fokusnya adalah pada hasil yang sudah selesai (three reports = pencapaian konkret). Angka spesifik biasanya menunjukkan hasil akhir, bukan proses yang sedang berlangsung.

quiz.question: They ___ for the bus for over an hour, but it still hasn't arrived.
quiz.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous digunakan untuk menekankan durasi aktivitas yang belum selesai (for over an hour) dan masih berlangsung hingga sekarang. Kata 'still hasn't arrived' mengonfirmasi bahwa mereka masih menunggu.

quiz.question: I can't talk now. I ___ an important email and I need to finish it.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan Present Continuous (bukan Present Perfect Continuous) karena aksi sedang terjadi tepat di saat ini ('now'). Present Perfect Continuous digunakan untuk aktivitas yang dimulai di masa lalu dan berlanjut/baru selesai, bukan untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat berbicara.

modules.title: Travel Dilemmas, Booking Flights & Problem Resolution at Transit Hubs
modules.objective: Menangani situasi rumit di bandara internasional: penerbangan tertunda, bagasi hilang, dan pengalihan rute.

theory.summary: Ketika bepergian melalui bandara internasional, Anda akan menghadapi berbagai situasi yang memerlukan komunikasi yang jelas dan asertif namun tetap sopan. Modul ini mengajarkan cara menangani masalah umum seperti penerbangan tertunda, bagasi hilang, dan perubahan rute. Kunci sukses adalah menggunakan bahasa formal yang tepat, menyampaikan keluhan dengan tenang, dan memahami hak-hak penumpang. Anda akan belajar struktur kalimat untuk meminta bantuan, mengajukan klaim kompensasi, dan menjelaskan situasi darurat dengan vocabulary bandara tingkat lanjut.
rules: Gunakan Present Perfect untuk menjelaskan masalah yang baru terjadi: 'My luggage has been lost' atau 'The flight has been delayed for three hours'
Gunakan Modal Verbs untuk permintaan sopan dan formal: 'Could you please check...?', 'Would it be possible to...?', 'I would like to file a complaint about...'
Gunakan Passive Voice untuk fokus pada masalah, bukan pelaku: 'I was informed that...', 'My booking was cancelled', 'Passengers are being transferred to...'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Penggunaan Tenses saat Melaporkan Masalah
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pelajar menggunakan Simple Past padahal masalahnya masih berlangsung atau baru saja terjadi. Gunakan Present Perfect untuk masalah yang berdampak pada situasi saat ini, dan Past Simple hanya untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai sepenuhnya.
commonTrap.wrong: My flight delayed two hours ago and I still wait here.
commonTrap.correct: My flight has been delayed for two hours and I'm still waiting here.

vocab.collocation: I missed my connecting flight to Singapore because the first flight arrived late.
We have a six-hour layover in Dubai before our final destination.
I'd like to file a compensation claim for the delayed flight and missed hotel booking.
Please fill out the customs declaration form before passing through immigration.
Due to bad weather, our flight has been rerouted through Tokyo instead of Seoul.
Make sure you have your boarding pass and passport ready at the gate.
Your luggage should arrive at baggage claim carousel number 5.
The flight was overbooked, so they're offering vouchers for volunteers to take a later flight.
Do I need a transit visa if I have a 10-hour layover in this country?
Your flight is now boarding at gate 23B. Please proceed immediately.

dialogue.context: Sarah sedang berada di konter maskapai di bandara transit Singapura. Bagasinya tidak tiba bersama penerbangannya, dan dia memiliki connecting flight dalam 2 jam ke Sydney.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Excuse me, I've just arrived on flight SQ 287 from Jakarta, but my luggage hasn't appeared at the baggage claim.
lines.translation: Permisi, saya baru tiba dengan penerbangan SQ 287 dari Jakarta, tetapi bagasi saya tidak muncul di baggage claim.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that, ma'am. May I have your boarding pass and baggage tag receipt, please?
lines.translation: Saya turut prihatin mendengarnya, Bu. Boleh saya lihat boarding pass dan tanda terima bagasi Anda?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Here they are. I'm quite worried because I have a connecting flight to Sydney in two hours, and I need some items from my suitcase.
lines.translation: Ini dia. Saya cukup khawatir karena saya punya penerbangan lanjutan ke Sydney dalam dua jam, dan saya memerlukan beberapa barang dari koper saya.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Let me check our system. It appears your luggage was left behind in Jakarta due to weight restrictions. It will arrive on the next flight in four hours.
lines.translation: Biar saya cek sistem kami. Terlihat bagasi Anda tertinggal di Jakarta karena pembatasan berat. Bagasi akan tiba dengan penerbangan berikutnya dalam empat jam.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: But I'll already be on my way to Sydney by then! Can you arrange to have it forwarded to my hotel in Sydney?
lines.translation: Tetapi saya sudah akan dalam perjalanan ke Sydney pada saat itu! Bisakah Anda mengatur agar bagasi dikirim ke hotel saya di Sydney?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Absolutely. We'll arrange free delivery to your accommodation. Could you please fill out this form with your Sydney hotel details?
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Kami akan mengatur pengiriman gratis ke akomodasi Anda. Bisakah Anda mengisi formulir ini dengan detail hotel Sydney Anda?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Thank you. Also, I'd like to know about filing a compensation claim for the inconvenience.
lines.translation: Terima kasih. Juga, saya ingin tahu tentang mengajukan klaim kompensasi atas ketidaknyamanan ini.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Of course. You're entitled to compensation. I'll provide you with a reference number and the claim form. You can submit it online within 30 days.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Anda berhak mendapat kompensasi. Saya akan memberikan nomor referensi dan formulir klaim. Anda dapat mengirimkannya secara online dalam 30 hari.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih dengan Mr. Khoirul untuk menangani situasi ketika penerbangan Anda dibatalkan dan Anda perlu direroute. Mr. Khoirul berperan sebagai petugas maskapai, dan Anda adalah penumpang yang mencari solusi.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good afternoon. I'm afraid I have some bad news. Your flight to London has been cancelled due to technical problems. How can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Oh no! This is quite urgent. I have an important meeting tomorrow morning in London. What are my options?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I understand your concern. We can reroute you through Paris with a two-hour layover, departing in 90 minutes. You'd arrive in London three hours later than originally planned.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That might work, but I'm concerned about my checked luggage. Will it be transferred automatically to the connecting flight?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Yes, we'll make sure your baggage is transferred. I'll tag it as priority. Also, because of the cancellation, you're entitled to meal vouchers and compensation.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Thank you, that's helpful. Could you also confirm that I won't need a transit visa for the Paris layover?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's correct. Since you're staying in the international transit area and it's under 24 hours, no transit visa is required. Let me print your new boarding passes.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Perfect. I'd also like to receive written confirmation of the compensation claim for my records.

quiz.question: My flight has been ___ for four hours due to mechanical issues.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'delayed' (bentuk past participle) karena kalimat ini menggunakan Present Perfect Passive (has been + past participle) untuk menunjukkan kejadian yang baru terjadi dan masih berdampak pada situasi sekarang.

quiz.question: I ___ my connecting flight because the first plane arrived late.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan Simple Past 'missed' karena ini adalah kejadian yang sudah selesai di masa lalu dengan waktu yang jelas (ketika pesawat pertama terlambat). Present Perfect akan digunakan jika dampaknya masih relevan sekarang tanpa menyebut waktu spesifik.

quiz.question: ___ you please check if my luggage has arrived on the next flight?
quiz.explanation: 'Could' adalah pilihan paling sopan dan formal untuk membuat permintaan di situasi bandara profesional. 'Can' terlalu kasual, dan 'Should' memiliki arti yang berbeda (seharusnya) bukan permintaan.

quiz.question: Passengers are being ___ to alternative flights due to the cancellation.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'transferred' (past participle) karena ini adalah Present Continuous Passive (are being + past participle). Passive voice digunakan karena fokusnya pada penumpang yang menerima tindakan, bukan siapa yang melakukan transfer.

quiz.question: I would like to ___ a compensation claim for my delayed baggage.
quiz.explanation: Collocation yang tepat adalah 'file a claim' dalam konteks formal seperti klaim kompensasi atau keluhan resmi. 'Make a claim' juga mungkin, tetapi 'file' lebih formal dan standar di industri penerbangan.

modules.title: Modals of Probability & Deduction: Must, Might, Can't in Everyday Reasoning
modules.objective: Menggunakan kata kerja bantu modal untuk menyimpulkan kepastian (must), kemungkinan (might/could), dan kemustahilan (can't).

theory.summary: Modal verbs untuk deduksi membantu kita menyatakan seberapa yakin kita terhadap suatu situasi saat ini. Saat kita melihat bukti dan menarik kesimpulan, kita menggunakan must (hampir pasti benar), might/could (mungkin benar), dan can't (hampir pasti tidak benar). Pola ini sangat berguna dalam percakapan sehari-hari ketika kita menganalisis situasi berdasarkan informasi yang kita miliki.
rules: MUST + bare infinitive = deduksi positif dengan kepastian tinggi (99% yakin). Formula: Subject + must + be/verb. Contoh: 'The lights are on. He must be home.' (Lampu menyala, jadi dia pasti di rumah)

MIGHT/COULD + bare infinitive = deduksi dengan kemungkinan sedang (50% yakin). Formula: Subject + might/could + be/verb. Contoh: 'She's not answering. She might be in a meeting.' (Dia tidak menjawab, mungkin sedang rapat)

CAN'T + bare infinitive = deduksi negatif dengan kepastian tinggi (hampir mustahil). Formula: Subject + can't + be/verb. Contoh: 'That can't be John. He's in London today.' (Itu pasti bukan John, dia sedang di London hari ini)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Penggunaan Mustn't untuk Deduksi Negatif
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa menggunakan mustn't untuk menyatakan deduksi negatif, padahal mustn't berarti 'prohibition' (larangan), bukan deduksi. Untuk deduksi negatif yang berarti 'hampir pasti tidak', gunakan can't.
commonTrap.wrong: He mustn't be at home. (Salah - ini berarti 'dia tidak boleh di rumah')
commonTrap.correct: He can't be at home. (Benar - ini berarti 'dia pasti tidak di rumah')

vocab.collocation: Based on the evidence, my deduction is that she's left the country.
There's a high probability that it will rain this afternoon.
You're making an assumption without knowing all the facts.
Can you explain the reasoning behind your decision?
The police found evidence that proves he was at the scene.
I can say with certainty that this is the best solution.
It's impossible to finish this project in one day.
After reviewing the data, we reached the conclusion that we need to change our strategy.
In this scenario, the best option might be to wait.
Her expression gave me a clue that something was wrong.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Tom sedang membicarakan rekan kerja mereka, Mark, yang tidak masuk kerja hari ini. Mereka menggunakan modal deduksi untuk menebak apa yang sedang terjadi.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Have you seen Mark today? He's not at his desk.
lines.translation: Kamu sudah lihat Mark hari ini? Dia tidak ada di mejanya.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: No, I haven't. He must be sick. He didn't look well yesterday.
lines.translation: Belum. Dia pasti sakit. Dia terlihat tidak sehat kemarin.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That can't be right. I just saw him post a photo on social media an hour ago from the gym.
lines.translation: Itu pasti salah. Aku baru saja melihat dia memposting foto di media sosial sejam yang lalu dari gym.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Really? Then he might be working from home today. He mentioned something about a delivery.
lines.translation: Benarkah? Kalau begitu dia mungkin sedang bekerja dari rumah hari ini. Dia menyebut sesuatu tentang pengiriman barang.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That's possible. Or he could be stuck in traffic. The roads are terrible this morning.
lines.translation: Itu mungkin. Atau dia bisa saja terjebak macet. Jalannya parah pagi ini.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Wait, I just got his message. He's at the dentist. He'll be here after lunch.
lines.translation: Tunggu, aku baru dapat pesannya. Dia di dokter gigi. Dia akan ke sini setelah makan siang.

speakingLab.context: Anda berlatih dengan Mr. Khoirul untuk membuat deduksi tentang berbagai situasi sehari-hari. Mr. Khoirul akan memberikan skenario dan Anda harus merespons dengan modal deduksi yang tepat.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we'll practice making deductions. I'll describe a situation and you tell me what you think using must, might, could, or can't. Ready? Here's the first one: Your neighbor's car is gone and all the lights in their house are off at 8 PM. What's your deduction?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: They must be out for the evening, or they might have gone on a trip.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent reasoning! Now, imagine you hear your colleague coughing badly and she looks very pale. What would you say?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: She must be ill. She can't be feeling well at all.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect use of can't! Here's a tricky one: Your friend said he'd meet you at 3 PM. It's now 3:45 and he's not here. He hasn't called. What might be happening?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: He might be stuck in traffic, or he could have forgotten about our meeting.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good possibilities! Last scenario: You see someone who looks exactly like your teacher, but your teacher told you yesterday she's traveling abroad this week. What's your conclusion?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That can't be her. She must be still abroad. It might be someone who looks similar.

quiz.question: The office is completely dark and locked. Everyone ___ have gone home already.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'must' karena bukti sangat kuat (kantor gelap dan terkunci) yang menunjukkan kepastian tinggi bahwa semua orang sudah pulang. Ini deduksi positif dengan confidence level 99%.

quiz.question: I'm not sure where Anna is. She ___ be at the library or the coffee shop.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'could' (atau 'might') karena kita tidak yakin dan ada beberapa kemungkinan. Ini menunjukkan probability sekitar 50%. 'Must' terlalu pasti dan 'can't' berarti mustahil, yang tidak sesuai konteks.

quiz.question: That ___ be Professor Chen. He's in Beijing giving a lecture right now.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'can't' untuk deduksi negatif dengan kepastian tinggi. Karena kita tahu Professor Chen sedang di Beijing, maka hampir mustahil orang itu adalah dia. Jangan gunakan 'mustn't' yang berarti larangan.

quiz.question: He's been studying for 12 hours straight. He ___ be exhausted by now.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'must' karena logika yang sangat kuat: belajar selama 12 jam tanpa henti hampir pasti membuat seseorang sangat lelah. Ini deduksi positif dengan tingkat kepastian sangat tinggi (99%).

quiz.question: She's not answering her phone. She ___ be in a meeting, or maybe her battery died.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'might' karena ada ketidakpastian dan beberapa kemungkinan dijelaskan (rapat atau baterai mati). Ini menunjukkan probability sedang (sekitar 50%), bukan kepastian tinggi yang memerlukan 'must'.

modules.title: Global Cuisine, Culinary Heritage & Expressing Dietary Preferences Politely
modules.objective: Mendiskusikan tradisi kuliner internasional, alergi makanan, preferensi vegetarian/halal, dan memesan menu secara spesifik.

theory.summary: Dalam konteks global, kemampuan mengekspresikan preferensi makanan dengan sopan sangat penting. Di level B1, Anda akan belajar cara menanyakan komposisi hidangan, menyampaikan alergi atau pembatasan diet, dan membuat permintaan khusus di restoran dengan bahasa yang halus dan profesional. Gunakan modal verbs seperti 'could' dan 'would' untuk kesopanan, serta frasa informatif seperti 'I have a dietary restriction' atau 'Does this contain...?' untuk komunikasi yang jelas.
rules: Gunakan 'Could you tell me...?' atau 'Would it be possible...?' untuk pertanyaan sopan: 'Could you tell me what ingredients are in this dish?' lebih formal daripada 'What's in this?'
Sampaikan alergi dengan jelas menggunakan 'I have a/an [adjective] allergy to...': 'I have a severe nut allergy' atau 'I'm allergic to shellfish' untuk memastikan keamanan
Gunakan 'Could I have...?' untuk permintaan modifikasi: 'Could I have the dressing on the side?' atau 'Could I have this without garlic, please?' menunjukkan kesopanan

Kosakata kuliner tingkat intermediate mencakup: savory (gurih), zesty (segar dan pedas), tender (empuk), simmer (memasak dengan api kecil), garnish (hiasan), marinate (merendam bumbu), bland (hambar), aromatic (harum)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan dalam Menyampaikan Alergi dan Preferensi
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa sering menggunakan bahasa yang terlalu langsung atau tidak cukup jelas saat menyampaikan pembatasan diet, yang bisa terdengar kasar atau menyebabkan kesalahpahaman berbahaya.
commonTrap.wrong: I don't eat meat. Take it out.
commonTrap.correct: I'm vegetarian. Could I have this dish without meat, please? Or would you recommend a vegetarian option?

vocab.collocation: I prefer savory dishes over sweet ones, especially for breakfast.
This salad has a zesty lemon dressing that really brightens the flavors.
The lamb was so tender it practically melted in my mouth.
Let the sauce simmer for about 20 minutes until it thickens.
The chef garnished the soup with fresh herbs and a drizzle of olive oil.
I have a severe nut allergy, so I need to avoid all tree nuts and peanuts.

vocab.meaning: berhubungan dengan diet atau pola makan
vocab.collocation: Do you have any dietary restrictions I should know about before ordering?
We marinate the chicken overnight in yogurt and spices for maximum flavor.
Indian cuisine uses aromatic spices like cardamom, cinnamon, and cumin.
The soup tasted a bit bland, so I added some salt and pepper.

dialogue.context: Sarah sedang makan malam di restoran Mediterranean bersama koleganya, Ahmad. Sarah memiliki alergi seafood dan Ahmad menjalankan diet halal. Mereka sedang memesan makanan kepada pelayan.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Good evening! Are you ready to order, or would you like a few more minutes?
lines.translation: Selamat malam! Apakah Anda siap memesan, atau Anda butuh waktu beberapa menit lagi?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: We're ready, thank you. Could you tell me what's in the seafood paella? I have a shellfish allergy.
lines.translation: Kami siap, terima kasih. Bisakah Anda jelaskan apa saja yang ada di seafood paella? Saya alergi kerang-kerangan.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: The paella contains mussels, prawns, and squid. But we also have a chicken and vegetable paella that's very popular.
lines.translation: Paella tersebut berisi kerang, udang, dan cumi. Tapi kami juga punya paella ayam dan sayuran yang sangat populer.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Perfect! I'll have the chicken paella, please. Could I have it without the bell peppers?
lines.translation: Sempurna! Saya akan pesan paella ayam. Bisakah saya minta tanpa paprika?

lines.speaker: Ahmad
lines.text: Excuse me, does your restaurant serve halal meat? It's important for my dietary requirements.
lines.translation: Permisi, apakah restoran Anda menyajikan daging halal? Ini penting untuk kebutuhan diet saya.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Yes, all our lamb and chicken dishes are prepared with halal-certified meat. I'd recommend our lamb tagine—it's very tender and aromatic.
lines.translation: Ya, semua hidangan domba dan ayam kami disiapkan dengan daging bersertifikat halal. Saya rekomendasikan lamb tagine kami—sangat empuk dan harum.

lines.speaker: Ahmad
lines.text: That sounds excellent. I'll have the lamb tagine. Could I have the couscous on the side instead of mixed in?
lines.translation: Kedengarannya bagus sekali. Saya akan pesan lamb tagine. Bisakah saya minta couscous-nya terpisah, bukan dicampur?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Absolutely, no problem at all. I'll make sure the kitchen notes both of your special requests.
lines.translation: Tentu saja, tidak masalah sama sekali. Saya akan pastikan dapur mencatat kedua permintaan khusus Anda.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berbicara dengan Mr. Khoirul, seorang AI tutor, dalam skenario roleplay di restoran fusion Asia. Mr. Khoirul berperan sebagai pelayan, dan Anda adalah tamu yang memiliki alergi kacang serta preferensi untuk makanan vegetarian. Latih cara menyampaikan kebutuhan diet Anda dengan sopan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good evening! Welcome to Fusion Garden. Have you dined with us before? Our menu features dishes from Thailand, Japan, and Vietnam.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good evening! No, this is my first time. The menu looks amazing. Could you help me with something? I'm vegetarian and I have a severe peanut allergy.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Of course! I'm glad you mentioned that. Many of our Thai dishes use peanuts, so I'll point out the safe options. Are you also avoiding other nuts, or just peanuts?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Just peanuts, thankfully. Other nuts are fine. Could you tell me which vegetarian dishes would be completely peanut-free?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Certainly! Our vegetable green curry is excellent and peanut-free. We also have a tofu teriyaki bowl and Vietnamese spring rolls with a tamarind sauce instead of peanut sauce. Would any of those interest you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The green curry sounds delicious! Could you tell me what vegetables are in it? And is it very spicy?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: It has bamboo shoots, bell peppers, Thai basil, and eggplant. The spice level is medium, but we can make it mild if you prefer. Would you like me to ask the kitchen to adjust it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Medium is perfect for me. I'll have the vegetable green curry, please. Could I have extra rice on the side? And just to confirm—no peanuts anywhere in the preparation?

quiz.question:
When asking about ingredients due to an allergy, which phrase is most appropriate?

A: What's in this?
B: I can't eat nuts.
C: ___
options: Tell me everything in this dish.
Could you tell me what this dish contains? I have a nut allergy.
Does this have nuts? I don't like them.
quiz.answer: Could you tell me what this dish contains? I have a nut allergy.
quiz.explanation: Pilihan ini paling tepat karena menggunakan 'Could you...' yang sopan, menjelaskan alasan spesifik (alergi, bukan preferensi), dan meminta informasi lengkap tentang komposisi hidangan. Ini memastikan komunikasi yang jelas dan aman.

quiz.question:
Which word best describes meat that is soft and easy to chew?

___ lamb fell apart with just a fork.
quiz.explanation: 'Tender' adalah kata yang tepat untuk menggambarkan daging yang empuk dan mudah dikunyah. 'Zesty' menggambarkan rasa segar dan pedas, sementara 'savory' berarti gurih. Dalam konteks tekstur daging, 'tender' adalah pilihan yang benar.

quiz.question:
Complete the polite request for a menu modification:

___ the dressing on the side, please?
quiz.explanation: 'Could I have' adalah bentuk paling sopan untuk membuat permintaan di restoran. Modal verb 'could' menunjukkan kesopanan, berbeda dengan 'I want' atau 'Give me' yang terlalu langsung dan bisa terdengar kasar dalam konteks formal.

quiz.question:
What does 'simmer' mean in cooking?

The recipe says to ___ the sauce for 15 minutes.
quiz.explanation: 'Simmer' berarti memasak dengan api kecil, di mana cairan hampir mendidih tapi tidak sampai mendidih penuh. Ini adalah teknik memasak yang lembut untuk mengembangkan rasa tanpa mengurangi cairan terlalu cepat atau merusak bahan makanan.

quiz.question:
Which phrase correctly expresses a dietary restriction?

I follow a halal diet. ___
options: Does your restaurant use halal meat? It's important for my dietary requirements.
I only eat halal so change the menu for me.
quiz.answer: Does your restaurant use halal meat? It's important for my dietary requirements.
quiz.explanation: Frasa ini sopan karena menggunakan pertanyaan, bukan perintah, dan menjelaskan pentingnya kebutuhan diet tanpa menuntut. Pilihan lain terlalu demanding atau tidak sopan untuk konteks komunikasi di restoran.

modules.title: Passive Voice in Ongoing Operations: Present Continuous & Present Perfect Passives
modules.objective: Menjelaskan proses manufaktur, renovasi, dan status sistem menggunakan kalimat pasif bentuk continuous dan perfect.

theory.summary: Present Continuous Passive dan Present Perfect Passive digunakan untuk menjelaskan proses yang sedang berlangsung atau yang sudah selesai tanpa menekankan pelakunya. Struktur ini sangat berguna dalam konteks profesional seperti laporan proyek, manufaktur, dan operasi sistem. Present Continuous Passive (is/are being + V3) menggambarkan aksi yang sedang terjadi saat ini, sedangkan Present Perfect Passive (has/have been + V3) menunjukkan aksi yang sudah selesai dengan hasil yang masih relevan.
rules: Present Continuous Passive: is/are being + past participle (V3). Contoh: The factory is being renovated. / New products are being developed.
Present Perfect Passive: has/have been + past participle (V3). Contoh: The report has been submitted. / All employees have been notified.

Gunakan Present Continuous Passive untuk proses yang sedang berlangsung sekarang, dan Present Perfect Passive untuk aksi yang sudah selesai dengan dampak hingga saat ini. Contoh: The bridge is being repaired (sedang berlangsung) vs. The bridge has been repaired (sudah selesai).

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Penggunaan Being dan Been
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa sering keliru menggunakan 'being' untuk Present Perfect atau 'been' untuk Present Continuous. Ingat: 'being' untuk proses sedang berlangsung, 'been' untuk proses yang sudah selesai.
commonTrap.wrong: The documents have being signed yesterday.
commonTrap.correct: The documents have been signed. / The documents are being signed right now.

vocab.collocation: The office building is being renovated to create more workspaces.
These smartphones are being manufactured in our new factory.
New security cameras have been installed throughout the building.
All equipment is being inspected before the production starts.
Our computer systems have been upgraded to the latest version.
All staff members have been notified about the schedule change.
The new products are being assembled by our skilled workers.
Your order has been dispatched and will arrive tomorrow.
New safety procedures are being implemented across all departments.
The budget increase has been authorized by the management.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Tom sedang membahas progress renovasi kantor dan update sistem IT perusahaan mereka.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Hi Tom, have you seen the third floor? It looks completely different now.
lines.translation: Hai Tom, sudah lihat lantai tiga? Terlihat sangat berbeda sekarang.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yes! The meeting rooms are being renovated this week. They're installing new furniture and equipment.
lines.translation: Ya! Ruang rapat sedang direnovasi minggu ini. Mereka sedang memasang furnitur dan peralatan baru.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That's great. Have the new computers been delivered yet?
lines.translation: Bagus sekali. Apakah komputer baru sudah dikirim?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: They have been delivered, but they're still being set up by the IT team. It should be finished by Friday.
lines.translation: Sudah dikirim, tapi masih sedang diatur oleh tim IT. Seharusnya selesai hari Jumat.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Perfect timing. I heard that all staff members have been notified about the training session next Monday.
lines.translation: Waktunya pas. Saya dengar semua staff sudah diberitahu tentang sesi pelatihan Senin depan.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yes, the training materials are being prepared right now. The system upgrade has been completed successfully.
lines.translation: Ya, materi pelatihan sedang disiapkan sekarang. Upgrade sistem sudah diselesaikan dengan sukses.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Excellent! Are the old files being transferred to the new system?
lines.translation: Bagus sekali! Apakah file-file lama sedang dipindahkan ke sistem baru?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: They're being transferred as we speak. Everything should be ready before the training starts.
lines.translation: Sedang dipindahkan saat kita bicara ini. Semuanya seharusnya siap sebelum pelatihan dimulai.

speakingLab.context: Anda adalah seorang project manager yang sedang melaporkan progress proyek kepada Mr. Khoirul. Gunakan Present Continuous Passive untuk menjelaskan apa yang sedang dikerjakan, dan Present Perfect Passive untuk menjelaskan apa yang sudah selesai.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Thanks for meeting with me today. Can you give me an update on the warehouse renovation project?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi Mr. Khoirul! Of course. The main structure has been completed, and the electrical system is being installed right now.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That sounds good. What about the security systems? Have they been set up yet?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The cameras have been installed, but the alarm system is still being tested by the security team.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. And how about the inventory management software? Is it ready for use?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The software has been purchased and is being configured by our IT department. It should be ready next week.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect. Have all the necessary permits been approved by the authorities?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, all permits have been approved. We're on track to complete the project by the end of this month.

quiz.question: The new factory ___ by international investors next year.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini menggunakan 'next year' yang menunjukkan waktu future, bukan present continuous atau present perfect. Meskipun bukan passive continuous/perfect, pilihan 'will be built' adalah satu-satunya yang gramatikal benar untuk konteks future.

quiz.question: All employees ___ about the new policy last week.
quiz.explanation: Penggunaan 'last week' menunjukkan waktu lampau yang spesifik, sehingga menggunakan Simple Past Passive 'were notified', bukan Present Perfect Passive yang digunakan untuk aksi yang relevan dengan sekarang.

quiz.question: The documents ___ right now, so please wait a moment.
quiz.explanation: Frasa 'right now' menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat ini, sehingga menggunakan Present Continuous Passive 'are being processed' untuk menggambarkan proses yang sedang terjadi.

quiz.question: The server ___ successfully, and now we can access the new features.
quiz.explanation: Kata 'successfully' dan 'now we can access' menunjukkan bahwa upgrade sudah selesai dengan hasil yang masih relevan sekarang, sehingga menggunakan Present Perfect Passive 'has been upgraded'.

quiz.question: New safety equipment ___ in all production areas at the moment.
quiz.explanation: Frasa 'at the moment' menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung sekarang di semua area, sehingga menggunakan Present Continuous Passive 'is being installed' untuk menggambarkan proses instalasi yang sedang terjadi.

modules.title: Linking Ideas with Precision: In order to, So that, Because of & Due to
modules.objective: Menggabungkan ide kompleks menggunakan konjungsi tujuan dan penyebab formal untuk tulisan dan pidato yang koheren.

theory.summary: Dalam bahasa Inggris formal, kita menggunakan konjungsi khusus untuk menunjukkan tujuan dan penyebab dengan presisi. Konjungsi tujuan seperti 'in order to' dan 'so that' menjelaskan alasan melakukan sesuatu, sedangkan 'because of' dan 'due to' menunjukkan penyebab dari suatu situasi. Memahami perbedaan struktur gramatikal setelah setiap konjungsi ini sangat penting untuk menulis laporan, email profesional, dan pidato formal di level B1.
rules: IN ORDER TO + verb (infinitive): Digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan dengan struktur formal. Contoh: 'She studies every night in order to pass the exam.' (Subjek kedua klausa harus sama)

SO THAT + subject + modal verb (can/could/will/would): Digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan dengan penjelasan lebih lengkap. Contoh: 'He speaks slowly so that everyone can understand him.' (Bisa digunakan dengan subjek berbeda)

BECAUSE OF / DUE TO + noun phrase: Digunakan untuk menyatakan penyebab dengan kata benda atau frasa nomina. Contoh: 'The flight was cancelled due to bad weather.' atau 'She succeeded because of her hard work.'
BECAUSE + subject + verb (clause): Digunakan untuk menyatakan penyebab dengan klausa lengkap. Contoh: 'They arrived late because the traffic was heavy.' (Memerlukan subjek dan kata kerja)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Mencampur Struktur Noun Phrase dan Clause
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa level B1 sering salah menggunakan 'because of' diikuti klausa lengkap, atau 'because' diikuti noun phrase. Ingat: 'because of/due to' hanya diikuti kata benda atau frasa nomina, sedangkan 'because' harus diikuti subjek + kata kerja.
commonTrap.wrong: The meeting was postponed because of the manager was sick.
commonTrap.correct: The meeting was postponed because the manager was sick. ATAU The meeting was postponed because of the manager's illness.

vocab.collocation: We need precision in our measurements to ensure accurate results.
They decided to postpone the conference due to technical difficulties.
Please arrive early in order to ensure you get a good seat.
Due to unforeseen circumstances, we had to change our travel plans.
He worked overtime so that the project outcome would exceed expectations.
We couldn't hire more staff because of budget constraints.
The company will implement new policies in order to improve productivity.
Could you clarify that point so that we all understand the requirement?
The train service was affected due to a major disruption on the line.
We changed the meeting time in order to accommodate everyone's schedule.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Tom adalah rekan kerja yang sedang membahas persiapan presentasi penting untuk klien internasional. Mereka mendiskusikan alasan dan tujuan dari berbagai keputusan persiapan mereka.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Tom, I've prepared extra handouts so that all the participants can follow along easily during our presentation.
lines.translation: Tom, saya sudah menyiapkan handout tambahan agar semua peserta bisa mengikuti dengan mudah selama presentasi kita.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's excellent. I also arrived early in order to test all the equipment before the clients arrive.
lines.translation: Itu bagus sekali. Saya juga datang lebih awal untuk menguji semua peralatan sebelum klien datang.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Good thinking. Actually, we need to simplify slide 7 because of the feedback we received from the manager yesterday.
lines.translation: Pemikiran yang bagus. Sebenarnya, kita perlu menyederhanakan slide 7 karena masukan yang kita terima dari manajer kemarin.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I agree. The previous version was too technical. Should we include more examples so that the concepts are clearer?
lines.translation: Saya setuju. Versi sebelumnya terlalu teknis. Haruskah kita memasukkan lebih banyak contoh agar konsepnya lebih jelas?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Definitely. Also, the meeting room was changed due to renovation work on the third floor.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Juga, ruang rapat diganti karena pekerjaan renovasi di lantai tiga.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Oh, I didn't know that. We're now in Conference Room B, right? I'll send an update email in order to inform everyone about the location change.
lines.translation: Oh, saya tidak tahu itu. Kita sekarang di Ruang Konferensi B, kan? Saya akan mengirim email pembaruan untuk menginformasikan semua orang tentang perubahan lokasi.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Perfect. Let's do a final run-through because we only have 30 minutes left before they arrive.
lines.translation: Sempurna. Mari kita lakukan latihan terakhir karena kita hanya punya waktu 30 menit lagi sebelum mereka tiba.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Agreed. I want everything to be perfect so that we can win this contract.
lines.translation: Setuju. Saya ingin semuanya sempurna agar kita bisa memenangkan kontrak ini.

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul membantu Anda berlatih menggunakan konjungsi tujuan dan penyebab dalam konteks merencanakan acara kampus. Anda berperan sebagai panitia acara yang menjelaskan keputusan dan rencana Anda.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I heard you're organizing the campus cultural festival. Can you tell me why you chose the main hall as the venue?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi Mr. Khoirul! We chose the main hall because of its large capacity. It can accommodate up to 500 people.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That makes sense. What about the date? I noticed you changed it from the original plan.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, we postponed it by one week due to the midterm examination schedule. We wanted to avoid conflicts with students' exams.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good decision. What preparations have you made so far?

turns.speaker: You
