turns.text: We've hired professional sound equipment in order to ensure the best audio quality for the performances. We also created a detailed program so that everyone knows the schedule.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent planning! Have you considered promoting the event?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, we're using social media extensively so that we can reach more students. We're also putting up posters because many students don't check social media regularly.

quiz.question: The company implemented new security measures ___ protect customer data more effectively.
quiz.explanation: 'In order to' adalah pilihan yang tepat karena diikuti oleh kata kerja infinitif 'protect'. Strukturnya: in order to + verb. 'So that' memerlukan subject + modal verb, dan 'because of' digunakan untuk menyatakan penyebab, bukan tujuan.

quiz.question: The flight was delayed ___ severe weather conditions at the destination airport.
quiz.explanation: 'Due to' benar karena diikuti noun phrase 'severe weather conditions'. 'Because' memerlukan klausa lengkap (subject + verb), sedangkan 'so that' digunakan untuk tujuan, bukan penyebab.

quiz.question: She speaks three languages fluently ___ she can communicate with international clients easily.
quiz.explanation: 'So that' benar karena diikuti klausa lengkap 'she can communicate...' dengan subject dan modal verb 'can'. Strukturnya: so that + subject + modal + verb. 'In order to' hanya diikuti verb infinitif, dan 'because of' untuk penyebab dengan noun phrase.

quiz.question: Many students failed the exam ___ they didn't study the recommended materials thoroughly.
quiz.explanation: 'Because' tepat karena diikuti klausa lengkap 'they didn't study...' dengan subject + verb. 'Because of' hanya diikuti noun phrase, dan 'in order to' digunakan untuk tujuan, bukan penyebab.

quiz.question: The manager scheduled additional training sessions ___ the team's poor performance in the last quarter.
quiz.explanation: 'Because of' benar karena diikuti noun phrase 'the team's poor performance...'. Ini menyatakan penyebab dengan struktur noun phrase. 'Because' memerlukan klausa (subject + verb), dan 'so that' digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan.

modules.title: Urban Living vs Rural Peace: Demographic Trends, Nuanced Adjectives & Lifestyle Choices
modules.objective: Membandingkan gaya hidup perkotaan dan pedesaan dengan kata sifat bernuansa tinggi dan membedah tren sosial.

theory.summary: Dalam modul ini, kita akan mempelajari cara membandingkan kehidupan perkotaan dan pedesaan menggunakan kata sifat bernuansa dan struktur perbandingan tingkat lanjut. Pola 'the + comparative, the + comparative' digunakan untuk menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat antara dua hal yang meningkat atau menurun secara bersamaan. Misalnya, 'The bigger the city, the higher the cost of living' menunjukkan bahwa semakin besar kota, semakin tinggi biaya hidupnya. Struktur ini sangat berguna untuk membahas tren demografis, gaya hidup, dan perbandingan kompleks di level B1.
rules: Pola Perbandingan Ganda: 'The + comparative + subject + verb, the + comparative + subject + verb' - Contoh: The more crowded the streets are, the longer your commute takes.

Kata Sifat Bernuansa untuk Urban: bustling (ramai penuh aktivitas), hectic (sibuk membingungkan), vibrant (penuh kehidupan), cosmopolitan (beragam budaya), polluted (tercemar) - Contoh: Tokyo is a bustling metropolis with excellent infrastructure.

Kata Sifat Bernuansa untuk Rural: tranquil (tenang damai), peaceful (tentram), isolated (terpencil), scenic (pemandangan indah), tight-knit (komunitas erat) - Contoh: They moved to a tranquil village to escape the hectic city life.

Ekspresi Gaya Hidup: cost of living (biaya hidup), air quality (kualitas udara), public transport (transportasi umum), career opportunities (peluang karier), sense of community (rasa kebersamaan) - Contoh: The cost of living in rural areas is significantly lower than in cities.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Urutan dalam Pola Perbandingan Ganda
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa lupa menggunakan 'the' sebelum kata sifat komparatif di kedua bagian kalimat, atau salah meletakkan subjek dan verb. Pola yang benar harus selalu 'the + comparative + subject + verb' di kedua klausa.
commonTrap.wrong: More expensive the city, more difficult to save money.
commonTrap.correct: The more expensive the city is, the more difficult it is to save money.

vocab.collocation: We live in a bustling metropolis where something is always happening day and night.
After years in London, she moved to a tranquil village in the countryside.

vocab.meaning: perjalanan rutin dari rumah ke tempat kerja
vocab.collocation: My daily commute takes two hours because of the heavy traffic in the city.

vocab.meaning: sistem dasar dan fasilitas yang diperlukan (jalan, listrik, air)
vocab.collocation: The city has excellent infrastructure with modern hospitals and efficient public transport.
Air quality in rural areas is much better than in industrial cities.

vocab.meaning: jumlah uang yang dibutuhkan untuk kebutuhan hidup dasar
vocab.collocation: The cost of living in major cities has increased dramatically over the past decade.
City life can be hectic, with constant noise and endless deadlines to meet.
Some rural communities are quite isolated and lack access to modern amenities.

vocab.meaning: komunitas yang sangat dekat dan saling mendukung
vocab.collocation: Rural villages often have tight-knit communities where everyone knows each other.

vocab.meaning: kota besar dan penting dengan banyak penduduk
vocab.collocation: New York is a global metropolis that attracts millions of tourists every year.

dialogue.context: Emma dan David adalah teman kuliah yang sedang membahas rencana hidup setelah lulus. Emma ingin pindah ke kota besar untuk mengejar karier, sementara David lebih tertarik pada kehidupan pedesaan yang tenang.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: I can't wait to move to London after graduation. The bigger the city, the more career opportunities there are!
lines.translation: Aku tidak sabar pindah ke London setelah lulus. Semakin besar kotanya, semakin banyak peluang kariernya!

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Really? I'm planning to move to a tranquil village in Scotland. City life is too hectic for me.
lines.translation: Benarkah? Aku berencana pindah ke desa yang tenang di Skotlandia. Kehidupan kota terlalu sibuk untukku.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: But don't you worry about being isolated? Rural areas lack the infrastructure and entertainment options.
lines.translation: Tapi kamu tidak khawatir terisolasi? Daerah pedesaan kurang infrastruktur dan pilihan hiburan.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: That's exactly what I want! The more peaceful the environment, the happier I'll be. Plus, the air quality is so much better.
lines.translation: Itu persis yang aku inginkan! Semakin damai lingkungannya, semakin bahagia aku. Lagipula, kualitas udaranya jauh lebih baik.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Fair point, but the cost of living in cities isn't as bad as people think if you share accommodation.
lines.translation: Benar juga, tapi biaya hidup di kota tidak seburuk yang orang pikirkan kalau kamu berbagi akomodasi.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Maybe, but I don't want a two-hour commute every day. In a village, everything is within walking distance.
lines.translation: Mungkin, tapi aku tidak mau perjalanan dua jam setiap hari. Di desa, semuanya dalam jarak berjalan kaki.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: I guess we want different things. I need the bustling energy of a metropolis to feel alive!
lines.translation: Kurasa kita menginginkan hal yang berbeda. Aku butuh energi ramai dari kota besar untuk merasa hidup!

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: And I need the tight-knit community and scenic landscapes. To each their own, right?
lines.translation: Dan aku butuh komunitas yang erat dan pemandangan indah. Setiap orang berbeda, kan?

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul ingin membantu Anda mempraktikkan perbandingan antara kehidupan kota dan desa menggunakan pola perbandingan ganda dan kata sifat bernuansa. Anda akan berdiskusi tentang preferensi gaya hidup Anda.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today let's discuss urban and rural lifestyles. Where do you currently live, and what do you think about it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi Mr. Khoirul! I live in a small town. It's quite peaceful but sometimes I feel it's too quiet.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Interesting! Can you use a double comparative to describe how city size affects lifestyle? Try using 'the bigger... the more...'

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Sure! The bigger the city is, the more entertainment options you have available.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Now tell me, what do you think is the main advantage of rural living compared to urban areas?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think rural areas have much better air quality and are more tranquil than bustling cities.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect use of nuanced adjectives! What about the disadvantages? Can you mention at least two challenges of rural life?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, rural communities can be quite isolated, and they often lack good infrastructure like hospitals and public transport.

quiz.question: ___ the city grows, ___ difficult it becomes to find affordable housing.
quiz.explanation: Pola perbandingan ganda menggunakan 'the + comparative' di kedua bagian kalimat. 'Big' menjadi 'bigger' (comparative), dan kita tambahkan 'the' sebelumnya. 'Difficult' menggunakan 'more difficult', jadi pola lengkapnya 'the more difficult'.

quiz.question: Life in a ___ metropolis like Tokyo can be exciting but exhausting at the same time.
quiz.explanation: 'Bustling' artinya ramai penuh aktivitas, yang tepat menggambarkan kota besar seperti Tokyo. 'Tranquil' berarti tenang (cocok untuk desa), dan 'isolated' berarti terpencil (juga tidak cocok untuk metropolis besar).

quiz.question: The ___ in rural areas is significantly lower than in major cities, making it easier to save money.
quiz.explanation: 'Cost of living' (biaya hidup) adalah frasa yang tepat karena konteks kalimat membahas tentang kemudahan menabung. 'Commute' adalah perjalanan kerja, dan 'air quality' adalah kualitas udara, keduanya tidak relevan dengan penghematan uang.

quiz.question: Many people move to the countryside because they want to escape the ___ pace of city life.
quiz.explanation: 'Hectic' berarti sangat sibuk dan penuh tekanan, yang menggambarkan kehidupan kota yang ingin dihindari. 'Peaceful' (damai) dan 'scenic' (pemandangan indah) adalah kata sifat positif yang menggambarkan pedesaan, bukan sesuatu yang ingin dihindari.

quiz.question: Rural villages often have ___ communities where neighbors support each other and everyone knows everyone.
quiz.explanation: 'Tight-knit' menggambarkan komunitas yang sangat dekat dan saling mendukung, yang khas di desa-desa. 'Isolated' berarti terpencil (sifat geografis, bukan sifat hubungan sosial), dan 'bustling' berarti ramai (lebih cocok untuk kota).

modules.title: Habitual Past & Adaptations: Used To vs Would vs Be/Get Used To
modules.objective: Menguasai perbedaan kebiasaan masa lalu (used to / would) dengan proses adaptasi kebiasaan baru (be/get used to + V-ing).

theory.summary: Modul ini membahas tiga struktur yang sering membingungkan: 'used to', 'would', dan 'be/get used to'. Ketiganya terlihat mirip tetapi memiliki fungsi sangat berbeda. 'Used to' dan 'would' membicarakan kebiasaan di masa lalu yang sekarang sudah tidak dilakukan lagi, sedangkan 'be/get used to' membicarakan proses adaptasi terhadap situasi baru atau kebiasaan yang sudah menjadi normal. Memahami perbedaan ini penting untuk menceritakan pengalaman masa lalu dan menjelaskan proses penyesuaian diri dalam kehidupan sehari-hari atau lingkungan kerja baru.
rules: USED TO + infinitive: Menyatakan kebiasaan atau keadaan di masa lalu yang sekarang sudah tidak ada lagi. Formula: Subject + used to + verb (infinitive). Contoh: 'I used to live in Jakarta' (sekarang tidak lagi), 'She used to be a teacher' (sekarang bukan guru).

WOULD + infinitive: Menyatakan aksi berulang di masa lalu (kebiasaan), TETAPI tidak bisa untuk keadaan/status. Biasanya perlu konteks waktu yang jelas. Formula: Subject + would + verb (infinitive). Contoh: 'Every weekend, we would go to the beach' (aksi berulang). TIDAK BISA: 'I would live in Jakarta' atau 'She would be a teacher'.

BE USED TO + gerund/noun: Menyatakan sudah terbiasa dengan sesuatu (kondisi sudah normal/familiar). Formula: Subject + be (am/is/are/was/were) + used to + V-ing/noun. Contoh: 'I am used to waking up early' (sudah terbiasa), 'She is used to the cold weather' (sudah terbiasa dengan cuaca dingin).

GET USED TO + gerund/noun: Menyatakan proses menjadi terbiasa (sedang beradaptasi). Formula: Subject + get/gets/got + used to + V-ing/noun. Contoh: 'I'm getting used to working from home' (sedang dalam proses terbiasa), 'It took me months to get used to the new system' (butuh waktu untuk terbiasa).

commonTrap.trapTitle: Jebakan: Mencampur 'Used To' dengan 'Be Used To'
commonTrap.explanation: Kesalahan paling umum adalah menggunakan infinitive setelah 'be used to' atau menggunakan gerund setelah 'used to'. Ingat: 'used to' (kebiasaan lama) diikuti INFINITIVE, sedangkan 'be/get used to' (terbiasa/adaptasi) diikuti GERUND atau NOUN. Bentuk 'to' di sini adalah preposisi, bukan bagian dari infinitive.
commonTrap.wrong: I am used to wake up early. / I used to waking up at 5 AM.
commonTrap.correct: I am used to waking up early. / I used to wake up at 5 AM.

vocab.collocation: It took me several weeks to adapt to the new work environment.
Moving to a new country requires a big adjustment in your daily routine.
I used to have a very strict morning routine when I was younger.
I'm still getting used to the long commute to my new office.
Initially, I found it difficult to work remotely, but now I'm used to it.
I gradually got used to speaking English at work every day.
I can still recall the days when we would play outside every afternoon.
The office atmosphere is very different now; I'm getting used to the open-plan layout.
The transition from student life to working life was challenging at first.
I feel nostalgic when I think about how we would spend summers at my grandparents' house.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Mike sedang minum kopi sambil membicarakan perubahan dalam hidup mereka. Sarah baru saja pindah ke kota baru untuk pekerjaan, sementara Mike mengenang masa lalunya.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I'm still getting used to living in this city. Everything feels so different from my hometown.
lines.translation: Aku masih dalam proses terbiasa tinggal di kota ini. Semuanya terasa sangat berbeda dari kampung halamanku.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I know what you mean. When I first moved here, I would get lost every single day! But now I'm used to the complicated metro system.
lines.translation: Aku paham maksudmu. Ketika pertama kali pindah ke sini, aku akan tersesat setiap hari! Tapi sekarang aku sudah terbiasa dengan sistem metro yang rumit.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: How long did it take you to adapt? I used to walk everywhere in my old town, but here I have to take the train.
lines.translation: Berapa lama waktu yang kamu butuhkan untuk beradaptasi? Dulu aku biasa jalan kaki ke mana-mana di kota lamaku, tapi di sini aku harus naik kereta.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: About three months. Initially, the noise and crowds bothered me, but I gradually got used to it.
lines.translation: Sekitar tiga bulan. Pada awalnya, kebisingan dan keramaian menggangguku, tapi aku perlahan-lahan terbiasa.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That's reassuring. I really miss my old routine. Every morning, I would have breakfast at this small café near my apartment.
lines.translation: Itu menenangkan. Aku sangat merindukan rutinitas lamaku. Setiap pagi, aku akan sarapan di kafe kecil dekat apartemenku.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I feel nostalgic too sometimes. I used to live near the beach, and my friends and I would go swimming almost every weekend.
lines.translation: Aku juga kadang merasa nostalgia. Dulu aku tinggal dekat pantai, dan teman-temanku dan aku akan pergi berenang hampir setiap akhir pekan.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That sounds amazing. Are you used to the fast-paced lifestyle here now?
lines.translation: Kedengarannya luar biasa. Apakah kamu sudah terbiasa dengan gaya hidup yang cepat di sini sekarang?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yes, completely! Actually, I can't imagine living anywhere else now. You'll get used to it too, trust me.
lines.translation: Ya, sepenuhnya! Sebenarnya, aku tidak bisa membayangkan tinggal di tempat lain sekarang. Kamu juga akan terbiasa, percaya padaku.

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul ingin membantu Anda mempraktikkan penggunaan 'used to', 'would', dan 'be/get used to' dengan membicarakan pengalaman adaptasi Anda. Dia akan bertanya tentang kebiasaan masa lalu Anda dan bagaimana Anda beradaptasi dengan perubahan dalam hidup.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today, I'd like to talk about changes and adaptations in your life. Let's start with this: What's something you used to do regularly when you were younger, but you don't do anymore?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: When I was younger, I used to play video games every day after school. Now I rarely have time for that.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Interesting! So your routine has changed. Can you tell me about a specific activity you and your friends would do together back then? Use 'would' to describe it.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Every weekend, my friends and I would meet at the park and play football until it got dark.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect use of 'would'! Now, have you experienced any big changes recently? Maybe a new job, new schedule, or new environment? Tell me something you're getting used to right now.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I'm getting used to waking up earlier for my new job. It was difficult at first, but it's becoming easier.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! That's the adaptation process. And is there something about your new situation that you're already completely used to? Something that felt strange before but is normal now?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm used to taking the crowded train during rush hour now. Initially, I found it very stressful, but now it doesn't bother me anymore.

quiz.question: When I was a child, I ___ to school every day because it was only five minutes away.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'used to walk' karena kita membicarakan kebiasaan masa lalu (masa kecil) yang sekarang sudah tidak dilakukan lagi. 'Would walk' secara teknis juga bisa digunakan, tetapi 'used to' lebih natural untuk kebiasaan umum masa lalu. 'Am used to walking' salah karena ini untuk menyatakan sudah terbiasa (kondisi sekarang), bukan kebiasaan masa lalu.

quiz.question: After living in London for six months, I finally ___ driving on the left side of the road.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'got used to' karena kalimat ini menjelaskan proses adaptasi yang sudah selesai (finally = akhirnya). 'Got used to' diikuti gerund (driving) untuk menunjukkan bahwa seseorang sudah melalui proses dan sekarang terbiasa. 'Used to' dan 'would' salah karena keduanya untuk kebiasaan masa lalu, bukan proses adaptasi.

quiz.question: Every summer, we ___ visit our grandparents in the countryside and help them with the farm work.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'would' karena kalimat ini menggambarkan aksi berulang di masa lalu (every summer) dengan konteks waktu yang jelas. 'Would' cocok untuk menggambarkan kebiasaan spesifik yang dilakukan berulang kali. 'Are used to' salah karena ini untuk kondisi sekarang (terbiasa), dan 'got used to' salah karena ini untuk proses adaptasi, bukan aksi berulang.

quiz.question: I ___ the spicy food here yet. It's still too hot for me, but I'm trying.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'am not used to' karena kalimat ini menjelaskan bahwa seseorang belum terbiasa dengan makanan pedas (kondisi sekarang). Kata 'yet' (belum) menunjukkan kondisi saat ini. 'Didn't use to' salah karena ini untuk kebiasaan masa lalu yang negatif. 'Wouldn't' salah karena ini untuk penolakan atau kebiasaan di masa lalu, bukan kondisi sekarang.

quiz.question: My grandmother ___ tell us fascinating stories about her youth before bedtime. We loved those moments.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'would' karena kalimat ini menggambarkan aksi berulang di masa lalu (menceritakan kisah sebelum tidur). Konteks 'before bedtime' dan kata kerja 'loved' (past tense) menunjukkan ini adalah memori masa lalu. 'Is used to' salah karena ini untuk kondisi sekarang (terbiasa), dan 'gets used to' salah karena ini untuk proses adaptasi yang sedang berlangsung.

modules.title: Job Interviews: Showcasing Strengths, Describing Challenges & Asking Strategic Questions
modules.objective: Menjawab pertanyaan wawancara kerja standar dengan metode STAR, memaparkan kelemahan secara positif, dan menanyakan budaya kerja.

theory.summary: Wawancara kerja dalam bahasa Inggris memerlukan strategi khusus untuk menjawab pertanyaan secara efektif. Metode STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) membantu Anda menyusun jawaban yang terstruktur dan meyakinkan. Saat menjelaskan kekuatan, gunakan contoh konkret dari pengalaman nyata. Untuk kelemahan, paparkan dengan cara positif dengan menunjukkan upaya perbaikan. Mengajukan pertanyaan strategis tentang budaya kerja menunjukkan ketertarikan Anda yang serius terhadap posisi tersebut.
rules: STAR Method: Situation (jelaskan konteks), Task (tugas yang dihadapi), Action (tindakan yang diambil), Result (hasil yang dicapai). Contoh: 'In my previous role (S), I needed to meet a tight deadline (T), so I organized daily check-ins with the team (A), and we completed the project two days early (R).'

Positive Weakness Framing: Akui kelemahan dengan jujur + tunjukkan kesadaran diri + jelaskan langkah perbaikan. Formula: 'I used to struggle with X, but I've been working on it by Y, and now I can Z.' Contoh: 'I used to struggle with public speaking, but I've been taking a presentation course, and now I can confidently present to small groups.'

Strategic Questions: Gunakan pola 'Could you tell me about...?' atau 'How would you describe...?' untuk menanyakan budaya kerja, dinamika tim, atau peluang pengembangan. Contoh: 'Could you tell me about the team dynamics?' atau 'How would you describe the company's approach to professional development?'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Peringatan Kesalahan Umum
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak kandidat memberikan jawaban yang terlalu umum atau teoretis tanpa contoh konkret. Hindari jawaban seperti 'I'm a hard worker' tanpa bukti spesifik. Juga hindari memaparkan kelemahan yang terlalu serius atau relevan langsung dengan posisi yang dilamar.
commonTrap.wrong: My biggest weakness is that I'm a perfectionist and I work too hard.
commonTrap.correct: I sometimes focus too much on details, which can slow me down. I've been using time-blocking techniques to balance thoroughness with efficiency, and it's helped me meet deadlines more consistently.

vocab.collocation: My greatest strength is my ability to work well under pressure and deliver results on time.
The biggest challenge I faced was managing multiple projects simultaneously with limited resources.
Tell me about a time you handled a difficult deadline and how you managed to complete the task.
Could you elaborate on the team dynamics and how team members typically collaborate on projects?
This is an opportunity to showcase your skills and demonstrate what you can bring to the company.
When discussing a weakness, be honest but focus on what you're doing to improve it.
Could you elaborate on the company's approach to employee development and training opportunities?
I'm particularly proud of what we accomplished as a team during that challenging project last year.
I took the initiative to reorganize our filing system, which improved our team's efficiency by 30%.
What opportunities does the company provide for professional development and career advancement?

dialogue.context: Sarah sedang mengikuti wawancara kerja untuk posisi Marketing Coordinator di sebuah perusahaan teknologi. Pewawancara, Mr. Thompson, menanyakan tentang pengalaman dan kekuatan Sarah.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Thank you for coming in today, Sarah. Can you tell me about a time you handled a difficult deadline?
lines.translation: Terima kasih sudah datang hari ini, Sarah. Bisakah Anda ceritakan tentang suatu saat ketika Anda menghadapi tenggat waktu yang sulit?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Certainly. In my previous role, we had to launch a campaign in two weeks instead of the usual month. I organized daily team meetings, delegated tasks clearly, and we actually launched one day early with excellent results.
lines.translation: Tentu. Di posisi saya sebelumnya, kami harus meluncurkan kampanye dalam dua minggu alih-alih sebulan seperti biasa. Saya mengorganisir pertemuan tim harian, mendelegasikan tugas dengan jelas, dan kami sebenarnya meluncurkan satu hari lebih awal dengan hasil yang sangat baik.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Impressive. What would you say is your greatest strength?
lines.translation: Mengesankan. Apa yang menurut Anda adalah kekuatan terbesar Anda?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: My greatest strength is my ability to analyze data and turn insights into actionable strategies. For example, I identified a gap in our target audience and created a campaign that increased engagement by 45%.
lines.translation: Kekuatan terbesar saya adalah kemampuan untuk menganalisis data dan mengubah wawasan menjadi strategi yang dapat ditindaklanjuti. Sebagai contoh, saya mengidentifikasi kesenjangan dalam audiens target kami dan membuat kampanye yang meningkatkan keterlibatan sebesar 45%.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: That's excellent. Now, what would you consider a weakness?
lines.translation: Itu bagus sekali. Sekarang, apa yang Anda anggap sebagai kelemahan?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I used to struggle with delegating tasks because I wanted to ensure everything was perfect. However, I've been working on trusting my team more, and now I can balance quality control with effective collaboration.
lines.translation: Saya dulu kesulitan mendelegasikan tugas karena saya ingin memastikan semuanya sempurna. Namun, saya telah berusaha lebih mempercayai tim saya, dan sekarang saya bisa menyeimbangkan kontrol kualitas dengan kolaborasi yang efektif.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Good to hear. Do you have any questions for me?
lines.translation: Senang mendengarnya. Apakah Anda punya pertanyaan untuk saya?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes, could you tell me about the team dynamics? And how would you describe the company's approach to professional development?
lines.translation: Ya, bisakah Anda ceritakan tentang dinamika tim? Dan bagaimana Anda menggambarkan pendekatan perusahaan terhadap pengembangan profesional?

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul berperan sebagai pewawancara kerja untuk posisi Project Coordinator. Anda adalah kandidat yang akan menjawab pertanyaan wawancara menggunakan metode STAR, menjelaskan kekuatan dan kelemahan, serta mengajukan pertanyaan strategis tentang budaya kerja perusahaan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Welcome to the interview. I'm excited to learn more about you today. Let me start with this: Can you tell me about a time when you had to work with a difficult team member? How did you handle that situation?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Thank you for having me. In my last position, I worked with a colleague who often missed deadlines. I scheduled a one-on-one meeting to understand their challenges, and we created a shared task tracker. This improved our collaboration significantly, and we completed the project successfully.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That shows great problem-solving skills. Now, what would you say is your greatest strength, and can you give me a specific example of how you've used it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My greatest strength is my organizational ability. For instance, when I managed five projects simultaneously, I created a priority matrix and color-coded system that helped my team stay on track. We delivered all projects on time with zero delays.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent example. Everyone has areas for improvement. What's a weakness you're currently working on?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I sometimes focus too much on details, which can be time-consuming. I've been practicing the 80-20 rule, focusing on the most impactful 20% of tasks first. This has helped me become more efficient while maintaining quality standards.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I appreciate your self-awareness. Before we wrap up, do you have any questions for me about the role or our company?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I have two questions. Could you elaborate on the team dynamics and how the team typically collaborates? Also, what opportunities does the company provide for professional development?

quiz.question: When using the STAR method, what does the 'A' stand for? 'The STAR method helps you structure your answer: Situation, Task, ___, Result.'
quiz.explanation: Dalam metode STAR, huruf 'A' adalah Action (tindakan) - yaitu tindakan spesifik yang Anda ambil untuk mengatasi situasi atau menyelesaikan tugas tersebut. Urutan lengkapnya: Situation (situasi), Task (tugas), Action (tindakan), Result (hasil).

quiz.question: Which is the best way to frame a weakness in a job interview? 'I ___ with time management, but I've been using digital tools to improve, and now I meet all my deadlines consistently.'
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'used to struggle' untuk menunjukkan bahwa ini adalah kelemahan di masa lalu yang sedang Anda perbaiki. Ini menunjukkan kesadaran diri dan pertumbuhan. Hindari 'always struggle' (terlalu negatif) atau 'never had problems' (tidak jujur dan tidak menjawab pertanyaan).

quiz.question: Complete this strategic question about company culture: '___ you tell me about the team dynamics and how team members typically collaborate?'
quiz.explanation: 'Could you tell me about...' adalah cara yang sopan dan profesional untuk mengajukan pertanyaan dalam wawancara kerja. Ini lebih natural dan formal dibandingkan 'Must' (terlalu memaksa) atau 'Should' (kurang tepat konteksnya untuk bertanya).

quiz.question: When showcasing your strengths, which approach is most effective? 'My greatest strength is my communication skills. ___'
options: Last month, I mediated a conflict between two departments and helped them reach a successful agreement.
I'm really good at talking to people.
quiz.answer: Last month, I mediated a conflict between two departments and helped them reach a successful agreement.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban terbaik memberikan contoh konkret dan spesifik dengan hasil yang terukur. 'Last month, I mediated...' menggunakan contoh nyata yang membuktikan kekuatan Anda. Hindari pernyataan umum seperti 'I'm really good at...' atau 'Everyone says...' yang tidak memberikan bukti konkret.

quiz.question: Which question best shows interest in professional growth? 'What opportunities does the company provide for ___?'
quiz.explanation: 'Professional development' (pengembangan profesional) menunjukkan bahwa Anda serius tentang pertumbuhan karier dan komitmen jangka panjang pada perusahaan. Pertanyaan tentang 'free lunch' atau 'vacation days', meskipun valid, lebih baik ditanyakan setelah Anda mendapat tawaran pekerjaan, bukan di wawancara awal.

modules.title: Complex Narrative Storytelling: Interweaving Past Continuous, Past Simple & Past Perfect Continuous
modules.objective: Menyusun narasi multi-lapis yang dinamis dengan mengintegrasikan ketiga tense masa lalu secara harmonis.

theory.summary: Dalam narasi kompleks, kita sering perlu menggambarkan beberapa lapisan waktu di masa lalu. Past Perfect Continuous (had been + V-ing) menunjukkan aksi yang sudah berlangsung untuk durasi tertentu sebelum kejadian lain di masa lalu. Past Continuous menggambarkan latar belakang atau aksi yang sedang berlangsung, sedangkan Past Simple menceritakan kejadian utama yang terjadi. Kombinasi ketiga tense ini menciptakan narasi yang kaya dan dinamis, seperti dalam kalimat: 'She was exhausted because she had been working for twelve hours when her boss finally called.'
rules: Past Perfect Continuous: had been + V-ing - untuk aksi yang sudah berlangsung lama sebelum momen lain di masa lalu. Contoh: 'He had been studying for three hours before the power went out.'
Past Continuous: was/were + V-ing - untuk latar belakang atau aksi yang sedang berlangsung ketika kejadian lain terjadi. Contoh: 'They were discussing the project when the manager arrived.'
Past Simple: V2 - untuk kejadian utama atau aksi yang mengganggu aksi yang sedang berlangsung. Contoh: 'The phone rang while I was cooking dinner.'

Urutan narasi: Gunakan Past Perfect Continuous untuk menjelaskan durasi aksi sebelumnya, Past Continuous untuk latar belakang, dan Past Simple untuk aksi utama. Contoh: 'I had been waiting for two hours, the rain was pouring down, and then she finally appeared.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Mencampur Past Continuous dengan Past Perfect Continuous
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa keliru menggunakan Past Continuous untuk aksi yang sudah selesai sebelum kejadian lain. Past Continuous hanya untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu, sedangkan Past Perfect Continuous menunjukkan durasi aksi yang sudah berlangsung sebelum momen lain di masa lalu.
commonTrap.wrong: I was studying for three hours when the exam started. (keliru - tidak menunjukkan bahwa belajar sudah berlangsung sebelum ujian)
commonTrap.correct: I had been studying for three hours before the exam started. (benar - menunjukkan durasi belajar sebelum ujian dimulai)

vocab.collocation: She felt exhausted after the long journey because she had been traveling for fifteen hours.
Sorry to interrupt, but I had been trying to reach you all morning.
They were engaged in a heated discussion when I entered the room.
The athlete collapsed during the race because he had been training too intensively.
She had been pursuing her dream of becoming a doctor for many years.
It was frustrating because I had been waiting in the queue for over an hour.
He glanced at his watch and realized he had been working since dawn.
We had been hiking since dawn when we finally reached the summit.
I felt relieved when the doctor arrived because my father had been suffering all night.
She was staring at the screen when she realized she had been working on the wrong file.

dialogue.context: Emma dan David sedang membahas pengalaman Emma saat menghadiri wawancara kerja yang melelahkan kemarin.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: You look exhausted! How did the interview go yesterday?
lines.translation: Kamu terlihat kelelahan! Bagaimana wawancaranya kemarin?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: It was incredibly frustrating. I had been preparing for three weeks, but when I arrived, they were dealing with a system failure.
lines.translation: Sangat menjengkelkan. Aku sudah mempersiapkan diri selama tiga minggu, tapi ketika aku tiba, mereka sedang menangani kegagalan sistem.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Oh no! So what happened? Did you wait long?
lines.translation: Oh tidak! Jadi apa yang terjadi? Apakah kamu menunggu lama?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: I had been waiting in the lobby for two hours when they finally called me in. By that time, I was so nervous.
lines.translation: Aku sudah menunggu di lobi selama dua jam ketika mereka akhirnya memanggilku masuk. Saat itu, aku sangat gugup.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: That sounds terrible. What were the interviewers doing while you were waiting?
lines.translation: Kedengarannya mengerikan. Apa yang dilakukan pewawancara saat kamu menunggu?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: They were trying to fix their computers. The IT team had been working on it since morning, but the problem was more serious than they thought.
lines.translation: Mereka sedang mencoba memperbaiki komputer mereka. Tim IT sudah mengerjakan masalah itu sejak pagi, tapi masalahnya lebih serius dari yang mereka kira.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: At least they understood it wasn't your fault. Did the interview itself go well?
lines.translation: Setidaknya mereka paham itu bukan salahmu. Apakah wawancaranya sendiri berjalan baik?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Yes, actually! Once we started, I felt relieved. All the preparation paid off because I had been practicing my answers every single day.
lines.translation: Ya, sebenarnya! Begitu kami mulai, aku merasa lega. Semua persiapan terbayar karena aku sudah berlatih jawabanku setiap hari.

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul meminta Anda menceritakan pengalaman menarik atau menantang yang pernah Anda alami, dengan fokus pada penggunaan Past Perfect Continuous, Past Continuous, dan Past Simple.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today, I'd like you to tell me about a memorable or challenging experience you had. Try to describe what had been happening before the main event, what was going on at the time, and what actually happened. Are you ready?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I'm ready! I'll tell you about when I took an important exam last year.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Let's start with the preparation. What had you been doing before the exam day arrived?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I had been studying every night for two months. I was really determined to pass.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Great use of Past Perfect Continuous! Now, tell me what was happening on the morning of the exam. Set the scene for me.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: On the exam morning, I was feeling nervous. My hands were shaking while I was having breakfast, and I kept checking my notes.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! I can picture it clearly. Now, what actually happened during the exam? Any unexpected moments?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Well, I had been worrying about the difficult questions, but when I opened the paper, I realized I knew most of the answers. I finished early and felt relieved!

quiz.question: Maria was exhausted because she ___ for six hours without a break.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan Past Perfect Continuous 'had been working' untuk menunjukkan aksi (bekerja) yang sudah berlangsung selama durasi tertentu (enam jam) sebelum hasil di masa lalu (merasa kelelahan). Past Continuous 'was working' tidak menunjukkan durasi sebelum momen lain, dan Past Simple 'worked' tidak menunjukkan durasi atau hubungan dengan kelelahan.

quiz.question: While they ___ the presentation, the electricity suddenly went out.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan Past Continuous 'were preparing' untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung ketika aksi lain (listrik padam) mengganggu. 'Had been preparing' salah karena menunjukkan durasi sebelum kejadian lain, bukan aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat itu. 'Prepared' adalah Past Simple yang tidak menunjukkan aksi sedang berlangsung.

quiz.question: The students ___ attention while the teacher was explaining the complex grammar rule.
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous 'were paying' tepat untuk menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung bersamaan dengan aksi lain (guru sedang menjelaskan). Kedua aksi terjadi secara bersamaan di masa lalu. 'Had been paying' akan menunjukkan mereka sudah memperhatikan sebelum guru menjelaskan, yang tidak logis. 'Paid' tidak menunjukkan durasi atau kebersamaan aksi.

quiz.question: I finally understood the problem because I ___ about it for days.
quiz.explanation: Past Perfect Continuous 'had been thinking' menunjukkan proses berpikir yang sudah berlangsung selama beberapa hari sebelum akhirnya memahami masalahnya. Ini menjelaskan penyebab dari pemahaman yang tercapai. 'Was thinking' hanya menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung, tidak menunjukkan durasi atau hubungan sebab-akibat. 'Thought' terlalu sederhana untuk menggambarkan proses yang berkelanjutan.

quiz.question: By the time the ambulance arrived, the doctors ___ emergency procedures and the nurses ___ the patient.
options: had been performing / had been assisting
quiz.explanation: Past Continuous 'were performing' dan 'were assisting' tepat untuk menggambarkan aksi-aksi yang sedang berlangsung pada momen tertentu di masa lalu (ketika ambulans tiba). Kedua aksi adalah latar belakang situasi saat ambulans tiba. Past Perfect Continuous akan menunjukkan aksi sudah berlangsung lama sebelumnya, yang tidak sesuai konteks. Past Simple terlalu sederhana dan tidak menunjukkan aksi sedang berlangsung.

modules.title: Consumer Rights, Product Warranties & Constructive Assertiveness
modules.objective: Menyampaikan keluhan konsumen secara tegas, sopan, dan efektif untuk menuntut pengembalian dana atau penggantian barang rusak.

theory.summary: Sebagai konsumen, Anda memiliki hak untuk mendapatkan produk yang sesuai spesifikasi dan garansi yang dijanjikan. Ketika produk rusak atau tidak sesuai, Anda perlu menyampaikan keluhan secara assertif namun profesional. Assertiveness berbeda dengan agresif—Anda tetap tegas tanpa kasar. Gunakan struktur: (1) jelaskan masalah dengan spesifik, (2) rujuk hak konsumen atau garansi, (3) nyatakan permintaan yang jelas (refund/replacement), (4) tetap tenang dan dokumentasikan semua komunikasi.
rules: Gunakan 'I am entitled to...' untuk merujuk hak konsumen: 'I am entitled to a full refund under the Consumer Protection Act' atau 'I am entitled to a replacement within the warranty period'

Gunakan 'The product is defective/faulty' untuk menjelaskan masalah: 'The product is defective and does not match the specifications stated on the box' atau 'The item is faulty and stopped working after two days'

Gunakan 'I insist on...' atau 'I must insist that...' untuk menekankan permintaan: 'I insist on speaking with a customer relations supervisor' atau 'I must insist that you process my refund immediately'
Gunakan present perfect untuk menggambarkan masalah berkelanjutan: 'I have contacted your support team three times' atau 'The issue has not been resolved despite my multiple complaints'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan: Terlalu Pasif atau Terlalu Agresif
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak learner B1 menggunakan bahasa yang terlalu lemah ('maybe you could help me?') atau terlalu agresif ('You must give me money now!'). Gunakan assertive language yang tegas namun profesional dengan struktur formal dan referensi ke hak atau garansi.
commonTrap.wrong: Can you maybe give me my money back if it's not too much trouble?
commonTrap.correct: I am entitled to a full refund as the product is defective and still under warranty. I would like to process this refund today.

vocab.meaning: rusak, cacat, tidak berfungsi dengan baik
vocab.collocation: The laptop I purchased is defective and will not turn on despite being fully charged.
As a consumer, I am entitled to a replacement under the two-year manufacturer's warranty.
This product comes with a 12-month warranty that covers all manufacturing defects.
I would like to request a full refund as the item does not match the online description.

vocab.meaning: rusak, bermasalah, tidak bekerja dengan benar
vocab.collocation: The headphones are faulty—the left speaker produces no sound at all.
The product does not match the specifications listed on your website.

vocab.meaning: meningkatkan ke level yang lebih tinggi
vocab.collocation: If this issue is not resolved today, I will need to escalate my complaint to senior management.
I insist on receiving a replacement unit since this one arrived damaged.
Under consumer protection law, I have the right to return faulty goods within 30 days.
I would like to speak with a supervisor as this matter has not been handled appropriately.

dialogue.context: Sarah membawa kembali blender yang rusak ke toko elektronik. Dia berbicara dengan customer service representative untuk meminta pengembalian dana. Blender tersebut masih dalam masa garansi 1 tahun.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Good morning. I purchased this blender three weeks ago, and it's already stopped working. The motor makes a strange noise and then shuts off completely.
lines.translation: Selamat pagi. Saya membeli blender ini tiga minggu yang lalu, dan sudah berhenti bekerja. Motornya mengeluarkan suara aneh lalu mati total.

lines.speaker: Customer Service
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt and the warranty card with you?
lines.translation: Saya turut prihatin mendengarnya. Apakah Anda membawa struk dan kartu garansi?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Yes, here they are. The product is clearly defective and does not match the specifications. It should last much longer than three weeks.
lines.translation: Ya, ini dia. Produk ini jelas rusak dan tidak sesuai spesifikasi. Seharusnya bertahan lebih dari tiga minggu.

lines.speaker: Customer Service
lines.text: We can send it for repairs under warranty. It usually takes about two to three weeks.
lines.translation: Kami bisa mengirimkannya untuk perbaikan dengan garansi. Biasanya memakan waktu dua hingga tiga minggu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I'm not satisfied with that solution. I am entitled to a full refund or immediate replacement since the product is faulty. I've only used it a few times.
lines.translation: Saya tidak puas dengan solusi itu. Saya berhak mendapat pengembalian dana penuh atau penggantian langsung karena produknya rusak. Saya baru memakainya beberapa kali.

lines.speaker: Customer Service
lines.text: I understand your frustration, but our policy requires repair attempts first before replacement.
lines.translation: Saya memahami kekecewaan Anda, tapi kebijakan kami mengharuskan upaya perbaikan terlebih dahulu sebelum penggantian.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Under consumer protection law, I have the right to choose between repair, replacement, or refund for defective goods. I insist on speaking with a supervisor to resolve this matter today.
lines.translation: Berdasarkan hukum perlindungan konsumen, saya berhak memilih antara perbaikan, penggantian, atau pengembalian dana untuk barang rusak. Saya ingin berbicara dengan supervisor untuk menyelesaikan masalah ini hari ini.

lines.speaker: Customer Service
lines.text: Let me call the store manager for you. Please wait just a moment.
lines.translation: Biar saya panggilkan manajer toko untuk Anda. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

speakingLab.context: Anda berperan sebagai konsumen yang membeli smartphone yang ternyata baterainya cepat habis dan layarnya berkedip-kedip. Anda datang ke service center untuk menuntut penggantian. Mr. Khoirul berperan sebagai customer service representative. Praktikkan cara menyampaikan keluhan secara tegas namun sopan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good afternoon! Welcome to TechMart Service Center. How can I assist you today?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good afternoon. I bought this smartphone from your store two weeks ago, and it has serious problems. The battery drains within three hours, and the screen flickers constantly.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. That does sound problematic. Do you have the purchase receipt and warranty documentation?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, here's everything. The product is clearly defective and does not match the specifications you advertised. I am entitled to a replacement under warranty.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I understand your concern. However, we typically need to run diagnostics first, which takes 5-7 business days. Then we can determine if it needs repair or replacement.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's not acceptable. I've only had this phone for two weeks and it's already faulty. I insist on an immediate replacement. I cannot wait another week without a working phone.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I apologize for the inconvenience. Let me check our inventory to see if we have the same model available for immediate exchange.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Thank you. If a replacement isn't available today, I would like to escalate this complaint to your supervisor and request a full refund instead.

quiz.question: I am ___ to a full refund because the product is defective and still under warranty.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'entitled' (past participle digunakan sebagai adjective) setelah 'to be' untuk menyatakan 'berhak'. Pola: be + entitled + to + noun. 'I am entitled to a refund' berarti 'Saya berhak mendapat pengembalian dana'.

quiz.question: The laptop I purchased is ___ and will not turn on at all.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'defective' (adjective) untuk mendeskripsikan produk yang rusak atau cacat. Pola: be + defective. 'Defect' adalah noun (kerusakan), sedangkan 'defectively' adalah adverb. Dalam konteks ini kita butuh adjective untuk melengkapi 'is'.

quiz.question: I must ___ that you process my refund immediately, as I have been waiting for three weeks.
quiz.explanation: Setelah modal verb 'must', gunakan bare infinitive (verb tanpa 'to'). Pola: must + insist + that-clause. 'I must insist that...' adalah cara formal dan tegas untuk menekankan permintaan Anda sebagai konsumen.

quiz.question: The product does not match the ___ listed on your website.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'specifications' (plural noun) untuk merujuk pada detail teknis atau spesifikasi produk. Setelah article 'the' kita butuh noun. 'Specify' adalah verb, dan 'specified' adalah past participle yang biasanya digunakan sebagai adjective.

quiz.question: If this issue is not resolved today, I will need to ___ my complaint to senior management.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'need to', gunakan bare infinitive. Pola: need + to + escalate. 'Escalate' (verb) berarti 'meningkatkan ke level lebih tinggi'. 'Escalation' adalah noun, dan 'escalated' adalah past tense/participle.

modules.title: Ujian Kelulusan B1.2: Evaluasi Komprehensif Komunikasi Global & Dunia Kerja
modules.objective: Ujian kelulusan komprehensif 4 keterampilan (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) untuk membuka Sub-Level B1.3

theory.summary: Ujian kelulusan B1.2 ini mengevaluasi kemampuan Anda dalam empat keterampilan utama bahasa Inggris: mendengarkan (Listening), membaca (Reading), menulis dan tata bahasa (Writing & Grammar), serta berbicara (Speaking). Ujian ini dirancang untuk mengukur kemampuan komunikasi Anda dalam konteks global dan dunia kerja, termasuk wawancara kerja, penanganan keluhan, negosiasi bisnis, dan pemahaman hak konsumen. Anda akan menghadapi 16 soal yang terbagi merata dengan fokus pada present perfect continuous untuk aktivitas berkelanjutan, modals of deduction untuk menyimpulkan informasi, passive voice untuk konteks formal, dan used to/be used to untuk kebiasaan. Skor minimal 75% diperlukan untuk melanjutkan ke level B1.3.
rules: Present Perfect Continuous: have/has + been + verb-ing → Digunakan untuk menekankan durasi aktivitas yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut atau baru saja selesai. Contoh: 'I have been working here for three years.' (Saya sudah bekerja di sini selama tiga tahun.)

Modals of Deduction: must/might/can't/could + verb → Digunakan untuk menyimpulkan atau menduga sesuatu berdasarkan bukti. must = sangat yakin (positif), might/could = mungkin, can't = yakin tidak mungkin. Contoh: 'She must be the manager.' (Dia pasti manajernya.) / 'He can't be serious.' (Dia pasti tidak serius.)

Passive Voice: be + past participle → Digunakan ketika fokus pada objek/penerima aksi, bukan pelaku. Sangat umum dalam konteks bisnis dan formal. Contoh: 'The report was submitted yesterday.' (Laporan itu diserahkan kemarin.) / 'Customers are informed about their rights.' (Pelanggan diberi tahu tentang hak mereka.)

Used to vs Be used to: 'used to + infinitive' = kebiasaan masa lalu yang tidak lagi dilakukan. 'be used to + noun/gerund' = terbiasa dengan sesuatu saat ini. Contoh: 'I used to smoke.' (Dulu saya merokok.) vs 'I'm used to working late.' (Saya terbiasa bekerja larut.)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampuradukkan Present Perfect Simple dan Continuous
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa sering salah memilih antara present perfect simple dan continuous. Present perfect simple fokus pada hasil atau fakta ('I have finished the report'), sedangkan present perfect continuous menekankan durasi atau proses yang sedang berlangsung ('I have been working on the report for two hours'). Dalam konteks wawancara kerja atau negosiasi, menggunakan continuous menunjukkan komitmen dan proses berkelanjutan.
commonTrap.wrong: I have worked on this project. (Jika ingin menekankan durasi hingga sekarang)
commonTrap.correct: I have been working on this project for six months. (Menekankan durasi dan kontinuitas)

dialogue.context: Sarah sedang menghadiri wawancara kerja untuk posisi marketing coordinator di sebuah perusahaan multinasional. Pewawancara, Mr. Thompson, menanyakan pengalaman dan keterampilan Sarah.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Good morning, Sarah. Thank you for coming. Could you tell me about your current role?
lines.translation: Selamat pagi, Sarah. Terima kasih sudah datang. Bisakah Anda ceritakan tentang peran Anda saat ini?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Good morning. I've been working as a junior marketing specialist for two years now, and I've been managing our social media campaigns.
lines.translation: Selamat pagi. Saya sudah bekerja sebagai spesialis pemasaran junior selama dua tahun sekarang, dan saya sudah mengelola kampanye media sosial kami.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: That's interesting. What made you decide to apply for this position?
lines.translation: Itu menarik. Apa yang membuat Anda memutuskan untuk melamar posisi ini?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I'm looking for new challenges and your company's international projects really appeal to me. I'm used to working in multicultural teams.
lines.translation: Saya mencari tantangan baru dan proyek internasional perusahaan Anda benar-benar menarik bagi saya. Saya terbiasa bekerja di tim multikultural.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Excellent. Can you describe a situation where you had to handle a difficult client complaint?
lines.translation: Bagus sekali. Bisakah Anda menjelaskan situasi di mana Anda harus menangani keluhan klien yang sulit?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Certainly. Last month, a client complained about delayed delivery. I listened to their concerns, offered immediate compensation, and ensured the issue was resolved within 24 hours.
lines.translation: Tentu. Bulan lalu, seorang klien mengeluh tentang pengiriman yang tertunda. Saya mendengarkan kekhawatiran mereka, menawarkan kompensasi segera, dan memastikan masalahnya diselesaikan dalam 24 jam.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: That shows great initiative. One final question: Where do you see yourself in five years?
lines.translation: Itu menunjukkan inisiatif yang bagus. Satu pertanyaan terakhir: Di mana Anda melihat diri Anda dalam lima tahun?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I hope to have developed my skills further and be leading a marketing team, contributing to the company's global expansion.
lines.translation: Saya berharap telah mengembangkan keterampilan saya lebih jauh dan memimpin tim pemasaran, berkontribusi pada ekspansi global perusahaan.

speakingLab.context: Anda berperan sebagai seorang customer service representative di bandara internasional. Mr. Khoirul akan berperan sebagai penumpang yang mengalami masalah dengan penerbangan yang tertunda dan bagasi yang hilang. Tujuan Anda adalah menangani keluhannya dengan profesional, menawarkan solusi, dan memastikan kepuasannya.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excuse me, I need to speak with someone about my flight. It's been delayed for four hours and now they're saying my luggage is missing!

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm very sorry to hear about this situation, sir. Let me help you. Could you please provide me with your booking reference number?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Here it is: BK7492. This is unacceptable! I have an important meeting tomorrow morning and all my documents are in that suitcase.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I completely understand your frustration. Let me check the system right away. While I'm doing that, I can offer you meal vouchers and arrange accommodation for tonight.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Accommodation is fine, but what about my luggage? And will I receive any compensation for this inconvenience?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Your luggage has been located and will be delivered to your hotel by 10 PM tonight. Regarding compensation, you're entitled to €400 for the delay, and we'll process that within 7 business days.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That sounds better. Can you also help me rebook my connecting flight?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Absolutely. I've already arranged you on the first flight tomorrow at 7 AM, and we've upgraded you to business class as a gesture of goodwill. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Dengarkan transkrip wawancara kerja berikut: 'Interviewer: How long have you been working in digital marketing? Candidate: I've been working in this field for about five years, but I've been specializing in SEO for the last two years.' Berdasarkan transkrip, berapa lama kandidat tersebut sudah berspesialisasi dalam SEO?
quiz.explanation: Kandidat mengatakan 'I've been specializing in SEO for the last two years', yang berarti dia sudah berspesialisasi dalam SEO selama dua tahun terakhir. Meskipun dia bekerja di bidang digital marketing selama lima tahun, spesialisasi SEO-nya baru dimulai dua tahun lalu.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Dengarkan transkrip percakapan di bandara berikut: 'Passenger: My flight was delayed by six hours and my luggage is lost. Agent: I sincerely apologize. According to our policy, you're entitled to €600 compensation for delays over four hours. We've also located your luggage and it will be delivered tonight.' Apa yang ditawarkan agen kepada penumpang?
options: Free flight upgrade and hotel accommodation
quiz.explanation: Agen dengan jelas menyebutkan dua hal: kompensasi €600 untuk keterlambatan lebih dari empat jam, dan pengiriman bagasi malam itu juga. Ini adalah solusi konkret yang ditawarkan untuk menangani keluhan penumpang.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Dengarkan transkrip berikut: 'Manager: I must say, you've been performing exceptionally well. Employee: Thank you. I've been trying to improve my skills. Manager: It shows. You must be very dedicated to your work.' Apa kesimpulan yang dibuat manajer tentang karyawan tersebut?
options: The employee might be looking for a new job
The employee must be very dedicated
The employee can't be working hard enough
quiz.answer: The employee must be very dedicated
quiz.explanation: Manajer menggunakan modal 'must be' untuk menyatakan kesimpulan yang sangat yakin berdasarkan bukti (performa luar biasa karyawan). 'Must' dalam konteks deduction menunjukkan kepastian tinggi bahwa karyawan tersebut sangat berdedikasi pada pekerjaannya.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Dengarkan transkrip resolusi komplain berikut: 'Customer: I ordered this product three weeks ago and it still hasn't arrived. Representative: I apologize for the inconvenience. Your order was delayed due to customs clearance, but it has been dispatched and should arrive by Friday. We'll also refund your shipping costs.' Apa penyebab keterlambatan pesanan?
options: The product was out of stock
quiz.explanation: Representatif dengan jelas menyatakan bahwa 'Your order was delayed due to customs clearance', yang berarti keterlambatan disebabkan oleh proses bea cukai. Ini adalah penjelasan spesifik tentang akar masalah keterlambatan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Bacalah teks berikut: 'In today's global marketplace, companies must be proactive in addressing customer complaints. Research shows that 70% of customers who have their complaints resolved quickly remain loyal to the brand. Effective complaint handling involves listening carefully, offering immediate solutions, and following up to ensure satisfaction.' Menurut teks, berapa persen pelanggan yang tetap setia jika keluhan mereka diselesaikan dengan cepat?
quiz.explanation: Teks secara eksplisit menyatakan 'Research shows that 70% of customers who have their complaints resolved quickly remain loyal to the brand.' Ini adalah statistik penting yang menunjukkan dampak penanganan keluhan yang efektif terhadap loyalitas pelanggan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Bacalah artikel tentang hak konsumen berikut: 'Under EU regulations, airline passengers are entitled to compensation when flights are delayed by more than three hours. The amount varies: €250 for flights under 1,500 km, €400 for EU flights over 1,500 km, and €600 for international flights over 3,500 km. However, compensation is not required if the delay was caused by extraordinary circumstances beyond the airline's control.' Berapa kompensasi untuk penerbangan EU sejauh 2,000 km yang tertunda 4 jam?
quiz.explanation: Penerbangan EU sejauh 2,000 km (lebih dari 1,500 km) yang tertunda lebih dari 3 jam berhak mendapat kompensasi €400 sesuai dengan regulasi yang disebutkan dalam teks. Kategori €600 hanya untuk penerbangan internasional lebih dari 3,500 km.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Bacalah teks bisnis berikut: 'The new marketing strategy has been implemented across all departments. Sales reports are now generated automatically and sent to managers weekly. Customer feedback is being collected through multiple channels and analyzed to improve our services. These changes have resulted in a 25% increase in customer satisfaction.' Bagaimana laporan penjualan sekarang dibuat dan dikirimkan?
options: They are created manually by sales staff monthly
They are generated automatically and sent weekly
They must be requested by managers individually
quiz.answer: They are generated automatically and sent weekly
quiz.explanation: Teks dengan jelas menyatakan dalam passive voice: 'Sales reports are now generated automatically and sent to managers weekly.' Ini menunjukkan sistem otomatis yang berjalan setiap minggu untuk menghasilkan dan mengirimkan laporan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Bacalah teks berikut tentang adaptasi kerja: 'Many professionals find it challenging to adjust when they start working remotely. However, after a few weeks, most employees become used to the flexibility and report higher productivity. Companies that used to require daily office attendance are now embracing hybrid work models.' Apa yang dialami sebagian besar karyawan setelah beberapa minggu bekerja remote?
options: They remain uncomfortable with remote work
They become used to the flexibility
They request to return to the office
quiz.answer: They become used to the flexibility
quiz.explanation: Teks menyatakan 'most employees become used to the flexibility', yang berarti sebagian besar karyawan menjadi terbiasa dengan fleksibilitas kerja remote. Frasa 'become used to' menunjukkan proses adaptasi yang berhasil setelah periode penyesuaian.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan present perfect continuous dengan benar untuk menunjukkan aktivitas berkelanjutan dalam konteks wawancara kerja:
options: I work on international projects for three years now.
I have been working on international projects for three years.
I am working on international projects for three years.
quiz.answer: I have been working on international projects for three years.
quiz.explanation: Present perfect continuous (have been working) adalah struktur yang tepat untuk menekankan durasi aktivitas yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut hingga sekarang. Struktur ini sering digunakan dalam wawancara kerja untuk menunjukkan pengalaman berkelanjutan. 'For three years' menunjukkan durasi waktu.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan modal of deduction dengan tepat untuk menyimpulkan situasi berdasarkan bukti:
options: She might be the new manager because she's very confident.
She must be the new manager because I saw her name on the door.
She can be the new manager if she wants to.
quiz.answer: She must be the new manager because I saw her name on the door.
quiz.explanation: Modal 'must' digunakan untuk deduction dengan tingkat kepastian tinggi berdasarkan bukti konkret (nama di pintu). 'Might' menunjukkan kemungkinan yang lebih rendah, sedangkan 'can' dalam konteks ini tidak tepat untuk menyimpulkan fakta. Bukti visual yang jelas memerlukan 'must' untuk menunjukkan kesimpulan yang hampir pasti.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Ubah kalimat aktif berikut ke dalam passive voice yang tepat untuk konteks formal bisnis: 'The company will announce the new policy next week.' Manakah bentuk passive yang benar?
options: The new policy will announce by the company next week.
The new policy will be announced next week.
The new policy is announced by the company next week.
quiz.answer: The new policy will be announced next week.
quiz.explanation: Passive voice yang benar untuk future simple adalah 'will be + past participle'. Struktur 'will be announced' adalah bentuk pasif yang tepat dan natural dalam konteks formal bisnis. Menyebutkan 'by the company' tidak perlu karena sudah jelas dari konteks, dan passive voice sering digunakan untuk fokus pada objek (kebijakan) bukan pelaku (perusahaan).

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Pilih kalimat yang menggunakan 'used to' dan 'be used to' dengan benar:
options: I used to working in a corporate office, but now I'm used to work from home.
I used to work in a corporate office, but now I'm used to working from home.
I use to work in a corporate office, but now I used to working from home.
quiz.answer: I used to work in a corporate office, but now I'm used to working from home.
quiz.explanation: Struktur yang benar: 'used to + infinitive' untuk kebiasaan masa lalu yang tidak lagi dilakukan (used to work), dan 'be used to + gerund' untuk sesuatu yang sudah menjadi kebiasaan saat ini (used to working). Perbedaan ini penting: yang pertama tentang masa lalu, yang kedua tentang kenyamanan saat ini.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Seorang klien mengeluh tentang layanan yang buruk. Respons mana yang paling profesional dan sesuai untuk customer service representative?
options: That's not our fault. You should have read the terms and conditions.
I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Let me see how I can resolve this for you immediately.
Many customers complain about this. There's nothing we can do.
quiz.answer: I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Let me see how I can resolve this for you immediately.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menunjukkan empati profesional dengan meminta maaf secara tulus, mengakui masalah tanpa menyalahkan pelanggan, dan langsung menawarkan tindakan konkret untuk menyelesaikan masalah. Ini adalah standar emas dalam customer service: acknowledge, apologize, act.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Dalam wawancara kerja, pewawancara bertanya: 'What are your salary expectations?' Respons mana yang paling diplomatis dan profesional?
options: I expect at least $100,000 or I'm not interested.

I'm flexible and open to discussion. Based on my research and experience, I believe a range of $70,000-$85,000 would be appropriate, but I'm interested in hearing what you typically offer for this role.
I don't know. How much are you willing to pay?
quiz.answer: I'm flexible and open to discussion. Based on my research and experience, I believe a range of $70,000-$85,000 would be appropriate, but I'm interested in hearing what you typically offer for this role.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menunjukkan profesionalisme dengan: (1) menunjukkan fleksibilitas, (2) memberikan range berdasarkan riset dan pengalaman, (3) membuka ruang negosiasi dengan bertanya tentang standar perusahaan. Ini adalah keseimbangan antara menghargai diri sendiri dan bersikap terbuka dalam negosiasi.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Saat bernegosiasi deadline proyek dengan klien, manakah respons yang paling efektif untuk meminta perpanjangan waktu?
options: I can't finish by Friday. Give me more time.
I understand the urgency, but to ensure the highest quality output, would it be possible to extend the deadline to Monday? This would allow me to thoroughly review all aspects.
The deadline is impossible. Everyone knows that.
quiz.answer: I understand the urgency, but to ensure the highest quality output, would it be possible to extend the deadline to Monday? This would allow me to thoroughly review all aspects.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini efektif karena: (1) mengakui kebutuhan klien dengan 'I understand the urgency', (2) memberikan alasan yang berorientasi pada manfaat (kualitas tinggi), (3) menawarkan alternatif spesifik (Monday), dan (4) menjelaskan nilai tambah dari perpanjangan. Ini adalah negosiasi yang konstruktif, bukan penolakan atau keluhan.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Ketika seorang kolega menawarkan bantuan untuk proyek Anda, respons mana yang paling sopan dan profesional?
options: No, I don't need your help. I can handle it myself.
That's very kind of you, thank you. I'm actually working on the budget section right now. If you could review the market analysis part, that would be extremely helpful.
quiz.answer: That's very kind of you, thank you. I'm actually working on the budget section right now. If you could review the market analysis part, that would be extremely helpful.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menunjukkan profesionalisme dan kolaborasi yang baik dengan: (1) mengucapkan terima kasih atas tawaran, (2) memberikan konteks tentang apa yang sedang dikerjakan, (3) memberikan tugas spesifik yang jelas, dan (4) menyatakan apresiasi. Ini membangun kerja tim yang efektif dan saling menghormati.

modules.title: Media Literacy: Detecting Biases, Fact-Checking & Spotting Misinformation
modules.group: B1.3 - Critical Perspectives & Bridge to B2
modules.objective: Menganalisis artikel berita digital, membedakan fakta objektif dari opini, dan mengidentifikasi judul umpan klik (clickbait).

theory.summary: Di era digital, kita dihadapkan dengan ribuan artikel berita setiap hari. Tidak semua informasi yang kita baca akurat atau objektif. Media literacy adalah kemampuan penting untuk mengevaluasi sumber informasi, membedakan fakta dari opini, dan mengenali teknik manipulatif seperti clickbait. Clickbait adalah judul sensasional yang dirancang untuk menarik klik tanpa memberikan substansi. Bias adalah kecenderungan untuk menyajikan informasi dari sudut pandang tertentu. Fact-checking melibatkan verifikasi klaim dengan sumber kredibel dan independen. Sebagai pembaca kritis level B1, Anda perlu mengenali kata-kata emotif, klaim yang tidak didukung bukti, dan sumber yang tidak dapat diverifikasi.
rules: Fakta vs Opini: Fakta dapat diverifikasi dan objektif (contoh: 'The study was published in 2025'), sedangkan opini adalah pandangan subjektif (contoh: 'This is the best solution'). Gunakan frasa seperti 'According to the report...' untuk fakta dan 'In my opinion...' untuk opini.

Clickbait Headlines: Judul clickbait menggunakan kata-kata sensasional, pertanyaan dramatis, atau janji yang berlebihan. Contoh clickbait: 'You Won't Believe What Happened Next!' vs judul objektif: 'New Policy Announced by Government'. Hindari judul dengan 'shocking', 'unbelievable', atau angka yang tidak masuk akal.

Evaluating Sources: Sumber kredibel memiliki penulis yang jelas, tanggal publikasi, dan referensi yang dapat diverifikasi. Gunakan frasa evaluatif: 'This claim is unsubstantiated' (klaim ini tidak berdasar), 'According to independent audits...' (menurut audit independen), 'The evidence suggests...' (bukti menunjukkan).

commonTrap.trapTitle: Peringatan Kesalahan Umum
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa B1 keliru menggunakan frasa evaluatif atau tidak membedakan antara sumber primer dan sekunder. Kesalahan umum adalah menerima informasi tanpa memeriksa kredibilitas sumber.
commonTrap.wrong: This article says it's true, so it must be a fact.
commonTrap.correct: According to independent fact-checkers, this claim requires further verification before it can be considered factual.

vocab.meaning: penyajian informasi secara berlebihan untuk menarik perhatian
vocab.collocation: The newspaper was criticized for its sensationalism in reporting the incident.
We need to find credible sources to support our research.
Independent fact-checking organizations verified the politician's claims.

vocab.meaning: kecenderungan atau prasangka terhadap sudut pandang tertentu
vocab.collocation: The article shows clear bias towards one political party.
The headline was misleading and didn't reflect the actual content.
This claim is unsubstantiated and lacks supporting evidence.

vocab.meaning: konten dengan judul sensasional untuk menarik klik
vocab.collocation: That website is full of clickbait articles with exaggerated headlines.

vocab.meaning: kecenderungan mencari informasi yang mengkonfirmasi keyakinan kita
vocab.collocation: Confirmation bias makes us ignore evidence that contradicts our beliefs.
Always verify information from multiple sources before sharing it.
Good journalism should present objective facts without personal opinions.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Tom, dua mahasiswa jurnalistik, sedang mendiskusikan artikel berita yang mereka temukan di media sosial tentang tren kesehatan baru.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Tom, have you seen this article? The headline says 'This ONE weird trick will change your life forever!' Sounds too good to be true.
lines.translation: Tom, kamu sudah lihat artikel ini? Judulnya bilang 'SATU trik aneh ini akan mengubah hidupmu selamanya!' Kedengarannya terlalu bagus untuk jadi kenyataan.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's a classic example of clickbait, Sarah. The headline uses sensationalism to get clicks, but I bet the actual content doesn't deliver on that promise.
lines.translation: Itu contoh klasik clickbait, Sarah. Judulnya menggunakan sensasionalisme untuk mendapat klik, tapi aku yakin konten sebenarnya tidak memenuhi janji itu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You're right. I checked the source, and it's from an unknown website with no credible references. This claim is completely unsubstantiated.
lines.translation: Kamu benar. Aku cek sumbernya, dan itu dari website tidak dikenal tanpa referensi kredibel. Klaim ini benar-benar tidak berdasar.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Exactly. We need to practice fact-checking before believing everything we read online. Did you find any independent audits or scientific studies backing this up?
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. Kita perlu mempraktikkan fact-checking sebelum percaya semua yang kita baca online. Apakah kamu menemukan audit independen atau studi ilmiah yang mendukung ini?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Not at all. According to medical experts I consulted, there's no evidence supporting these claims. The article mixes facts with opinions without clearly distinguishing them.
lines.translation: Sama sekali tidak. Menurut ahli medis yang aku konsultasikan, tidak ada bukti yang mendukung klaim ini. Artikel ini mencampur fakta dengan opini tanpa membedakannya dengan jelas.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's a red flag. Good journalism should present objective information and clearly label opinions. This is misleading and potentially harmful.
lines.translation: Itu tanda bahaya. Jurnalisme yang baik harus menyajikan informasi objektif dan memberi label jelas pada opini. Ini menyesatkan dan berpotensi berbahaya.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I agree. We should always verify information from multiple credible sources before sharing it. Our responsibility as future journalists is to combat misinformation.
lines.translation: Aku setuju. Kita harus selalu memverifikasi informasi dari beberapa sumber kredibel sebelum membagikannya. Tanggung jawab kita sebagai jurnalis masa depan adalah melawan misinformasi.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Absolutely. Let's write an article about how to spot clickbait and avoid confirmation bias when reading news online.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Mari kita tulis artikel tentang cara mengenali clickbait dan menghindari confirmation bias saat membaca berita online.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang artikel berita kontroversial yang Anda temukan di media sosial. Mr. Khoirul akan membantu Anda menganalisis kredibilitas artikel tersebut dan mengidentifikasi tanda-tanda clickbait atau bias.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I see you've brought an article to discuss today. What's the headline, and what made you want to analyze it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi Mr. Khoirul! The headline says 'Scientists SHOCKED by this discovery!' I'm suspicious because it seems very sensational.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good instinct! That's a classic clickbait pattern. Can you tell me who published this article? Is the source credible?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Well, it's from a website I've never heard of before. There's no author name listed, and I can't find any references to scientific journals.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent observation! Those are major red flags. What about the content itself - does it present objective facts or mostly opinions?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Now that you mention it, the article mixes some scientific terms with emotional language like 'absolutely amazing' and 'you won't believe this.' This claim seems unsubstantiated.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect analysis! You've identified sensationalism, lack of credible sources, and unverified claims. What would you do before sharing this article?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would fact-check it by looking for the same information from independent, credible sources like scientific journals or reputable news organizations before believing or sharing it.

quiz.question: Which of the following is an example of a clickbait headline?
options: Government Announces New Education Policy for 2027
You Won't BELIEVE What This Teacher Did! Number 7 Will SHOCK You!
According to recent studies, screen time affects children's development
quiz.answer: You Won't BELIEVE What This Teacher Did! Number 7 Will SHOCK You!
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'You Won't BELIEVE What This Teacher Did! Number 7 Will SHOCK You!' karena menggunakan huruf kapital berlebihan, kata-kata sensasional (BELIEVE, SHOCK), dan janji yang tidak jelas untuk menarik klik. Ini adalah ciri khas clickbait yang memanipulasi rasa ingin tahu tanpa memberikan informasi substantif di judulnya.

quiz.question: The article states: 'According to independent audits, the company's financial reports show irregularities.' This sentence is an example of ___.
options: an objective fact with verifiable source
quiz.answer: an objective fact with verifiable source
