turns.text: My sister, who lives in Jakarta, is a doctor.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! You used the commas perfectly. How long has she been working as a doctor?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: She's been working for five years at a hospital, which is located in the city centre.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Well done! Now, tell me about a place you've visited recently. Remember to add extra commentary.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I visited Bali last month, which is famous for its beautiful beaches and temples.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect use of non-defining clause! Can you describe someone you met there?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I met a tour guide, whose knowledge about Balinese culture was incredible, and he showed us many hidden places.

quiz.question: My manager, ___ has worked here for fifteen years, is very supportive.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'who' untuk orang dalam non-defining relative clauses. 'That' TIDAK BOLEH digunakan dalam non-defining clauses. Koma menunjukkan ini adalah non-defining clause yang memberikan informasi tambahan tentang 'my manager'.

quiz.question: The new office building, ___ was designed by a famous architect, opens next month.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'which' untuk benda (office building) dalam non-defining relative clauses. Koma di awal dan akhir clause menandakan ini adalah informasi tambahan yang tidak esensial. 'That' tidak boleh digunakan dalam non-defining clauses.

quiz.question: Dr. Williams ___ research focuses on climate change, will speak at the conference.
quiz.explanation: Koma WAJIB ada sebelum 'whose' karena ini non-defining clause. 'Whose' menunjukkan kepemilikan (research milik Dr. Williams). Tanpa koma, makna kalimat berubah dan menjadi defining clause.

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses a non-defining relative clause?
options: My laptop that I bought last year is very fast.
My laptop, which I bought last year, is very fast.
My laptop, that I bought last year, is very fast.
quiz.answer: My laptop, which I bought last year, is very fast.
quiz.explanation: Opsi kedua benar karena menggunakan koma di awal dan akhir clause, serta menggunakan 'which' (bukan 'that'). Opsi pertama adalah defining clause tanpa koma. Opsi ketiga salah karena menggunakan 'that' dalam non-defining clause.

quiz.question: The documentary ___ won three awards ___ explores ocean pollution.
quiz.explanation: Koma diperlukan di KEDUA sisi non-defining clause (sebelum 'which' dan setelah 'awards'). Ini menandakan informasi tentang awards adalah tambahan. 'Which' adalah pilihan tepat untuk benda, dan 'that' tidak boleh digunakan dalam non-defining clauses.

modules.title: Art of Diplomatic Argumentation: Tactful Disagreement & Reaching Consensus
modules.group: B1.3 - Critical Perspectives & Bridge to B2
modules.objective: Menyampaikan ketidaksetujuan secara elegan, mengakui poin lawan bicara, dan membangun kesepakatan dalam diskusi kelompok.

theory.summary: Dalam komunikasi profesional dan akademis, kemampuan untuk tidak setuju dengan sopan adalah keterampilan penting. Argumentasi diplomatik memungkinkan kita menyampaikan perspektif berbeda tanpa menciptakan konflik atau merusak hubungan. Di level B1, Anda akan belajar menggunakan frasa penghubung yang melembutkan ketidaksetujuan, mengakui validitas argumen lawan bicara sebelum menyampaikan pandangan berbeda, dan menawarkan solusi kompromi. Teknik ini sangat berguna dalam meeting kerja, diskusi kelompok, atau debat informal.
rules: Gunakan 'softening phrases' sebelum menyatakan ketidaksetujuan: 'I see your point, however...', 'With respect, I...', 'While I understand...' untuk membuat pernyataan terdengar lebih sopan dan konstruktif.

Akui kebenaran sebagian argumen lawan sebelum memberi counter-argument: 'You're absolutely right about [X], but have we considered [Y]?', 'I agree with your premise, although...' - pola ini menunjukkan bahwa Anda mendengarkan dengan baik.

Tawarkan solusi kompromi dengan bahasa kolaboratif: 'Could we perhaps compromise on...?', 'What if we combined both approaches?', 'Would it be possible to...' - frasa ini menggeser fokus dari konflik ke solusi bersama.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan: Terlalu Langsung atau Agresif
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pelajar langsung mengatakan 'You're wrong' atau 'I don't agree' tanpa frasa pelembut, yang terdengar kasar dalam konteks profesional. Ketidaksetujuan langsung tanpa acknowledgment membuat lawan bicara defensif dan menutup ruang dialog.
commonTrap.wrong: You're wrong. That strategy won't work at all.
commonTrap.correct: I see your point, however, I have some concerns about the practical implementation. Could we perhaps explore some alternatives?

vocab.collocation: From my perspective, we should prioritize customer feedback before launching the new feature.
Could we reach a compromise that satisfies both departments' requirements?
While I agree with your premise, the data suggests a different conclusion.
She gave tactful feedback that helped him improve without feeling criticized.
I acknowledge your concerns, but we need to consider the budget constraints as well.
After two hours of discussion, we finally reached a consensus on the project timeline.
Have you considered any alternatives to this approach that might be more cost-effective?
I have some reservations about moving forward without testing the prototype first.
Your proposal certainly has merit, though we might need to adjust the timeline.
Given the new information, perhaps we should reconsider our initial decision.

dialogue.context: Sebuah meeting tim marketing sedang mendiskusikan strategi kampanye media sosial. Sarah mengusulkan fokus pada Instagram, sementara David memiliki perspektif berbeda tentang platform yang sebaiknya diprioritaskan.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I think we should focus all our budget on Instagram campaigns. The engagement rates are highest there.
lines.translation: Saya rasa kita harus fokuskan semua budget ke kampanye Instagram. Tingkat engagement-nya paling tinggi di sana.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I see your point about the engagement rates, however, have we considered that our target demographic also uses LinkedIn extensively?
lines.translation: Saya paham poin Anda tentang tingkat engagement, namun, apakah kita sudah mempertimbangkan bahwa target demografis kita juga banyak menggunakan LinkedIn?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That's true, but LinkedIn ads are significantly more expensive per impression.
lines.translation: Itu benar, tapi iklan LinkedIn jauh lebih mahal per impression.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: You're absolutely right about the cost. With respect, though, the conversion rate on LinkedIn is three times higher for B2B services like ours.
lines.translation: Anda benar sekali soal biaya. Namun dengan hormat, conversion rate di LinkedIn tiga kali lebih tinggi untuk layanan B2B seperti kita.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I acknowledge that's a valid point. Could we perhaps compromise on this? What if we allocated 60% to Instagram and 40% to LinkedIn?
lines.translation: Saya akui itu poin yang valid. Bisakah kita berkompromi soal ini? Bagaimana kalau kita alokasikan 60% ke Instagram dan 40% ke LinkedIn?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: That sounds like a reasonable middle ground. I'd be comfortable with that split, and we can adjust based on the results after the first month.
lines.translation: Kedengarannya seperti jalan tengah yang masuk akal. Saya nyaman dengan pembagian itu, dan kita bisa sesuaikan berdasarkan hasil setelah bulan pertama.

speakingLab.context: Anda dan Mr. Khoirul sedang berperan sebagai dua kolega yang mendiskusikan rencana kerja tim. Mr. Khoirul akan mengajukan beberapa ide, dan Anda berlatih menyampaikan ketidaksetujuan secara diplomatik sambil mencari solusi kompromi.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I've been thinking about our upcoming project. I believe we should extend the deadline by two weeks to ensure quality. What do you think?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I see your point about quality, however, we have client commitments that make a two-week extension quite challenging.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a fair concern. But rushing might compromise the final product. Don't you think quality should be our top priority?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: You're absolutely right that quality matters. With respect, though, could we perhaps compromise by extending just one week while adding one more team member?

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hmm, interesting suggestion. Though I have some reservations about bringing someone new into the project at this stage. They'd need time to catch up.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I acknowledge that's a valid point. What if we brought in someone who's already familiar with our framework? That would minimize the learning curve.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Now that could work! Your proposal certainly has merit. So we're looking at one week extension plus an experienced team member?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Exactly! I think we've reached a consensus that balances quality with our timeline constraints. Shall we present this to the team?

quiz.question: When you want to disagree politely in a professional setting, which phrase is most diplomatic? 'Your idea is bad.' vs '___'
options: I see your point, however, I have a slightly different perspective on this matter.
You're completely wrong about that approach.
That's not going to work at all.
quiz.answer: I see your point, however, I have a slightly different perspective on this matter.
quiz.explanation: Frasa 'I see your point, however...' menunjukkan bahwa Anda mendengarkan dan menghargai pendapat lawan bicara sebelum menyampaikan perspektif berbeda. Ini jauh lebih diplomatik daripada langsung mengatakan seseorang salah, dan menciptakan atmosfer dialog yang konstruktif.

quiz.question: To acknowledge someone's argument before presenting your counter-point, you should say: '___'
options: You're absolutely right about the cost factor, but have we considered the long-term benefits?
I don't care about the cost, we should just do it.
Your concern about cost is irrelevant here.
quiz.answer: You're absolutely right about the cost factor, but have we considered the long-term benefits?
quiz.explanation: Mengakui kebenaran sebagian argumen lawan ('You're absolutely right about...') sebelum menambahkan perspektif lain ('but have we considered...') adalah teknik argumentasi diplomatik yang efektif. Ini menunjukkan bahwa Anda mendengarkan dengan seksama dan tidak sekadar menolak mentah-mentah.

quiz.question: When proposing a compromise in a group discussion, the most tactful phrase is: '___'
options: Could we perhaps compromise by combining both approaches to satisfy everyone's concerns?
Just do what I say and stop arguing.
My way is better, so let's go with that.
quiz.answer: Could we perhaps compromise by combining both approaches to satisfy everyone's concerns?
quiz.explanation: Frasa 'Could we perhaps compromise...' menggunakan modal 'could' yang sopan dan kata 'perhaps' yang tidak memaksa. Menyebutkan 'combining both approaches' menunjukkan bahwa Anda mencari solusi kolaboratif yang menghargai kontribusi semua pihak, bukan memaksakan kehendak sendiri.

quiz.question: To express reservation about a proposal tactfully, you should say: 'I have some ___ about this approach.'
quiz.explanation: 'Reservations' adalah kata yang tepat untuk menyatakan keraguan atau keberatan secara profesional dan sopan. Kata ini netral dan tidak emosional, berbeda dengan 'hatred' atau 'anger' yang terlalu kuat dan tidak pantas dalam konteks profesional. Frasa lengkapnya 'I have some reservations about...' adalah cara standar untuk menyampaikan kekhawatiran dengan bijaksana.

quiz.question: Which response best demonstrates diplomatic disagreement? A: 'We should launch next month.' B: '___'
options: While I agree with your enthusiasm, the practical application might require more preparation time.
That's a terrible idea and it will never work.
You clearly don't understand the situation.
quiz.answer: While I agree with your enthusiasm, the practical application might require more preparation time.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini sempurna karena: (1) mengakui aspek positif dari usulan ('I agree with your enthusiasm'), (2) menggunakan 'while' sebagai penghubung yang halus, dan (3) menyampaikan kekhawatiran dengan fokus pada fakta praktis ('practical application might require...') bukan pada menyalahkan orang. Ini adalah contoh ideal argumentasi diplomatik di level B1.

modules.title: Bridge to B2: Extended Spontaneous Discourse, Debate & Argument Structure
modules.group: B1.3 - Critical Perspectives & Bridge to B2
modules.objective: Mempersiapkan transisi ke level Vantage (B2) dengan latihan berbicara panjang tanpa jeda, menyusun argumen terstruktur.

theory.summary: Modul ini mempersiapkan kamu untuk level B2 dengan fokus pada kemampuan berbicara panjang tanpa jeda dan menyusun argumen yang terstruktur. Kamu akan belajar struktur PEE (Point-Evidence-Explanation) untuk membangun argumen yang kuat, menggunakan discourse markers yang tepat untuk menghubungkan ide, dan menanggapi counterarguments dengan efektif. Ini adalah jembatan penting menuju kemampuan berbahasa tingkat menengah atas.
rules: Opening Statement Structure: Start with a clear thesis + Preview your main points. Pattern: 'I believe/argue that [thesis]. I will discuss [point 1], [point 2], and [point 3].'

PEE Framework: Point (state your argument) + Evidence (provide facts/examples) + Explanation (connect evidence to your point). Pattern: 'Firstly, [point]. For instance, [evidence]. This demonstrates that [explanation].'

Discourse Markers for Coherence: Use 'furthermore' (menambah), 'nevertheless' (kontras ringan), 'in contrast' (perbedaan jelas), 'consequently' (sebab-akibat). Example: 'Furthermore, studies show... Nevertheless, opponents argue... In contrast to this view... Consequently, we must...'
Addressing Counterarguments: Acknowledge opposing views then refute. Pattern: 'While some may argue that [counterargument], however [your refutation]. Moreover, [additional support].'
Powerful Summary: Restate thesis + Synthesize main points + Call to action/final thought. Pattern: 'In conclusion, [restate thesis]. As I have shown, [summary]. Therefore, [final impact statement].'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Menggunakan Discourse Markers
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa B1 menggunakan discourse markers secara berlebihan atau di posisi yang salah, membuat kalimat terdengar tidak natural. 'However' tidak bisa digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua independent clause dengan koma saja.
commonTrap.wrong: Online learning is convenient, however it lacks social interaction.
commonTrap.correct: Online learning is convenient. However, it lacks social interaction. / Online learning is convenient; however, it lacks social interaction.

vocab.collocation: Furthermore, the research indicates that regular exercise improves mental health significantly.
The plan has some drawbacks. Nevertheless, I believe we should proceed with caution.
The city failed to invest in public transport; consequently, traffic congestion worsened dramatically.
A common counterargument is that technology reduces face-to-face communication skills.
She presented compelling evidence that supports her position on climate change.
I acknowledge that there are valid concerns, but the benefits outweigh the risks.
The speaker attempted to refute the opposition's claims with statistical data.
Academic discourse requires clear structure and evidence-based reasoning.
In your conclusion, synthesize the main arguments to show how they connect.
I strongly advocate for increased funding in education to ensure equal opportunities.

dialogue.context: Dua mahasiswa, Emma dan James, sedang berlatih untuk kompetisi debat kampus. Mereka mendiskusikan strategi menyusun argumen yang efektif.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: James, I've been struggling with my opening statement. How do you make yours so compelling?
lines.translation: James, aku kesulitan dengan opening statement-ku. Bagaimana kamu membuat opening-mu begitu meyakinkan?

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: I always start with a clear thesis, then preview my three main points. Furthermore, I use a rhetorical question or striking statistic to grab attention immediately.
lines.translation: Aku selalu mulai dengan thesis yang jelas, lalu preview tiga poin utamaku. Lebih lanjut, aku menggunakan pertanyaan retoris atau statistik yang menarik untuk langsung menarik perhatian.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: That makes sense. But what about handling counterarguments? I always feel defensive when they challenge my points.
lines.translation: Itu masuk akal. Tapi bagaimana dengan menangani counterarguments? Aku selalu merasa defensif ketika mereka menantang poin-poinku.

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: Don't be defensive. Acknowledge their point first, then refute it with stronger evidence. For instance, say 'While some may argue that X, nevertheless, research shows Y.' This demonstrates confidence.
lines.translation: Jangan defensif. Akui poin mereka dulu, lalu bantah dengan bukti yang lebih kuat. Misalnya, katakan 'Meskipun beberapa orang mungkin berargumen bahwa X, namun demikian, penelitian menunjukkan Y.' Ini menunjukkan kepercayaan diri.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: I see. And for the conclusion? Should I just summarize everything?
lines.translation: Aku paham. Dan untuk kesimpulan? Apakah aku hanya harus merangkum semuanya?

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: Not just summarize. Synthesize your arguments to show how they connect, then end with a powerful call to action. Consequently, the judges will remember your message long after you finish speaking.
lines.translation: Tidak hanya merangkum. Sintesiskan argumen-argumenmu untuk menunjukkan bagaimana mereka terhubung, lalu akhiri dengan seruan bertindak yang kuat. Akibatnya, para juri akan mengingat pesanmu lama setelah kamu selesai berbicara.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: That's brilliant advice. In contrast to my previous approach, this structure feels much more professional and persuasive.
lines.translation: Itu saran yang brilian. Berbeda dengan pendekatanku sebelumnya, struktur ini terasa jauh lebih profesional dan persuasif.

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: Exactly. Practice using discourse markers naturally, and you'll sound like a B2 speaker in no time. Let's rehearse your speech together now.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. Latihan menggunakan discourse markers secara natural, dan kamu akan terdengar seperti pembicara B2 dalam waktu singkat. Mari kita latihan pidatomu bersama sekarang.

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul akan berperan sebagai moderator debat dan kamu adalah peserta yang harus menyampaikan argumen terstruktur tentang topik: 'Should social media platforms be regulated by the government?' Gunakan struktur PEE dan discourse markers yang tepat.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good afternoon! Welcome to today's debate practice. Your topic is: 'Should social media platforms be regulated by the government?' You have two minutes to present your opening statement. Please begin with your thesis and preview your main points.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Khoirul. I believe that social media platforms should be regulated by the government to protect users and ensure accountability. I will discuss three main points: user safety, misinformation control, and corporate responsibility.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent opening! Now, present your first point using the PEE structure. Remember: Point, Evidence, and Explanation.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Firstly, government regulation is essential for user safety. For instance, studies show that unregulated platforms allow harmful content targeting vulnerable groups, particularly children. This demonstrates that without oversight, social media companies prioritize profit over user wellbeing.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Strong argument! Now, let me present a counterargument: 'Some argue that government regulation threatens free speech and innovation.' How would you address this?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: While some may argue that regulation threatens free speech, however, targeted regulations can protect users without censoring legitimate expression. Furthermore, innovation thrives within ethical boundaries. Consequently, balanced regulation actually promotes sustainable growth in the tech industry.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Well handled! You've acknowledged the opposing view and refuted it effectively. Now, can you synthesize your arguments and provide a powerful conclusion?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: In conclusion, government regulation of social media is necessary to ensure user safety, combat misinformation, and hold corporations accountable. As I have shown, the benefits of regulation outweigh concerns about innovation. Therefore, we must implement smart regulations that protect citizens while fostering technological advancement.

quiz.question: Which discourse marker best fits this sentence? 'The project deadline is tight. ___, we must allocate more resources to complete it on time.'
quiz.explanation: 'Consequently' menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat yang tepat. Karena deadline ketat (sebab), maka kita harus alokasi lebih banyak sumber daya (akibat). 'Nevertheless' digunakan untuk kontras, dan 'In contrast' untuk membandingkan perbedaan.

quiz.question: In the PEE framework, what does the 'Explanation' component do?
options: Provides statistical data to support the point
Connects the evidence back to your main argument
quiz.answer: Connects the evidence back to your main argument
quiz.explanation: Explanation dalam PEE berfungsi menghubungkan bukti (evidence) kembali ke argumen utama (point), menjelaskan mengapa bukti tersebut mendukung klaim kamu. Ini adalah langkah analisis yang membuat argumen menjadi koheren dan meyakinkan.

quiz.question: Identify the correctly structured counterargument response: ___
options: Some people think online learning is bad, but I disagree completely.
While critics argue online learning lacks interaction, nevertheless, technology enables virtual collaboration that can be equally effective.
Online learning is better than traditional learning in every way.
quiz.answer: While critics argue online learning lacks interaction, nevertheless, technology enables virtual collaboration that can be equally effective.
quiz.explanation: Struktur yang benar untuk menanggapi counterargument adalah: acknowledge (While critics argue...) kemudian refute dengan bukti (nevertheless, technology enables...). Ini menunjukkan kamu memahami sudut pandang lawan namun memiliki argumen yang lebih kuat untuk membantahnya.

quiz.question: 'The study has limitations. ___, the findings provide valuable insights into consumer behavior.' Which marker shows appropriate contrast?
quiz.explanation: 'Nevertheless' adalah discourse marker yang tepat untuk menunjukkan kontras atau pengakuan terhadap kelemahan namun tetap menekankan nilai positif. Artinya: meskipun ada keterbatasan, temuan tetap berharga. 'Consequently' untuk sebab-akibat, 'Furthermore' untuk menambah informasi sejenis.

quiz.question: Which sentence demonstrates effective synthesis in a conclusion?
options: In conclusion, I talked about education, technology, and society.
To summarize, my three points were important and you should remember them.
As demonstrated, investment in education, coupled with technological advancement, creates sustainable economic growth that benefits society as a whole.
quiz.answer: As demonstrated, investment in education, coupled with technological advancement, creates sustainable economic growth that benefits society as a whole.
quiz.explanation: Sintesis yang efektif menunjukkan bagaimana berbagai argumen terhubung dan menghasilkan kesimpulan yang lebih besar (bigger picture). Contoh ini menggabungkan education + technology untuk menunjukkan dampak kolektif terhadap economic growth dan society, bukan sekadar mengulang poin-poin secara terpisah.

modules.title: Ujian Kelulusan Akhir B1: Comprehensive 4-Skills CEFR B1 Graduation Exam
modules.group: B1.3 - Critical Perspectives & Bridge to B2
modules.objective: Ujian kelulusan akhir komprehensif 4 keterampilan (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) untuk membuka Level B2 (B2.1)

theory.summary: Ujian kelulusan akhir B1 ini menguji kemampuan komprehensif Anda dalam keempat keterampilan bahasa Inggris: Listening (memahami seminar dan debat formal), Reading (menganalisis artikel opini dan teks argumentatif), Writing & Grammar (menguasai third conditional, mixed conditionals, reporting verbs, wish structures, dan non-defining relative clauses), serta Speaking (presentasi ide dan debat interaktif). Ujian ini dirancang untuk memastikan Anda siap melangkah ke level B2 dengan fondasi yang kuat dalam berkomunikasi secara akurat dan natural dalam konteks akademik dan profesional.
rules: Third Conditional: If + past perfect, would/could/might + have + past participle. Contoh: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
Mixed Conditionals: Menggabungkan time frame berbeda. Contoh: If I had taken that job (past), I would be living in Tokyo now (present).
Reporting Verbs: claim, suggest, deny, admit, insist + that clause atau infinitive. Contoh: She admitted (that) she had made a mistake. / He suggested going to the cinema.
Wish + Past Perfect: Menyatakan penyesalan masa lalu. Contoh: I wish I had learned Spanish when I was younger.
Non-defining Relative Clauses: Memberikan informasi tambahan dengan koma. Contoh: My brother, who lives in Australia, is a doctor.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum dalam Struktur Lanjutan B1
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa level B1 masih mencampuradukkan third conditional dengan second conditional, atau lupa menggunakan 'had' pada wish structures untuk penyesalan masa lalu. Kesalahan lain adalah tidak menggunakan koma pada non-defining relative clauses, atau salah menempatkan reporting verbs.
commonTrap.wrong: If I would have known, I would come earlier. / I wish I studied harder last year.
commonTrap.correct: If I had known, I would have come earlier. / I wish I had studied harder last year.

vocab.collocation: The report provides a comprehensive analysis of the environmental impact.
The new policy sparked controversy among local residents.
The government invested heavily in improving the country's infrastructure.
She presented a compelling argument for renewable energy.
The company plans to implement the new strategy next quarter.
The government launched a new initiative to reduce plastic waste.
She is a strong advocate for children's rights.
There has been a substantial increase in tourism this year.
New safety regulations will be enforced starting next month.
Corporate sustainability has become a priority for many businesses.

dialogue.context: Dua mahasiswa, Sarah dan Marcus, sedang mendiskusikan persiapan mereka untuk ujian kelulusan B1 di perpustakaan kampus.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I'm feeling quite nervous about the graduation exam tomorrow. Have you finished reviewing all the grammar structures?
lines.translation: Aku merasa agak gugup tentang ujian kelulusan besok. Apakah kamu sudah selesai mengulas semua struktur tata bahasa?

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Yeah, I've been focusing on mixed conditionals and reporting verbs today. I wish I had started preparing earlier, to be honest.
lines.translation: Ya, aku telah fokus pada mixed conditionals dan reporting verbs hari ini. Sejujurnya, aku berharap sudah mulai mempersiapkan lebih awal.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Same here. If I had managed my time better last week, I wouldn't be so stressed now. What about the listening section?
lines.translation: Sama denganku. Jika aku mengatur waktuku dengan lebih baik minggu lalu, aku tidak akan se-stress ini sekarang. Bagaimana dengan bagian listening?

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: I've been practicing with seminar recordings. The key is to identify the main arguments and supporting details quickly.
lines.translation: Aku telah berlatih dengan rekaman seminar. Kuncinya adalah mengidentifikasi argumen utama dan detail pendukung dengan cepat.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That's good advice. I'm most worried about the speaking section where we have to debate with Mr. Khoirul. Do you have any strategies?
lines.translation: Itu saran yang bagus. Aku paling khawatir tentang bagian speaking di mana kita harus berdebat dengan Mr. Khoirul. Apakah kamu punya strategi?

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Just stay calm and use the discourse markers we've learned. Also, don't forget to provide examples to support your opinions.
lines.translation: Tetap tenang saja dan gunakan discourse markers yang sudah kita pelajari. Juga, jangan lupa untuk memberikan contoh untuk mendukung pendapatmu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: You're right. If we apply everything we've learned systematically, we should be fine. Let's do a quick practice round together.
lines.translation: Kamu benar. Jika kita menerapkan semua yang telah kita pelajari secara sistematis, kita seharusnya baik-baik saja. Ayo kita lakukan latihan cepat bersama.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Absolutely. I suggest we start with a mock debate on environmental policy. That's likely to come up in the exam.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Aku menyarankan kita mulai dengan debat simulasi tentang kebijakan lingkungan. Itu kemungkinan akan muncul dalam ujian.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang mengikuti bagian Speaking dari ujian kelulusan B1 bersama Mr. Khoirul. Anda diminta untuk mempresentasikan pendapat tentang kebijakan transportasi publik di kota besar, kemudian berdebat secara interaktif dengan argumen yang konstruktif.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good afternoon! Welcome to your B1 graduation speaking exam. Today, I'd like you to present your perspective on this topic: 'Should cities prioritize public transportation over private vehicles?' Please share your main argument and supporting reasons.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Khoirul. I believe cities should absolutely prioritize public transportation. If governments invested more in efficient public transport systems, we would see reduced traffic congestion and lower carbon emissions. For example, cities like Tokyo have demonstrated that comprehensive metro systems can serve millions of people effectively.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a compelling argument. However, some people claim that private vehicles offer more flexibility and convenience, especially for families or those living in suburban areas. How would you respond to that perspective?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's a valid concern. While private vehicles do offer convenience, I would argue that if we had developed better public transport infrastructure earlier, people wouldn't feel so dependent on cars. We could implement park-and-ride facilities and improve last-mile connectivity to address suburban residents' needs.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Interesting solution. Let me challenge you further: implementing such comprehensive systems requires substantial funding. Where should this money come from, especially in developing countries with limited budgets?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's definitely a challenge. I suggest that governments could reallocate funds currently spent on building new roads and highways. Additionally, public-private partnerships could help finance these projects. If we had prioritized this decades ago, we wouldn't face such huge costs now, but it's never too late to start.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent points and well-structured arguments. You've demonstrated strong command of conditional structures and persuasive language. One final question: What would you say to citizens who resist giving up their cars?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would emphasize the long-term benefits: cleaner air, reduced stress from traffic, and lower transportation costs. I wish more people understood that choosing public transport is not just about personal convenience, but about creating sustainable cities for future generations. Education and incentives, like reduced fares or tax benefits, could help change mindsets gradually.

quiz.question:
[Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Good morning, everyone. Today's seminar focuses on urban sustainability. Dr. Martinez argues that cities must implement comprehensive green policies immediately. She claims that if governments had taken climate change seriously twenty years ago, we wouldn't be facing such severe environmental crises today. However, some experts suggest that economic growth should remain the priority.' 

Based on the transcript, what does Dr. Martinez believe about past government action?
options: Governments acted appropriately on climate issues
If governments had acted earlier, current crises could have been avoided
Economic growth is more important than environmental policies
Cities have already implemented sufficient green policies
quiz.answer: If governments had acted earlier, current crises could have been avoided
quiz.explanation: Dr. Martinez menggunakan third conditional ('if governments had taken... we wouldn't be facing') untuk menyatakan penyesalan bahwa pemerintah tidak bertindak lebih awal terhadap perubahan iklim. Ini menunjukkan dia percaya situasi krisis saat ini bisa dihindari jika ada tindakan di masa lalu.

quiz.question:
[Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'In yesterday's debate, Professor Chen insisted that technology alone cannot solve social inequality. She admitted that while digital innovations have created opportunities, they have also widened the gap between rich and poor communities. She suggested investing more in education and skills training programs.' 

What did Professor Chen admit about technology?
options: Technology has completely solved inequality problems
Technology has only positive effects on society
While technology creates opportunities, it also increases inequality
Technology should not be used in education
quiz.answer: While technology creates opportunities, it also increases inequality
quiz.explanation: Kata 'admitted' adalah reporting verb yang menunjukkan Professor Chen mengakui fakta. Dia mengakui bahwa meskipun teknologi menciptakan peluang ('created opportunities'), teknologi juga memperlebar kesenjangan ('widened the gap'). Ini menunjukkan pemahaman nuansa tentang dampak ganda teknologi.

quiz.question:
[Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'The panel discussion revealed diverse opinions. Mr. Thompson, who has worked in urban planning for 30 years, emphasized the importance of community involvement. He claimed that top-down policies often fail because they ignore local needs. Ms. Rivera, on the other hand, argued that strong central regulation is necessary to ensure consistent standards.' 

Which statement about Mr. Thompson is correct?
options: He supports top-down policies without community input
He believes policies fail when they ignore local community needs
He has no experience in urban planning
He agrees completely with Ms. Rivera's approach
quiz.answer: He believes policies fail when they ignore local community needs
quiz.explanation: Mr. Thompson mengklaim ('claimed that') bahwa kebijakan top-down sering gagal karena mengabaikan kebutuhan lokal. Ini menunjukkan dia percaya keterlibatan komunitas sangat penting. Informasi tambahan dalam non-defining relative clause ('who has worked... 30 years') memberikan kredibilitas pada pendapatnya.

quiz.question:
[Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'During the conference, several speakers addressed infrastructure challenges. Dr. Kim stated that if developing nations had received adequate international support in the 1990s, their infrastructure would be much more advanced today. She denied that corruption was the sole reason for infrastructure gaps, suggesting that lack of funding and expertise were equally important factors.' 

What mixed conditional does Dr. Kim express?
options: Past action would have different past result
Past action would have different present result
Present action would have present result
Future action will have future result
quiz.answer: Past action would have different present result
quiz.explanation: Dr. Kim menggunakan mixed conditional yang menghubungkan past condition ('if... had received... in the 1990s') dengan present result ('infrastructure would be... today'). Ini adalah ciri khas mixed conditional yang menunjukkan bagaimana tindakan masa lalu mempengaruhi situasi sekarang.

quiz.question:
[Reading Comprehension] Read the passage: 'The debate over remote work continues to divide opinion. Advocates argue that flexible working arrangements improve work-life balance and reduce commuting stress. Companies that implemented remote work policies during the pandemic, such as tech giants in Silicon Valley, have reported sustained productivity levels. Critics, however, claim that remote work weakens team cohesion and organizational culture. They insist that face-to-face interaction is essential for innovation and collaboration.' 

According to the passage, what do critics of remote work insist?
options: Remote work always increases productivity significantly
Face-to-face interaction is crucial for innovation and teamwork
All companies should adopt permanent remote work policies
Remote work has no negative effects on organizations
quiz.answer: Face-to-face interaction is crucial for innovation and teamwork
quiz.explanation: Kata 'insist' menunjukkan pendirian kuat dari kritikus remote work. Mereka bersikeras bahwa interaksi tatap muka ('face-to-face interaction') adalah esensial untuk inovasi dan kolaborasi. Ini merupakan argumen utama melawan remote work dalam teks.

quiz.question:
[Reading Comprehension] Read the passage: 'Environmental regulations have become increasingly stringent worldwide. The European Union's Green Deal, which aims to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050, represents one of the most ambitious climate initiatives globally. Supporters maintain that such comprehensive regulations are necessary to prevent catastrophic climate change. Business leaders, who often express concerns about compliance costs, nevertheless acknowledge that sustainability has become a competitive advantage in modern markets.' 

What is the function of the clause 'who often express concerns about compliance costs'?
options: It defines which business leaders are being discussed
It provides additional non-essential information about business leaders
It contradicts the main point about regulations
It introduces a new topic unrelated to the passage
quiz.answer: It provides additional non-essential information about business leaders
quiz.explanation: Klausa 'who often express concerns about compliance costs' adalah non-defining relative clause yang ditandai dengan koma. Klausa ini memberikan informasi tambahan tentang business leaders tanpa mendefinisikan atau membatasi siapa mereka. Informasi ini bisa dihilangkan tanpa mengubah makna inti kalimat.

quiz.question:
[Reading Comprehension] Read the passage: 'The rise of artificial intelligence poses both opportunities and challenges for education. If educators had anticipated this technological shift earlier, curricula might have been adapted more smoothly. Today's students, many of whom will work in jobs that don't yet exist, need skills that emphasize critical thinking and adaptability rather than memorization. Educational institutions must therefore reimagine their approaches to prepare students for an AI-integrated future.' 

What does the passage suggest about educators and AI?
options: Educators successfully predicted all AI developments
Earlier anticipation could have made curriculum adaptation easier
Students don't need new skills for the future
AI has no impact on educational requirements
quiz.answer: Earlier anticipation could have made curriculum adaptation easier
quiz.explanation: Kalimat menggunakan third conditional ('If educators had anticipated... curricula might have been adapted') untuk menyatakan bahwa jika pendidik telah mengantisipasi pergeseran teknologi AI lebih awal, kurikulum mungkin bisa disesuaikan dengan lebih mulus. Ini menyiratkan penyesalan bahwa hal tersebut tidak terjadi.

quiz.question:
[Reading Comprehension] Read the passage: 'Public health experts continue to debate optimal vaccination strategies. Dr. Sanders claims that mandatory vaccination policies have proven effective in preventing disease outbreaks, citing the eradication of smallpox as compelling evidence. She suggests that governments should implement similar comprehensive programs for emerging diseases. Critics, meanwhile, argue that individual freedom must be balanced with public health concerns, proposing voluntary programs with strong educational components instead.' 

How does Dr. Sanders support her position?
options: She provides no evidence for her claims
She uses the smallpox eradication as evidence for mandatory vaccination effectiveness
She suggests only voluntary vaccination programs
quiz.answer: She uses the smallpox eradication as evidence for mandatory vaccination effectiveness
quiz.explanation: Dr. Sanders mengklaim ('claims that') bahwa kebijakan vaksinasi wajib terbukti efektif, dan dia mendukung klaimnya dengan menyebutkan ('citing') pemberantasan cacar sebagai bukti yang meyakinkan ('compelling evidence'). Ini menunjukkan cara argumentasi yang kuat dengan menggunakan bukti historis konkret.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Rewrite the sentence using third conditional: 'I didn't know about the meeting, so I didn't attend.' Which option correctly transforms this sentence?
options: If I knew about the meeting, I would attend.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended.
If I know about the meeting, I will attend.
If I would have known about the meeting, I had attended.
quiz.answer: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended.
quiz.explanation: Third conditional digunakan untuk situasi hipotesis di masa lalu yang tidak terjadi. Struktur yang benar adalah: If + past perfect (had known), would + have + past participle (would have attended). Pilihan lain menggunakan tenses yang salah atau struktur yang tidak gramatikal.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the sentence with correct reporting verb usage:
options: She suggested to go to the cinema.
He admitted that he had made a mistake.
quiz.answer: He admitted that he had made a mistake.
quiz.explanation: Reporting verb 'admit' diikuti oleh 'that clause' atau bentuk gerund. Pilihan 'He admitted that he had made a mistake' benar karena menggunakan struktur admit + that clause dengan tense yang tepat (past perfect untuk menunjukkan aksi sebelum admitting). Pilihan lain menggunakan infinitive yang salah atau struktur yang tidak lengkap.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Which sentence correctly expresses a wish about the past?
options: I wish I can speak French fluently.
I wish I could have learned Spanish when I was young.
I wish I had studied harder for the exam last week.
I wish I will travel to Japan next year.
quiz.answer: I wish I had studied harder for the exam last week.
quiz.explanation: Untuk menyatakan penyesalan tentang masa lalu, gunakan 'wish + past perfect'. Pilihan 'I wish I had studied harder for the exam last week' benar karena menggunakan 'had studied' (past perfect) untuk menyesali tindakan yang tidak dilakukan di masa lalu. Pilihan lain menggunakan tenses yang tidak tepat untuk menyatakan wish tentang masa lalu.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Identify the sentence with correct mixed conditional structure:
options: If I had taken that job, I would live in London now.
If I take that job, I would have lived in London.
If I took that job, I will live in London.
If I have taken that job, I would be living in London.
quiz.answer: If I had taken that job, I would live in London now.
quiz.explanation: Mixed conditional menghubungkan past condition dengan present result. Struktur yang benar: If + past perfect (had taken), would + base verb (would live). Kalimat ini menunjukkan bahwa tindakan masa lalu (tidak mengambil pekerjaan) mempengaruhi situasi sekarang (tidak tinggal di London). Pilihan lain mencampurkan tenses yang tidak sesuai untuk mixed conditional.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] You are in a formal debate and need to politely disagree with someone's argument about environmental policy. Which response is most appropriate?
options: I see your point, however, I would argue that renewable energy investments offer long-term economic benefits that outweigh initial costs.
That's stupid. Everyone knows solar power is better.
No way! I totally disagree with everything you said.
quiz.answer: I see your point, however, I would argue that renewable energy investments offer long-term economic benefits that outweigh initial costs.
quiz.explanation: Dalam debat formal level B1, penting untuk tidak setuju dengan sopan menggunakan discourse markers seperti 'I see your point, however' dan kemudian menyampaikan argumen dengan bahasa yang terstruktur ('I would argue that...'). Ini menunjukkan kemampuan berdebat secara akademis tanpa bersikap konfrontatif atau kasar.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] During a presentation, someone asks you a challenging question you're not prepared for. What's the most professional B1-level response?
options: I don't know anything about that topic.

That's an excellent question. While I don't have specific data at hand, I would suggest that further research in this area could provide valuable insights. I'd be happy to follow up with more information later.
I can't answer that. Next question, please.
Why are you asking me such difficult questions?
quiz.answer: That's an excellent question. While I don't have specific data at hand, I would suggest that further research in this area could provide valuable insights. I'd be happy to follow up with more information later.
quiz.explanation: Respons profesional level B1 harus menunjukkan kemampuan mengelola situasi tidak terduga dengan sopan. Jawaban ini mengakui pertanyaan ('excellent question'), jujur tentang keterbatasan ('don't have specific data'), menyarankan solusi ('further research'), dan menawarkan tindak lanjut. Ini menunjukkan kematangan komunikasi dan fleksibilitas.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] You need to present a counter-argument in a seminar discussion about urban development. Which approach demonstrates strong B1 speaking skills?
options: I completely disagree with everything that was just said about high-rise buildings.
While high-rise buildings do maximize space efficiency, I would argue that we must also consider their environmental impact and effects on community cohesion. For instance, studies have shown that...
High-rise buildings are terrible and nobody likes them.
Everyone knows low-rise buildings are better. That's obvious.
quiz.answer: While high-rise buildings do maximize space efficiency, I would argue that we must also consider their environmental impact and effects on community cohesion. For instance, studies have shown that...
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menunjukkan kemampuan B1 untuk: (1) mengakui argumen lawan dengan sopan ('While... do maximize'), (2) memperkenalkan counter-argument terstruktur ('I would argue that'), (3) memberikan alasan spesifik ('environmental impact', 'community cohesion'), dan (4) mengindikasikan akan memberikan bukti ('For instance, studies...'). Ini adalah pola argumentasi akademis yang matang.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] You're concluding a debate presentation and need to summarize your position persuasively. Which conclusion is most effective at B1 level?
options: That's all I have to say. Thank you.

In conclusion, I believe I've demonstrated that sustainable urban planning requires balancing economic growth with environmental protection. If we implement these policies now, future generations will benefit significantly. I urge all stakeholders to consider this comprehensive approach.
So yeah, we should do sustainable stuff. The end.
I think I'm right and that's my opinion. Thanks for listening.
quiz.answer: In conclusion, I believe I've demonstrated that sustainable urban planning requires balancing economic growth with environmental protection. If we implement these policies now, future generations will benefit significantly. I urge all stakeholders to consider this comprehensive approach.
quiz.explanation: Kesimpulan yang efektif di level B1 harus: (1) menggunakan discourse marker formal ('In conclusion'), (2) merangkum argumen utama dengan jelas, (3) menggunakan struktur conditional untuk memperkuat argumen ('If we implement... will benefit'), (4) menyertakan call to action persuasif ('I urge...'), dan (5) menggunakan bahasa formal yang tepat ('stakeholders', 'comprehensive approach'). Ini menunjukkan kemampuan presentasi akademis yang matang.
